Jev with Foresight: Safe Language-Guided Autonomous Driving via a Language World Model AutonomousDriving

language world model language-guided driving safe autonomous driving foresight candidate action evaluation

简要说明：Jev-AD 将类型化决策模型与预测未来交通动态的语言世界模型相结合，通过评估候选动作的预见后果，实现了更安全的语言引导自动驾驶。

TLDR: Jev-AD combines a typed decision model with a language world model that predicts future traffic movements in natural language, enabling safer language-guided autonomous driving by evaluating foreseen consequences of candidate actions.

Abstract: Large language models understand passengers' driving commands, but as driving agents they reason in generated text for seconds and must infer each action's consequences implicitly from the scene. We present Jev-AD, which pairs Jev, a typed decision model that answers predefined questions with probabilities, not generated text, with a language world model that predicts for every candidate action how nearby vehicles move over the next two seconds. Code turns these predictions into foreseen consequences, which Jev compares instead of inferring them from coordinates. In simulated highway merging (500 car-episodes), this foresight lowers the same decision model's collision rate from 26.0% to 2.4% at 0.25 seconds per decision, and Jev-AD achieves the passenger's intent in 93% of free-form command trials. In 500 replayed real-world NGSIM episodes, foresight lowers the collision rate from 48.2% to 2.8%, and the world model, learned from this traffic, foresees 93% of dangerous actions. Project page: https://ys-qu.github.io/jev-ad-website.

摘要（中文）：大型语言模型能够理解乘客的驾驶指令，但作为驾驶智能体，它们需要花费数秒在生成的文本中进行推理，并且必须隐式地从场景中推断每个动作的后果。我们提出了Jev-AD，它将Jev（一个类型化决策模型，通过概率而非生成文本回答预定义问题）与一个语言世界模型相结合，该模型能够针对每个候选动作预测周围车辆在未来两秒内的运动轨迹。代码将这些预测转化为可预见的后果，而Jev则直接对这些后果进行比较，而无需从坐标中推断。在模拟高速公路并线（500次车辆场景）中，这种前瞻性使得同一决策模型的碰撞率在每决策0.25秒的条件下从26.0%降至2.4%，且Jev-AD在93%的自由形式指令测试中实现了乘客意图。在500次回放的真实世界NGSIM场景中，前瞻性将碰撞率从48.2%降至2.8%，且从该交通数据中学习到的世界模型能够预见93%的危险动作。项目页面：https://ys-qu.github.io/jev-ad-website。

Authors: Yansong Qu, Jiancong Chen, Samuel Labi

Should the Action Expert Train the VLM? Action-Token Supervision and Gradient Routing in Mixture-of-Transformer VLAs VLA

vision-language-action gradient routing action tokens mixture-of-transformers autonomous driving

简要说明：本文研究了VLA训练中梯度隔离是否有益，发现动作令牌监督和评估设置决定了其价值，耦合通常在驾驶和操作中带来性能提升。

TLDR: This paper investigates whether gradient insulation in VLA training is beneficial, showing that action-token supervision and evaluation setting determine its value, with coupling often improving driving and manipulation performance.

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models increasingly pair a pre-trained vision-language model (VLM) with a flow-matching expert that conditions its action predictions on the VLM's key-value representations. Those representations must carry information useful for control, yet the VLM was never trained for the action expert's flow-matching objective. Two signals can address this: gradients backpropagated from the expert's loss (coupling), or VLM supervision to predict discrete tokens encoding the same target actions. Prominent training recipes forgo the first, blocking expert-to-VLM gradients (insulation) to protect the VLM's existing capabilities, while also supervising it on vision-language data and action tokens. Because vision-language co-training also aims to preserve those capabilities, the additional protection provided by insulation is unclear. At the same time, insulation removes a direct signal about which features continuous action prediction requires. On the other hand, action-token supervision offers an alternative way to learn action-relevant representations, which may explain why insulation succeeds in practice. We disentangle these factors in autonomous driving and manipulation by independently varying action-token supervision and whether the expert's loss updates the VLM. In open-loop driving, insulation is competitive with coupling when action tokens are supervised; without them, coupling reduces trajectory-prediction error by roughly 25%. When both components are trained jointly from the outset, coupling increases closed-loop driving route progress by approximately 17% with action-token supervision and 40% without it, and similarly improves robot manipulation performance under both settings. These findings show that the value of gradient insulation depends on the VLM's action supervision and the evaluation setting, challenging insulation as a default VLA training recipe.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型越来越多地将预训练的视觉-语言模型（VLM）与流匹配专家相结合，后者根据VLM的键值表示来条件化其动作预测。这些表示必须携带对控制有用的信息，然而VLM从未针对动作专家的流匹配目标进行训练。两种信号可以解决这一问题：从专家损失反向传播的梯度（耦合），或通过VLM监督来预测编码相同目标动作的离散令牌。主流训练方案放弃了前者，阻断专家到VLM的梯度（绝缘）以保护VLM的现有能力，同时也在视觉-语言数据和动作令牌上对其进行监督。由于视觉-语言联合训练同样旨在保留这些能力，绝缘所提供的额外保护尚不明确。与此同时，绝缘消除了关于连续动作预测需要哪些特征的直接信号。另一方面，动作令牌监督提供了一种学习动作相关表示的替代途径，这可能解释了绝缘在实践中为何能成功。我们在自动驾驶和操作任务中，通过独立改变动作令牌监督以及专家的损失是否更新VLM，来厘清这些因素。在开环驾驶中，当动作令牌被监督时，绝缘与耦合表现相当；而在没有动作令牌监督的情况下，耦合将轨迹预测误差降低了约25%。当两个组件从一开始就联合训练时，耦合在动作令牌监督下将闭环驾驶路线进度提高了约17%，在没有动作令牌监督时提高了约40%，并且在两种设置下均同样改善了机器人操作性能。这些发现表明，梯度绝缘的价值取决于VLM的动作监督和评估设置，从而对将绝缘作为VLA训练的默认方案提出了挑战。

Authors: Asher James Hancock, Boyi Li, Yuxiao Chen, Shuhan Tan, Wenhao Ding, Thomas Tian, Yan Wang, Boris Ivanovic, Marco Pavone

Asynchronous Robot Policies VLA

Asynchronous Robot Policy Vision-Language-Action models semantic memory action generation real-time control

简要说明：本文提出异步机器人策略（ARP），通过异步进程将高层语义推理与低层动作生成解耦，在保持语义能力的同时实现快速响应的机器人操作控制。

TLDR: This paper proposes Asynchronous Robot Policies (ARP), an architecture that decouples high-level semantic reasoning from low-level action generation via asynchronous processes, enabling fast reactive control without sacrificing semantic capability in VLA robot manipulation.

Abstract: Scaling vision-language foundation models has significantly advanced generalist robot manipulation, but the increased model scale introduces computational latency that degrades real-time physical reactivity. Existing Vision-Language-Action (VLA) architectures execute high-level semantic reasoning and action ex- ecution sequentially within the primary control loop, creating a fundamental tension between semantic-reasoning capability and robot agility. To address this, we propose Asynchronous Robot Policy (ARP), an architectural framework that decouples semantic reasoning from low-level action generation using asynchronous processes operating at independent frequencies. In ARP, a high-capacity Vision-Language Model (VLM) asynchronously updates a semantic memory at low fre- quency, while a lightweight Vision-Action Expert, conditioned on this semantic memory, generates robot actions at a much higher control frequency. Such a formulation, enables having a fast perception-action loop without compromising on the semantic capability. To overcome asynchronous memory staleness, ARP trains the vision-action expert on the semantic staleness and execution delay, with temporally mismatched observation across processes. On Franka manipulation tasks, ARP achieves an 18% higher success rate and 20% less time need for execution in quasi-static setups, while 3-5 times baseline performance in dynamic simulation environments. Furthermore, ARP enables operating the VLM at 10 times lower than its nominal frequency with no significant performance loss making it much more efficient than the baseline. These results highlight the architectural advantages of modeling robot policies as asynchronous processes, enabling real-world reactive deployment without sacrificing the scale of foundation models.

摘要（中文）：扩展视觉-语言基础模型的规模已显著推进通用机器人操作能力，但模型规模的增大引入了计算延迟，损害了实时物理响应性能。现有视觉-语言-动作（VLA）架构在主控制回路中顺序执行高层语义推理与动作执行，导致语义推理能力与机器人敏捷性之间存在根本性矛盾。为解决这一问题，我们提出异步机器人策略（ARP），一种通过以独立频率运行的异步进程将语义推理与低级动作生成解耦的架构框架。在ARP中，高容量视觉-语言模型（VLM）以低频异步更新语义记忆，而基于该语义记忆的轻量级视觉-动作专家则以更高的控制频率生成机器人动作。这一设计使得在不牺牲语义能力的前提下，实现快速感知-动作回路成为可能。为克服异步记忆陈旧性问题，ARP在训练视觉-动作专家时引入语义陈旧性与执行延迟，并处理跨进程的时间不匹配观测。在Franka操作任务中，ARP在准静态设置下实现了较基线高18%的成功率，并缩短20%的执行时间，同时在动态仿真环境中达到基线性能的3至5倍。此外，ARP支持VLM以标称频率的十分之一运行且无显著性能损失，使其相比基线更具效率。这些结果突显了将机器人策略建模为异步进程的架构优势，能够在不牺牲基础模型规模的前提下实现实时反应式部署。

Authors: Sombit Dey, Luc Van Gool, Danda Pani Paudel

DexHOT: Learning Hand-Object Configuration Transfer for Dexterous Manipulation Manipulation

hand-object configuration transfer dexterous manipulation relation-conditioned transfer primitive closed-loop tracking real robot

简要说明：DexHOT 从合成可行的手-物配置对中学习可重用的关系条件转移原语，无需人类参考运动，并通过配置子目标的闭环跟踪组合长时程灵巧操作行为，在仿真和真实灵巧手上均取得了很高的成功率。

TLDR: DexHOT learns a reusable relation-conditioned transfer primitive from synthetic feasible hand-object configuration pairs, without human reference motions, and composes long-horizon dexterous manipulation behaviors through closed-loop tracking of configuration subgoals, achieving high success on both simulated and real dexterous hands.

Abstract: Dexterous manipulation involves not only moving objects, but also arranging the hand around them to maintain useful contacts and enable subsequent actions. Yet many learning-based systems specify goals primarily through object poses or trajectories, leaving hand-object configurations to emerge implicitly. We introduce DexHOT, which formulates dexterous manipulation as hand-object configuration transfer: moving between feasible configurations that jointly specify hand articulation and object pose relative to the wrist. DexHOT learns a reusable relation-conditioned transfer primitive from synthetic feasible configuration pairs, without human reference motions, and composes long-horizon behaviors through closed-loop tracking of configuration subgoals. On DexHOTBench with 120 objects, a single policy achieves 80.5% transfer success on seen objects and 69.4% on unseen objects; on a real dexterous hand, it achieves 61.5% success over 200 real-robot transfers and 90% task success across six demonstration-guided tasks. These results show that explicit hand-object goals provide an expressive and composable interface for dexterous manipulation. More details and videos are available at https://dex-hot.github.io/.

摘要（中文）：灵巧操作不仅涉及移动物体，还要求手部围绕物体进行姿态调整，以保持有效接触并为后续动作创造条件。然而，许多基于学习的方法主要通过物体位姿或轨迹来设定目标，手与物体的构型关系则隐式地生成，缺乏显式约束。为此，我们提出DexHOT，将灵巧操作建模为手-物构型迁移：即在同时规定手部关节姿态与物体相对于手腕位姿的可行构型之间进行转移。DexHOT无需人工参考动作，仅从合成可行构型对中学习一种可复用的、受关系条件约束的迁移原语，并通过闭环跟踪构型子目标来编排长时程行为。在包含120个物体的DexHOTBench基准上，单一策略对已知物体达到80.5%的迁移成功率，对未见物体达到69.4%；在真实灵巧手上，经过200次实体机器人迁移实验获得61.5%的成功率，并在六项演示引导任务中实现90%的任务成功率。上述结果表明，显式的手-物目标为灵巧操作提供了富有表达能力且可组合的接口。更多详情与视频请访问 https://dex-hot.github.io/。

Authors: Zhewei Gui, Anthony Bolton, Jiyao Zhang, Zeyuan Chen, Qiyang Yan, Tianyu Wang, Hao Dong

HLO-AMP: Hierarchical Loco-Manipulation from Object-Aware Motion Priors HumanoidEmbodied

hierarchical loco-manipulation object-aware motion priors motion imitation whole-body control humanoid robot

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于人形机器人移动操作的分层框架，其中低级全身控制器通过运动模仿并在场景中放置操作对象进行训练，从而成为对象感知的运动先验。高级策略在此之上训练，以将这些先验泛化到长时程任务中，并在Unitree G1上展示了鲁棒的双臂箱子拾放操作。

TLDR: This paper introduces a hierarchical framework for humanoid loco-manipulation where the low-level whole-body controller is trained as an object-aware motion prior via motion imitation with the manipulated object in the scene. A high-level policy is trained on top to generalize these priors to long-horizon tasks, demonstrating robust bimanual box pick-and-place on a Unitree G1.

Abstract: Hierarchical pipelines for humanoid loco-manipulation typically pair a task-agnostic whole-body controller (WBC) with a downstream task policy. Such WBCs are often trained through manual reward shaping, which yields visibly machine-like motions; more consequentially, they are trained without the manipulated object in the scene. Object dynamics are instead approximated through randomized end-effector force disturbances, a proxy that fails to reproduce the distributed multi-contact wrench a real payload applies across the arms and torso, with the gap becoming critical near the platform's payload limit. In this work, we train the low-level (LL) controller itself as an object-aware motion prior: a single policy trained via motion imitation on retargeted motion-capture (MoCap) references that span the core motion primitives of the downstream task, with the manipulated object physically present in the scene. This single stage inherits natural human-like coordination from the references and absorbs the realistic contact wrench at its source, while exposing the same compact task-space command interface used by command-tracking WBCs. A reference-free high-level (HL) policy is then trained on top, with its action channel anchored to the empirical envelope of the low-level training data so that it generalizes the priors to a long-horizon multi-stage task while structurally preventing queries that would push the low level off-distribution. We instantiate the framework on a Unitree G1 for bimanual box pick-and-place: the same deployed policy generalizes across object masses and dimensions, initial and goal poses, and reactively recovers from intentional drops mid-carry. Video: https://youtu.be/viR_ULnRDQQ.

摘要（中文）：摘要： 类人机器人操作与移动分层流水线通常将任务无关的全身控制器（WBC）与下游任务策略配对。此类WBC通常通过手工奖励塑形进行训练，导致动作明显机械化；更为关键的是，训练过程中并未将被操作对象纳入场景。对象动力学转而通过随机化的末端执行器力扰动来近似，这种代理方法无法复现真实载荷在双臂及躯干上施加的分布式多接触力，尤其在接近平台载荷极限时，该差距变得至关重要。在本工作中，我们直接将底层（LL）控制器训练为对象感知的运动先验：通过运动模仿，在重定向的动作捕捉（MoCap）参考上训练单一策略，这些参考覆盖下游任务的核心运动基元，且被操作对象在场景中实际存在。该单一阶段继承参考中自然的人性化协调，并在源头吸收真实接触力，同时保持与命令跟踪型WBC相同的紧凑任务空间命令接口。随后，在其上训练无参考的高层（HL）策略，其动作通道锚定于底层训练数据的经验范围，从而将先验泛化到长时程多阶段任务中，同时从结构上避免将底层推向分布外的查询。我们在Unitree G1上实例化了该框架，用于双臂箱体抓取与放置：部署的同一策略在不同对象质量与尺寸、初始及目标位姿下均能泛化，并能反应式地从携带过程中的故意掉落中恢复。视频链接：https://youtu.be/viR_ULnRDQQ。

Authors: Jean-Pierre Sleiman, Bilal Hammoud, He Li, Jonathan Foster, Sylvain Bertrand, Jessica K. Hodgins, Farbod Farshidian

PrimeSim: A Generalist World Model Simulator from Large-Scale Cross-Embodiment Demonstrations WorldModel

world model action-conditioned video generation multiview consistency cross-embodiment long-horizon simulation

简要说明：PrimeSim 是一个基于跨本体机器人演示训练的动作条件多视角世界模型模拟器，通过渐进式训练、统一动作表示、视图感知注意力和层级记忆实现稳定长时程仿真，并支持策略优化。

TLDR: PrimeSim is an action-conditioned, multiview world model simulator trained on 30,110 hours of cross-embodiment robot demonstrations, featuring progressive mid/posttraining, unified action representation, view-aware attention, and hierarchical memory for stable long-horizon rollouts, enabling fast simulation and policy optimization.

Abstract: A robot world model that serves as a simulator must do more than generate plausible videos: it must faithfully follow commanded actions, maintain consistency across camera views, and sustain coherent long-horizon rollouts. We present PrimeSim, an action-conditioned, multiview world model simulator that addresses these challenges through progressive midtraining and posttraining. Starting from a pretrained video generator, we midtrain on 30,110 hours of robot demonstrations spanning 22 platforms. To improve action following, we introduce a unified cross-embodiment action representation and frame-aligned dual-path conditioning to strengthen action-frame correspondence. To maintain multiview consistency, we develop view-aware interleaved attention with explicit camera identities, enabling cross-view information exchange while preserving view-specific representations. We further introduce a fast-video, slow-memory posttraining framework that transforms the bidirectional video generator into an efficient autoregressive simulator. By combining fast causal generation, self-rollout training, and hierarchical temporal memory, PrimeSim mitigates error accumulation from self-generated histories and supports coherent long-horizon simulation. PrimeSim runs at 10.1 FPS, remains stable over long-horizon rollouts on rigid and deformable manipulation tasks, and transfers to held-out platforms within 100 to 200 gradient steps where the pretrained backbone does not. Against five open-source action-conditioned world models it leads four of the five WorldSimProbe suites and posts the best overall EWMBench score, while fine-grained local calibration still trails the field; its rollouts are faithful enough to support GRPO-based policy optimization. We release the model weights, inference code, and training code.

摘要（中文）：用作模拟器的机器人世界模型必须做到的不仅仅是生成看似合理的视频：它必须忠实地遵循所下达的动作指令，在不同相机视角之间保持一致性，并维持连贯的长时程推演。我们提出了PrimeSim，一种动作条件化的多视角世界模型模拟器，通过渐进式中期训练和后期训练来解决这些挑战。我们从预训练的视频生成器出发，在涵盖22个平台的30,110小时机器人演示数据上进行中期训练。为了提升动作跟随能力，我们引入了一种统一的跨具身动作表示，以及帧对齐的双路径条件注入机制，以增强动作与帧之间的对应关系。为了保持多视角一致性，我们开发了具有显式相机身份标识的视角感知交错注意力机制，在保留各视角特定表示的同时实现跨视角信息交换。我们进一步引入了一种“快速视频、慢速记忆”的后期训练框架，将双向视频生成器转化为高效的自回归模拟器。通过结合快速因果生成、自推演训练和分层时间记忆，PrimeSim缓解了由自生成历史累积带来的误差传播，并支持连贯的长时程仿真。PrimeSim以每秒10.1帧的速度运行，在刚性和可变形操作任务的长时程推演中保持稳定，并能在100至200个梯度步内迁移到未见过的平台，而预训练骨干模型无法做到这一点。在与五个开源动作条件化世界模型的对比中，PrimeSim在五个WorldSimProbe测试套件中领先其中四个，并在EWMBench整体得分上取得最优成绩，但在细粒度局部校准方面仍落后于现有方法；其生成的推演结果足够可靠，可支持基于GRPO的策略优化。我们发布了模型权重、推理代码和训练代码。

Authors: Travis Davies, Wentao Ma, Lihao Guo, Tengfei Ma, Xiaowen Chang, Jiafeng Xu, Shilong Wang, Yiqi Deng, Shaowen He, Xiaoqi Li, Qian Zhu, Ran Cheng, Hao Dong

Coordinating Humanoid Loco-Manipulation through Action-Conditioned Latent Foresight HumanoidEmbodied

humanoid loco-manipulation latent world-action model action-conditioned endpoint predictor temporal prior real-robot deployment

简要说明：本文提出动作条件潜在预见，一种潜在世界动作模型，通过端点预测器和时间先验评估拟议的人形机器人移动操作命令序列，在仿真和真实机器人上取得了较高的成功率。

TLDR: This paper introduces action-conditioned latent foresight, a latent world-action model that evaluates proposed humanoid loco-manipulation command sequences via an endpoint predictor and a temporal prior, achieving strong success rates in simulation and on a real robot.

Abstract: Humanoid loco-manipulation requires coordinated body motion and hand interaction over time, and a plausible-looking command sequence can still drop a held object or leave an interaction incomplete. We present action-conditioned latent foresight, a latent world-action model (WAM) that evaluates proposed command sequences before execution. An action generator proposes joint motion-hand command sequences from vision, language, and the robot state. An action-conditioned endpoint predictor estimates the visual features each sequence prefix reaches and measures progress toward a demonstration-derived subgoal, while a joint temporal prior scores temporal consistency given the robot state and preceding commands. The robot executes the first commands of the best-scoring sequence and replans from the next observation. During training, action consistency regularization reconstructs the first demonstrated command from observed and predicted feature changes, encouraging the predictor to retain action-relevant information. On ten tasks in the humanoid loco-manipulation simulation benchmark SIMPLE, our method achieves 89.7% average success, compared with 73.7% for Psi-Zero and 82.0% for DiT4DiT. On seven real-robot tasks, it achieves 85.7% under standard conditions and 65.7% under unseen object configurations, while GR00T N1.7 achieves 70.0% and 48.6%, respectively. Project page: https://ju6276.github.io/Action-Grounded-Foresight/

摘要（中文）：类人形移动操作任务要求身体运动与手部交互在时间维度上协同配合，即便指令序列在视觉上合理，仍可能导致手持物体掉落或交互动作未完整执行。我们提出了一种基于动作条件约束的潜在前瞻方法，即潜在世界-动作模型（WAM），该模型能够在执行前对候选指令序列进行评估。动作生成器基于视觉信息、语言指令及机器人状态生成关节运动与手部操作的联合指令序列。动作条件化的末端预测器估计每个序列前缀所达到的视觉特征，并衡量其朝向演示-derived子目标推进的进度，同时，联合时间先验模块结合机器人状态与先前指令对时间一致性进行评估。机器人执行评分最优序列中的前若干条指令，并从下一观测状态开始重新规划。在训练阶段，动作一致性正则化通过观测到的与实际预测的特征变化重建首条演示指令，促使预测器保留与动作相关的信息。在类人形移动操作仿真基准SIMPLE的十项任务中，我们的方法实现了89.7%的平均成功率，而Psi-Zero为73.7%，DiT4DiT为82.0%。在七项真实机器人任务中，标准条件下成功率达到85.7%，在未见过的物体配置下为65.7%，而GR00T N1.7在相应条件下分别仅为70.0%和48.6%。项目主页：https://ju6276.github.io/Action-Grounded-Foresight/

Authors: Ju Dong, Xinyu Xiao, Yiming Zhou, Tianshuo Yang, Xuerong Liu, Lei Zhang, Jian Chen, Haocheng Zhao, Yu Fu, Yujie Wei, Diwen Zheng, Alois Christian Knoll, Angela P. Schoellig, Ping Luo, Jianwei Zhang

Future Representation Distillation for Imagination-free World Action Models VLA

World Action Model representation distillation video diffusion model robot control action prediction

简要说明：DreamFree 将冻结的视频扩散世界模型的预测表示蒸馏到仅使用当前观测的编码器中，从而实现无需想象、实时的机器人动作预测。它在真实和模拟任务中优于先进的 VLA 和 WAM 基线，并能从未标注动作的视频演示中学习新任务。

TLDR: DreamFree distills the predictive representations of a frozen video diffusion world model into an encoder that uses only current observations, enabling real-time, imagination-free action prediction for robot control. It outperforms state-of-the-art VLA and WAM baselines across real and simulated tasks and can learn new tasks from video demonstrations without action labels.

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) use the predictive knowledge of pretrained video diffusion models for robot control through future video prediction. However, iterative video denoising is costly, and inaccurate visual predictions can compromise action prediction. Our key idea is to make this predictive knowledge available through visual representations computed from the current observation, enabling action prediction without generating future videos. We introduce DreamFree, a WAM that repurposes a pretrained video diffusion model as a predictive visual encoder through representation distillation. The visual encoder learns to predict a frozen video diffusion model's representation using only the current observation. An action module is then trained to predict actions by extracting action-relevant information from the visual encoder. Across real-world and simulated tasks, DreamFree achieves higher success rates than state-of-the-art VLAs and WAMs, while performing real-time closed-loop control at 11Hz with a 14B video diffusion backbone. Experiments show that DreamFree can translate stronger video priors and additional video data into better robot control and enable learning new robot tasks from video demonstrations, including videos from a different embodiment, without action annotation for the new tasks.

摘要（中文）：世界动作模型（WAMs）利用预训练视频扩散模型的预测性知识，通过未来视频预测实现机器人控制。然而，迭代式视频去噪成本高昂，且不准确的视觉预测可能损害动作预测的准确性。我们的核心思路是，通过从当前观测计算得到的视觉表征来提供这些预测性知识，从而无需生成未来视频即可实现动作预测。为此，我们提出DreamFree，一种将预训练视频扩散模型通过表征蒸馏重塑为预测性视觉编码器的WAM。该视觉编码器仅利用当前观测即可学习预测冻结的视频扩散模型的表征。随后，训练一个动作模块，通过从视觉编码器中提取与动作相关的信息来预测动作。在真实世界和模拟任务中，DreamFree均取得了比最先进的VLA和WAM更高的成功率，同时以14B视频扩散主干实现11Hz的实时闭环控制。实验表明，DreamFree能够将更强的视频先验知识和额外的视频数据转化为更好的机器人控制性能，并能从视频演示中学习新的机器人任务，包括来自不同本体的视频，且无需为新任务标注动作。

Authors: Jaehyeong Jo, Sangwon Jang, Sihyun Yu, Seonghyeon Ye, Yekyung Nah, Hojung Jung, Kimin Lee, Sung Ju Hwang

Physical Diffusion Policy via MPM-Guided 3D Gaussian Simulation Manipulation

physics-aware diffusion policy 3D Gaussian Splatting Material Point Method material property estimation Mixture-of-Experts

简要说明：该论文提出了一种物理感知的扩散策略，通过3D高斯溅射和可微物质点法仿真从视觉演示中估计材料属性，然后使用具有物理记忆库的专家混合策略来适应不同物体的操作，在仿真和真实任务中提高了成功率和泛化能力。

TLDR: This paper introduces a physics-aware diffusion policy that estimates material properties from visual demonstrations via 3D Gaussian Splatting and differentiable MPM simulation, then uses a Mixture-of-Experts policy with a physics memory bank for adaptive manipulation across diverse objects, improving success and generalization in simulated and real-world tasks.

Abstract: Learning robust manipulation policies for diverse everyday objects remains challenging because objects with different materials exhibit distinct deformation and contact dynamics. While diffusion policies provide a powerful framework for modeling multimodal manipulation behaviors, they typically lack explicit physical reasoning and may produce averaged actions when facing heterogeneous objects. We present a physics-aware diffusion policy that augments visual imitation learning with object physical understanding. Our framework recovers material properties from visual demonstrations by coupling 3D Gaussian Splatting with differentiable Material Point Method simulation, where video guidance and particle-level constraints enable accurate physical parameter estimation. The estimated physics conditions are further integrated into a material-aware Mixture-of-Experts diffusion policy, allowing adaptive behavior generation across different physical regimes. For practical deployment, we introduce a physics memory bank that provides efficient physical retrieval without requiring online simulation optimization. Experiments on a wide range of simulated and real-world objects demonstrate improved manipulation success and generalization over existing diffusion-based approaches. These results show that incorporating physical knowledge is critical for scalable robot manipulation in diverse environments.

摘要（中文）：学习针对多样化日常物体的鲁棒操控策略仍具挑战性，因为不同材料的物体表现出截然不同的形变与接触动力学特性。尽管扩散策略为多模态操控行为建模提供了强大框架，但其通常缺乏显式物理推理能力，且在面对异质物体时可能产生平均化动作。我们提出一种物理感知的扩散策略，将物体物理理解融入视觉模仿学习。该框架通过耦合三维高斯泼溅与可微物质点法仿真，从视觉演示中恢复材料属性，其中视频引导与粒子级约束实现了精确的物理参数估计。估计得到的物理条件进一步集成到材料感知的专家混合扩散策略中，从而在不同物理域间实现自适应行为生成。为便于实际部署，我们引入物理记忆库，在不需在线仿真优化的前提下提供高效物理检索。在广泛的仿真与真实世界物体上的实验表明，该方法相较于现有基于扩散的方法在操控成功率与泛化能力上均有提升。这些结果说明，融入物理知识对于在多样化环境中实现可扩展的机器人操控至关重要。

Authors: Can Wang, Qiyuan Qiao, Lei Liu, Ge Yuan, Xinhui Liu, Dong Xu

RAFT: Reasoning-Aligned Fine-Tuning Improves Robustness of VLA Post-Training VLA

reasoning-aligned fine-tuning vision-language-action models robustness low-rank adapters out-of-distribution success

简要说明：RAFT提出了一种两阶段后训练方法，先对推理注释微调低秩适配器，再冻结它们并在动作示范上训练，从而提高了VLA策略在真实和模拟机器人任务中对分布外变化的鲁棒性。

TLDR: RAFT introduces a two-stage post-training method that first fine-tunes low-rank adapters on reasoning annotations, then freezes them while training on action demonstrations, improving VLA policy robustness to out-of-distribution variations on real and simulated robot tasks.

Abstract: Adapting a generalist vision-language-action (VLA) policy to a target task with limited demonstrations can improve nominal task success while reducing robustness to variations in appearance, objects, and instructions. We introduce reasoning-aligned fine-tuning (RAFT), a two-stage post-training procedure: RAFT first trains low-rank adapters on task-relevant reasoning annotations, then freezes them while fine-tuning the policy on action demonstrations. On a physical DROID robot, RAFT achieves $75.0\%$ out-of-distribution success, compared with $27.9\%$ for plain fine-tuning; on a multi-stage bimanual YAM task, it reaches $70.0\%$ mean success, compared with $36.0\%$ for the strongest baseline. RAFT also improves success under visual, object, and instruction shifts in simulated pick-and-place and open-drawer tasks. Compared with plain fine-tuning, RAFT policies place more attention on annotated task regions and yield higher linear-probe accuracy for object identity in later layers. A broader reasoning-data mixture further improves downstream success across demonstration budgets.

摘要（中文）：将通用视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略调整至目标任务，在演示数据有限的情况下，能够提升标称任务成功率，但会降低其对外观、物体和指令变化的鲁棒性。我们提出推理对齐微调（RAFT），一种两阶段的后训练流程：RAFT首先在任务相关的推理标注上训练低秩适配器，然后将它们冻结，同时基于动作演示对策略进行微调。在物理DROID机器人上，RAFT在分布外场景中的成功率达到$75.0\%$，而普通微调仅为$27.9\%$；在多阶段双臂YAM任务中，RAFT的平均成功率为$70.0\%$，而最强基线的平均成功率为$36.0\%$。在模拟的抓取放置和抽屉开启任务中，RAFT在视觉、物体和指令变化下也提升了成功率。与普通微调相比，RAFT策略将更多注意力集中在标注的任务区域上，并在后续层中展现出更高的物体身份线性探针准确率。更广泛的推理数据混合进一步提升了不同演示预算下的下游任务成功率。

Authors: Shresth Grover, Andrey Kolobov, Dhruv Shah

AIRoA-0: Long-Horizon, Precise, Cross-Embodiment Manipulation from Handheld Data Manipulation

handheld demonstrations bimanual manipulation vision-language-action model embodiment-agnostic wrist cameras

简要说明：AIRoA-0 是一个仅基于 16,151 小时手持演示训练的双臂操作系统，无需机器人数据，在多种实体上十个任务中实现了 78% 的成功率。

TLDR: AIRoA-0 is a bimanual manipulation system trained solely on 16,151 hours of handheld demonstrations, using no robot data, and achieves 78% success on ten tasks across multiple embodiments.

Abstract: AIRoA-0 (A-0) is a bimanual manipulation system learned from 16,151 hours of handheld demonstrations, with no robot data collected at any stage. The demonstrations are recorded with YUBI, our open-source handheld gripper, which lets people record manipulation data anywhere with no robot present. From a single instruction, A-0 sorts more than a dozen small parts into their numbered cells and changes the mop pads and brush of a robot vacuum; among other tasks, it unzips a pencil case and folds a towel. It performs these tasks using only a camera on each wrist, with no head or scene camera, at a site where none of its training data was recorded. Across the ten tasks of our evaluation, it averages a success rate of 78%, against 27% for the strongest of four other vision-language-action models post-trained on the same task demonstrations. We collect no teleoperation data and use no reinforcement learning or on-robot corrections, and the robot appears only at test time. The system learns which regions of each wrist view matter for the task, predicts the stage the task has reached, and decodes actions as a continuous stream. A-0 is embodiment-agnostic: it runs on robots that mount the YUBI gripper, such as a bimanual Franka, TX-G2, OpenArm and UR. We are releasing the dataset, to our knowledge the largest open dataset of handheld-gripper demonstrations with task and subtask instructions, together with the pre-trained weights and the post-training recipe. Videos of A-0 on every task are on the project page, https://a-0.airoa.io. Anyone can build the gripper, record a task of their own and post-train the model on it in under four hours on a single node of eight H200 GPUs.

摘要（中文）：AIRoA-0（简称A-0）是一套双臂操控系统，其训练数据来自16,151小时的手持演示，且在任一阶段均未采集任何机器人数据。演示过程使用我们开源的手持夹爪YUBI进行记录，使人们能够在无机器人在场的情况下，于任何地点采集操控数据。仅凭一条指令，A-0即可将十多个小型零件分拣至对应编号的格子中，并更换扫地机器人的拖布和刷头；在其他任务中，它还能拉开笔袋拉链并折叠毛巾。执行这些任务时，A-0仅依靠各手腕上的摄像头，无头部或场景摄像头，且作业地点与其训练数据的采集地点完全无关。在我们的十项任务评估中，A-0的平均成功率达到78%，而在基于相同任务演示进行后训练的其他四种视觉-语言-动作模型中，表现最强者的平均成功率仅为27%。我们未采集任何遥操作数据，也未使用强化学习或机器人本体修正，机器人在测试阶段才首次登场。该系统能够学习每个手腕视野中对任务关键的区域，预测任务当前进展阶段，并以连续流的形式解码动作。A-0与具体 embodiment（具身形态）无关：可在任何安装了YUBI夹爪的机器人上运行，例如双臂Franka、TX-G2、OpenArm及UR。我们正在发布该数据集——据我们所知，这是目前最大的、附带任务与子任务指令的手持夹爪演示开源数据集——同时一并发布预训练权重及后训练配方。A-0在每项任务上的演示视频均可在项目页面 https://a-0.airoa.io 上查看。任何人都可以自行构建该夹爪，录制自己的任务，并在单节点8块H200 GPU上于四小时内完成对该模型的后训练。

Authors: Yueh-Hua Wu, Kei Ota, Hanlong Li, Hayata Yuasa, Jason Wang, Kengo Ikeuchi, Kensuke Chiyoma, Makoto Sugiura, Masafumi Takahashi, Masatoshi Tateno, Naoaki Kanazawa, Nicola Scianca, Petr Khrapchenkov, Satoshi Otsubo, Takehiko Ohkawa, Takuya Okubo, Tatsuya Matsushima, Yuki Noguchi, Yuma Shin, Zixuan Zhong

TAMPAgent: Agentic Belief-Space Planning for Mobile Manipulation Manipulation

mobile manipulation belief-space planning task and motion planning large vision-language model agent closed-loop execution

简要说明：本文提出TAMPAgent，一种将大视觉语言模型与任务与运动规划（TAMP）相结合的智能体规划框架，用于部分可观测环境下的移动操作，在真实机器人上显著优于直接工具调用的基线方法。

TLDR: This paper introduces TAMPAgent, an agentic planning framework that integrates LVLMs with Task and Motion Planning (TAMP) for mobile manipulation under partial observability, significantly outperforming direct tool-calling baselines on real robots.

Abstract: Open-world robotic mobile manipulation requires acting in physical environments with only partial information. While recent Large Vision-Language Model (LVLM) agents show strong open-world reasoning capabilities, existing architectures that rely on direct tool calling struggle with geometric uncertainty and thus are limited to fully-observable tabletop environments. In contrast, Task and Motion Planning (TAMP) systems can solve long-horizon tasks under partial observability but incur high computational costs and require closed worlds. We propose \textbf{TAMPAgent}, an agentic planning framework that unifies the reasoning of LVLMs with the structured constraint satisfaction of TAMP systems. We endow an LVLM agent with a belief-space planning model operating over an extensible API of perception, planning, and control tools. The agent formulates a partial task plan composed of parameterized observation and execution actions, which is subsequently completed using classical search algorithms. After extracting the plan's geometric constraints, the agent leverages its tool API to bind valid parameter values, satisfying feasibility requirements and producing an executable motion plan. Upon execution, the agent continuously updates its belief history and repeats this closed-loop process by interleaving observation and manipulation actions. Evaluated across complex household mobile manipulation tasks on Rainbow Y1 and Unitree G1 platforms, TAMPAgent significantly outperforms direct tool-calling agentic baselines, demonstrating that integrating TAMP constraint satisfaction into agentic planning loops is essential for unstructured, partially observable environments.

摘要（中文）：开放式世界中的机器人移动操作需要在仅具备部分信息的环境中执行任务。尽管近年来大型视觉-语言模型（LVLM）代理展现出强大的开放式推理能力，但现有的依赖直接工具调用的架构在几何不确定性面前表现不足，因而局限于完全可观测的桌面环境。相比之下，任务与运动规划（TAMP）系统能够在部分可观测条件下解决长时域任务，但计算成本高且需要封闭世界假设。我们提出了\textbf{TAMPAgent}，一种将LVLM的推理能力与TAMP系统的结构化约束满足相统一的代理规划框架。我们赋予LVLM代理一个基于置信空间（belief-space）的规划模型，该模型在可扩展的感知、规划与控制工具API上运行。代理首先制定一个由参数化观测和执行动作组成的部分任务计划，随后通过经典搜索算法将其补全。在提取计划的几何约束后，代理利用其工具API绑定有效的参数值，以满足可行性要求并生成可执行的运动计划。在执行过程中，代理持续更新其置信历史记录，并通过交错执行观测与操作动作来重复这一闭环过程。在Rainbow Y1和Unitree G1平台上进行的复杂家庭移动操作任务评估中，TAMPAgent显著优于直接工具调用的代理基线，表明将TAMP约束满足集成到代理规划闭环中对于非结构化、部分可观测环境至关重要。

Authors: Utkarsh A. Mishra, Alperen Degirmenci, Yongxin Chen, Danfei Xu, Tucker Hermans, Caelan Garrett

Human-to-Robot Transfer via Bridging Representation and Action Space in VLAs VLA

human-robot co-training VLA adaptation embodiment gap representation alignment action tokenizer

简要说明：H2RB 提出了一种人机协同训练框架，通过几何锚定对齐观测和分离解码器分词器共享动作潜在表示，利用不成对的人机演示来适配预训练 VLA 策略，在真实任务中显著提升了物体迁移和技能迁移性能。

TLDR: H2RB introduces a human-robot co-training framework that adapts pretrained VLA policies using unpaired human and robot demonstrations by aligning observations via geometry-anchored alignment and sharing action latents through a decoupled-decoder tokenizer, significantly improving object transfer and skill transfer on real-world tasks.

Abstract: Pretrained Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies provide a strong starting point for deployment, but adapting them to a target robot and environment still requires costly embodiment-specific demonstrations. Human demonstrations are far easier to collect, yet directly leveraging them is challenging due to the substantial human-robot embodiment gap, particularly when the underlying VLA has been pretrained primarily on robot data. We introduce H2RB (Human-To-Robot Bridge), a human-robot co-training framework for adapting pretrained VLA policies from unpaired human and robot demonstrations. H2RB bridges the embodiment gap at both interfaces: geometry-anchored alignment grounds human and robot observations in a compatible representation, while a decoupled-decoder tokenizer shares action latents without forcing both domains through a single action mapping. This design allows human demonstrations to provide useful behavioral supervision while retaining the rich visual, semantic, and control priors of the pretrained VLA. Across real-world tasks, H2RB substantially improves object transfer performance from 8.0 to 51.8 and enables skill transfer to score 62.7, in settings where co-train baselines totally fail to transfer human-demonstrated skills. The benefit also persists under object-placement shifts, improving out-of-distribution transfer from 6.0 to 45.3. H2RB suggests a way for human demonstrations to serve as a scalable supervision source for adapting pretrained robotic policies, reducing the dependence on costly target-robot data collection.

摘要（中文）：预训练视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略为部署提供了强大的起点，但将其适配到目标机器人和环境仍需大量昂贵的具身特定示范数据。人类示范数据的采集则容易得多，然而由于人机之间存在显著的具身差异，直接利用这些数据颇具挑战，尤其是当底层VLA主要基于机器人数据进行预训练时。我们提出H2RB（Human-To-Robot Bridge），一种用于从非配对的人类和机器人示范中适配预训练VLA策略的人机协同训练框架。H2RB在两端接口处弥合了具身差异：几何锚定对齐将人类和机器人的观测映射到兼容的表示空间中，而解耦解码器分词器则共享动作潜在表征，无需强制两个域通过单一动作映射。这种设计使得人类示范能够提供有效的行为监督，同时保留预训练VLA丰富的视觉、语义和控制先验。在真实世界任务中，H2RB将物体迁移性能从8.0大幅提升至51.8，并在协同训练基线完全无法迁移人类示范技能的场景下实现技能迁移得分62.7。该优势在物体放置位置偏移的情况下依然保持，将分布外迁移性能从6.0提升至45.3。H2RB表明，人类示范可以作为适配预训练机器人策略的可扩展监督来源，从而减少对昂贵的目标机器人数据采集的依赖。

Authors: Junhyeong Park, Wook Jung, Taeyoung Kim, Huiwon Jang, Jinwoo Shin

WayTrace: A Map-to-Language-to-Trace Hierarchy for Embodied Urban Navigation VLA

embodied urban navigation vision-language model trace prediction reinforcement learning policy wheeled-legged robot

简要说明：WayTrace 是一个用于具身城市导航的层级系统，利用视觉语言模型将网络地图方向转换为原子语言指令，通过轨迹预测器生成视觉路径，并由强化学习策略进行跟踪，在仿真和真实世界中实现了鲁棒的远距离导航。

TLDR: WayTrace is a hierarchical system for embodied urban navigation that uses a vision-language model to convert web-map directions into atomic language commands, a trace predictor to generate visual paths, and a reinforcement learning policy to track them, achieving robust long-range navigation in simulations and real-world deployments.

Abstract: Web services provide walking directions for nearly every city, but following them reliably over long routes remains challenging for autonomous robots. Point-goal navigation policies rely heavily on accurate GNSS, while most vision-language navigation models struggle to execute even short instructions outdoors. We present WayTrace, a hierarchical system that connects web-map directions to robot motion through language. An off-the-shelf orchestrator vision-language model reads the turn-by-turn directions, a satellite map and recent camera images, and issues one atomic language command at a time, such as "cross the road to the left". An onboard trace predictor, trained on over one million automatically labelled samples from street-level images, draws the path for this command in the image, and a reinforcement learning policy tracks it. In long-range simulated missions, WayTrace remains robust to GNSS noise and rarely leaves crosswalks or sidewalks, while point-goal baselines degrade sharply with about ten times more violations. Deployed on a wheeled-legged robot, WayTrace completes real-world missions of up to 1.37 km at about 1.1 m/s through a busy city centre, rural trails and a university campus, handling crosswalks, staircases and construction sites. Project page: https://way-trace.github.io

摘要（中文）：Web服务几乎为每个城市都提供了步行导航路线，但自主机器人在长距离路线上可靠地遵循这些路线仍然是一项挑战。点目标导航策略严重依赖精确的GNSS，而大多数视觉-语言导航模型即使在户外执行简短指令时也表现不佳。我们提出了WayTrace，一个通过语言将网络地图导航与机器人运动连接起来的分层系统。一个现成的编排视觉-语言模型读取逐向导航指令、卫星地图和最近的摄像头图像，并一次发出一个原子语言命令，例如“向左过马路”。一个车载轨迹预测器，在超过一百万个从街景图像自动标注的样本上训练，在图像中绘制该命令的路径，并由一个强化学习策略跟踪该路径。在远程模拟任务中，WayTrace对GNSS噪声保持鲁棒性，很少偏离人行横道或人行道，而点目标基线方法则性能急剧下降，违规次数约为其十倍。部署在轮腿式机器人上，WayTrace在繁忙的市中心、乡村小径和大学校园中完成了长达1.37公里的真实世界任务，速度约为1.1米/秒，能够应对人行横道、楼梯和建筑工地。项目页面：https://way-trace.github.io

Authors: Manthan Patel, Jonas Frey, Pascal Roth, Marco Hutter, Cesar Cadena

LoopQ: Fair, Closed-Loop Evaluation of Quantized Vision-Language-Action Models VLA

post-training quantization closed-loop benchmark vision-language-action models LIBERO RTN

简要说明：LoopQ 是一个用于评估 VLA 模型后训练量化方法的闭环基准，发现通用量化基线优于 VLA 专用方法，且标准 LIBERO 基准掩盖了 LIBERO-plus 扰动所揭示的性能损失。

TLDR: LoopQ is a closed-loop benchmark for evaluating PTQ methods on VLA models, finding that generic quantization baselines outperform VLA-specific methods, and that standard LIBERO benchmarks mask performance losses revealed by LIBERO-plus perturbations.

Abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) for vision-language-action (VLA) models promises smaller and faster VLA deployments. However, when analyzing existing VLA quantization works, we realised that it is hard to reason about the performance of the suggested quantization method compared to existing, similar, or in many cases, simpler PTQ methods. We present LoopQ, a closed-loop benchmark that compares multiple quantization policies on the same checkpoint, layers and engine, varying only the method and the kernels. We evaluate RTN, AWQ, GPTQ, ActQuant and QuantVLA on four VLAs with more than 180,000 episodes of LIBERO and LIBERO-plus, compare against QVLA's reported results on the same layers, and benchmark whether the four public VLA-quantization releases can be reproduced. We benchmark the methods on an NVIDIA H100, an L4, and a Jetson AGX Thor. Our results show that while quantization reliably saves memory, 2-3x for real low-bit models, VLA-specific PTQ methods underperform compared to simpler generic baselines. At 4 bits, RTN, AWQ and GPTQ match or exceed ActQuant and QuantVLA, plain RTN matches the calibrated methods, and plain AWQ matches the success QVLA reports for itself. Standard LIBERO hides the losses that do exist: configurations with no significant LIBERO loss lose 1.5-4.3 points under paired LIBERO-plus perturbations. Speed is a weaker story. At batch 1 on the H100, no quantized pi0.5 or OpenVLA-OFT configuration is faster than its 16-bit model (1.06-1.58x slower on library kernels); only the L4 with int8 kernels gains (4-14%), the Thor is slower on every 4-bit configuration, and the engine alone changes latency by 2.1x. Profiling explains why: pi0.5's quantized backbone is compute-bound, while its memory-bound action expert, 63% of GPU time and 13% of the parameters, stays in 16 bits.

摘要（中文）：后训练量化（PTQ）在视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型中的应用有望实现更小、更快的VLA部署。然而，在分析现有VLA量化工作时，我们发现，与已有的、类似的，或在许多情况下更简单的PTQ方法相比，很难评估所提出的量化方法的性能。我们提出了LoopQ，一个闭环基准测试，在相同的检查点、层和引擎上比较多种量化策略，仅改变方法和内核。我们在包含超过180，000条LIBERO和LIBERO-plus轨迹的四个VLA上评估了RTN、AWQ、GPTQ、ActQuant和QuantVLA，并与QVLA在同一层上报告的结果进行了比较，同时验证了四个公开的VLA量化发布是否可复现。我们在NVIDIA H100、L4和Jetson AGX Thor上对这些方法进行了基准测试。我们的结果表明，虽然量化能够可靠地节省内存（对于真正的低比特模型可节省2-3倍），但VLA特定的PTQ方法在性能上不如更简单的通用基线。在4比特下，RTN、AWQ和GPTQ达到或超过了ActQuant和QuantVLA，普通RTN与经过校准的方法表现相当，而普通AWQ则达到了QVLA报告的成功水平。标准LIBERO掩盖了实际存在的损失：在配对LIBERO-plus扰动下，没有显著LIBERO损失的配置损失了1.5-4.3个百分点。速度方面的结论则较弱。在H100上的批大小为1时，没有量化的pi0.5或OpenVLA-OFT配置比其16位模型更快（在库内核上慢1.06-1.58倍）；只有L4上的int8内核有增益（4-14%），Thor在每种4位配置下都更慢，且仅引擎变化就会导致延迟差异达2.1倍。性能分析解释了原因：pi0.5的量化骨干网络是计算受限的，而其内存受限的动作专家（占GPU时间的63%，参数量的13%）仍保持在16位。

Authors: Syed Umer Bukhari, Magnus Almgren, Ahmed Ali-Eldin

CRONOS: Benchmarking Non-Episodic Reinforcement Learning for Robotic Manipulation VLA

non-episodic RL VLA fine-tuning robotic manipulation simulation benchmark long-horizon

简要说明：CRONOS 是一个用于机器人操作中非情节强化学习微调视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的仿真基准，揭示了长时程任务和泛化中的挑战及解决方案。

TLDR: CRONOS is a simulation benchmark for non-episodic RL fine-tuning of vision-language-action (VLA) models in robotic manipulation, revealing challenges and solutions for long-horizon tasks and generalization.

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is promising for adapting robot policies to unstructured real-world environments. However, standard RL pipelines rely on episodic training with frequent scene resets, which is impractical for real-world deployment due to the need for substantial human intervention. While prior work has studied non-episodic RL in relatively small policies trained from scratch, its behavior when fine-tuning modern large-scale pre-trained vision-language-action (VLA) models remains underexplored. In this work, we introduce CRONOS, a simulation benchmark for RL fine-tuning of VLAs under non-episodic scene resets. CRONOS leverages high-fidelity physics simulators and adopts shared-scene multi-task settings. Using CRONOS, we show that naively fine-tuning pre-trained policies fails in non-episodic settings due to shifts in object configurations and end-effector poses; however, these challenges can be mitigated through targeted reset allocation and by addressing biases in pre-trained models. Moreover, we find that non-episodic training enhances long-horizon manipulation and improves generalization to previously unseen object configurations and task sequences. Project page: https://embodiedai-ntu.github.io/cronos/

摘要（中文）：强化学习在将机器人策略适应非结构化真实世界环境方面展现出巨大潜力。然而，标准强化学习流程依赖于频繁场景重置的分幕式训练，这在真实世界部署中因需要大量人工干预而难以实际应用。尽管已有研究在从零训练的小规模策略中探索了非分幕式强化学习，但其在微调现代大规模预训练视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型时的行为仍缺乏充分研究。为此，本文提出CRONOS——一个用于非分幕式场景重置下VLA模型强化学习微调的仿真基准。CRONOS利用高保真物理仿真器，并采用共享场景多任务设置。基于CRONOS，我们发现直接微调预训练策略在非分幕式设置中会因物体构型与末端执行器位姿的变化而失败；然而，通过有针对性的重置分配及修正预训练模型中的偏差，这些挑战可以得到缓解。此外，我们发现非分幕式训练能够增强长时程操作能力，并提升对未见物体构型与任务序列的泛化性能。项目主页：https://embodiedai-ntu.github.io/cronos/

Authors: Po-Yi Wu, Djengo Cyun-Jyun Fang, Dian Cheng, Tsung-Wei Ke

Trajectory Evaluation via Rollout-Free World Model for End-to-end Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

rollout-free world model trajectory evaluation end-to-end autonomous driving shared scene memory spatial readout

简要说明：本文提出了RFWorld，一种用于端到端自动驾驶的无回滚世界模型，通过直接查询共享场景记忆来评估候选轨迹，降低了推理成本并避免了递归预测误差，在NAVSIM和Bench2Drive上取得了最先进的性能。

TLDR: This paper introduces RFWorld, a rollout-free world model for end-to-end autonomous driving that evaluates candidate trajectories by directly querying a shared scene memory, reducing inference cost and avoiding recursive prediction errors while achieving state-of-the-art performance on NAVSIM and Bench2Drive.

Abstract: Although existing candidate trajectory evaluators have substantially improved end-to-end planning accuracy, their underlying mechanism remains suboptimal. Model-based evaluators typically make scoring future-aware by explicitly predicting candidate-conditioned future states over the planning horizon, which we term rollout. However, rollout incurs high inference cost and accumulates prediction errors. We argue that planning does not require reconstructing a full future scene for each candidate, but only future-relevant information for reliable comparison. We therefore propose RFWorld, a Rollout-Free World model for end-to-end trajectory evaluation. RFWorld constructs a shared scene memory and shapes it into a future-readable representation via lightweight training-time temporal readout with semantic supervision, keeping training overhead low. At inference time, candidate trajectories directly query the shared memory via sparse spatial readout for scoring, reducing computation by roughly the planning horizon times the number of candidate trajectories, while avoiding recursive rollout errors. Experiments on NAVSIM and Bench2Drive show that RFWorld learns a more planning-aligned world representation and achieves state-of-the-art performance.

摘要（中文）：虽然现有的候选轨迹评估器已显著提升了端到端规划精度，但其底层机制仍存在次优问题。基于模型的评估器通常通过在规划时域内显式预测候选条件化的未来状态来使评分具备前瞻性，我们称之为展开（rollout）。然而，展开不仅带来高昂的推理成本，还会累积预测误差。我们认为，规划并不需要为每个候选重构完整的未来场景，而只需提取与未来相关的信息以进行可靠比较。为此，我们提出RFWorld，一种无展开（Rollout-Free）的端到端轨迹评估世界模型。RFWorld构建共享场景记忆，并通过轻量级训练时的时间读取与语义监督将其塑造为可读的未来表示，从而保持较低的训练开销。在推理阶段，候选轨迹通过稀疏空间读取直接查询共享记忆以进行评分，计算量约减少为规划时域乘以候选轨迹数量的规模，同时避免了递归展开误差。在NAVSIM和Bench2Drive上的实验表明，RFWorld学习到更贴合规划的世界表示，并取得了最先进的性能。

Authors: Junzhe Wang, Jinqing Zhang, Qingjie Liu

Do Agentic Policies Need to Look at Every Step? Geometric Abstraction for Reasoning and Action Manipulation

geometric abstraction manipulation policy grounded text and symbols multimodal language models RGB-D grounding

简要说明：本文提出使用带有符号引用和度量残差的3D几何抽象代替原始图像用于机器人策略，在减少多模态查询的同时提升多步操作性能。

TLDR: This paper proposes using a 3D geometric abstraction with symbolic references and metric residuals instead of raw images for robot policies, improving multi-step manipulation while reducing multimodal queries.

Abstract: Recent multimodal language models can reason directly about robot scenes, but it is unclear whether they need to repeatedly reinterpret raw visual observations at every step of an interaction. We propose shifting routine spatial reasoning from images to text and symbols through a 3D geometric abstraction that is refreshed locally from observations and read directly by the language models. Specifically, our interface represents scene geometry via typed, evidence-aware symbolic references to object parts, grounds them from calibrated RGB-D, and returns compact textual checkpoints with metric residuals after each action. Symbolic task structure can thus be reused across decisions while metric values are rebound to the current scene, with direct visual reasoning invoked only on demand. Across offline policy synthesis and continuous online execution, reasoning over grounded text and symbols improves multi-step manipulation completion while substantially reducing repeated multimodal queries, positioning explicit geometric state as an effective substrate for agentic robot policies.

摘要（中文）：近期出现的多模态语言模型能够直接对机器人场景进行推理，但其是否需要在交互的每一步中反复重新解读原始视觉观察数据，目前尚不明确。我们提出将常规空间推理从图像转向文本与符号，通过一种从观测中局部刷新、并由语言模型直接读取的三维几何抽象来实现。具体而言，我们的接口通过类型化、具备证据感知的符号引用表示对象部件的场景几何结构，基于校准后的RGB-D数据对其进行 grounding，并在每次动作后返回带有度量残差的紧凑文本检查点。由此，符号任务结构可在多次决策间复用，而度量值则重新绑定至当前场景，仅在需要时按需调用直接视觉推理。在离线策略合成与连续在线执行过程中，基于已 grounding 的文本与符号进行推理，能够提升多步操作任务的完成度，同时显著减少重复的多模态查询次数，从而将显式几何状态确立为智能体化机器人策略的有效基础。

Authors: Yihang Liu, Yiming Chen, Mingzhe Zheng

DRAP: Dynamics-Risk Adaptive Plasticity for Continual Learning in Physical AI VLA

continual learning Dynamics-Risk Adaptive Plasticity OpenVLA LIBERO perturbation amplification

简要说明：本文提出 DRAP，一种无回放的物理AI持续学习方法，通过风险加权重要性调整张量级学习率，抑制扰动放大，在 LIBERO 套件上连续微调 OpenVLA 时显著提升旧任务保留能力。

TLDR: This paper introduces DRAP, a replay-free continual learning method for physical AI that uses risk-weighted importance to adapt tensor-level learning rates, improving retention in sequential OpenVLA fine-tuning on LIBERO suites by limiting perturbation amplification.

Abstract: Continual learning in physical AI differs from conventional continual learning because small per-step policy errors can accumulate over a trajectory. Each deviation may move the agent outside the training distribution, increase subsequent prediction errors, and ultimately cause closed-loop task failure. This work introduces Dynamics-Risk Adaptive Plasticity (DRAP), a replay-free method that estimates the historical importance of adaptable model tensors from sample-level action gradients weighted by local trajectory-amplification risk. A ridge-regularized local linear model is fitted to expert state-action transitions, and the largest singular value of its state-transition matrix provides a policy-independent, Lyapunov-inspired estimate of one-step perturbation amplification. After each task, risk-weighted squared gradients are accumulated in a tensor-level importance memory. During subsequent tasks, DRAP uses normalized cumulative importance to scale the effective AdamW learning rate of each tensor, immediately reducing the plasticity of components that supported previous behavior at dynamically sensitive trajectory points. We instantiate DRAP on a fixed KappaTune-selected subnetwork of OpenVLA and evaluate replay-free sequential adaptation across the LIBERO Spatial, Object, and Goal suites. Compared with standard AdamW fine-tuning and EWC, the results show substantially improved retention of previously learned behaviors while preserving strong new-suite acquisition.

摘要（中文）：物理AI中的持续学习不同于传统持续学习，因为每一步较小的策略误差可能会在轨迹中累积。每次偏差都可能使智能体偏离训练分布，增加后续预测误差，并最终导致闭环任务失败。本工作引入了动力学风险自适应可塑性（DRAP），这是一种无需回放的方法，通过由局部轨迹放大风险加权的样本级动作梯度来估计可调整模型张量的历史重要性。该方法将岭正则化的局部线性模型拟合到专家状态-动作转换上，其状态转换矩阵的最大奇异值提供了与策略无关的、受李雅普诺夫启发的单步扰动放大估计。在每个任务之后，风险加权的平方梯度累积在张量级重要性记忆中。在后续任务中，DRAP使用归一化的累积重要性来缩放每个张量的有效AdamW学习率，从而立即降低在动态敏感轨迹点上支持先前行为的组件的可塑性。我们在固定的KappaTune选择的OpenVLA子网络上实例化DRAP，并评估跨LIBERO空间、物体和目标套件的无回放顺序适应性能。与标准AdamW微调和EWC相比，结果表明在保持新套件强获取能力的同时，对先前学习行为的保留有了显著提升。

Authors: Oswaldo Ludwig

HiLo-WAM: Decoupling Long-Horizon Task Evolution and Local Dynamics in World Action Models Manipulation

World Action Models long-horizon manipulation dual-DiT cross-stream attention progressive inference

简要说明：HiLo-WAM 通过双DiT架构解耦了世界动作模型中的长期任务演化和局部视觉动态，提升了长时程机器人操作性能与计算效率。

TLDR: HiLo-WAM decouples long-horizon task evolution from local visual dynamics in World Action Models using a dual-DiT architecture, improving long-horizon robotic manipulation performance and computational efficiency.

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) improve robotic manipulation by jointly modeling visual dynamics and robot actions. However, most existing WAMs model dense short-horizon visual dynamics, capturing local interactions but providing limited long-range task context. Extending prediction horizons increases uncertainty and computation while entangling task-level evolution with fine-grained local dynamics, obscuring their dependencies and distinct roles in action generation. We propose HiLo-WAM, which decouples long-horizon task evolution from local visual dynamics while jointly modeling their interaction with robot actions. A sparse long-horizon visual stream captures historical task context and future evolution, while a dense local dynamics visual stream models short-horizon robot-object interactions. The two streams operate at different temporal scales within a unified dual-DiT architecture and guide actions through structured cross-stream attention. Progressive inference further reduces unnecessary computation through stream-wise partial denoising, joint denoising, and dynamic skipping. Experiments demonstrate strong long-horizon manipulation performance: HiLo-WAM achieves a 93.70% average success rate on RoboTwin 2.0 and a 17.43 progress score on RoboDojo long-horizon tasks, with robust in-domain and OOD performance on the Fourier GR-3 robot. Ablations confirm the complementary contributions of long-horizon task evolution and local interaction dynamics, while temporal-scale analyses highlight the importance of balancing temporal coverage and resolution. Progressive inference further achieves a 2.93x speedup while improving performance.

摘要（中文）：世界动作模型（WAMs）通过联合建模视觉动态与机器人动作来提升机器人操作能力。然而，现有的大多数WAMs对密集的短时域视觉动态进行建模，虽然能够捕捉局部交互，但提供的长程任务上下文有限。延长预测时域会增加不确定性和计算开销，同时将任务层面的演化与细粒度的局部动态纠缠在一起，从而模糊了它们在动作生成中的依赖关系及各自角色。我们提出HiLo-WAM，将长时域任务演化与局部视觉动态解耦，同时联合建模它们与机器人动作之间的交互。一条稀疏的长时域视觉流捕捉历史任务上下文与未来演化，而一条密集的局部动态视觉流则建模短时域的机器人-物体交互。两条流在统一的双DiT架构中以不同的时间尺度运行，并通过结构化的跨流注意力引导动作生成。渐进式推理通过流级部分去噪、联合去噪和动态跳步进一步减少不必要的计算。实验证明了强大的长时域操作性能：HiLo-WAM在RoboTwin 2.0上达到93.70%的平均成功率，在RoboDojo长时域任务上取得17.43的进度分数，并在Fourier GR-3机器人上展现出稳健的域内和域外性能。消融实验证实了长时域任务演化与局部交互动态的互补贡献，而时间尺度分析则强调了平衡时间覆盖范围与分辨率的重要性。渐进式推理进一步实现了2.93倍的加速，同时提升了性能。

Authors: Xingyu Wang, Yanjiang Guo, Zhijing Ding, Jiaxin Fang, Zeyu Lai, Jiayu Dong, Weikang Wan, Jianyu Chen, Yuxiang Gao, Mengdi Xu

LLMs as MDP Designers: A Dependency-Aware Agentic Framework for Automated Robot Policy Generation RLRobot

LLM MDP robot policy RL Isaac Sim

简要说明：该论文提出了ARPG，一种依赖感知的智能体框架，利用LLM从自然语言任务描述中自动生成可执行的机器人强化学习策略，在Isaac Sim中提高了MDP制定和模拟器实现的效率。

TLDR: This paper introduces ARPG, a dependency-aware agentic framework that uses LLMs to automate the generation of executable robot RL policies from natural-language task descriptions, improving MDP formulation and simulator implementation in Isaac Sim.

Abstract: We investigate the automated generation of executable robot reinforcement learning (RL) policies from natural-language task descriptions. Rather than using large language models (LLMs) as execution-time decision makers, we use them as designers that construct RL pipelines before deployment, including Markov decision process (MDP) formulation and simulator implementation. We identify a phase-wise structure in this problem: MDP formulation is dependency-structured and sequential, whereas simulator implementation becomes modular once the formulation is fixed. Based on this structure, we propose ARPG, a dependency-aware agentic framework that performs sequential MDP modeling, localized verification and correction, and simulator-structured implementation while externalizing intermediate artifacts. ARPG targets a key failure mode of automated policy generation: executable code may still yield non-learnable policies when state, action, reward, and termination artifacts are not semantically aligned. Experiments in Isaac Sim show that ARPG improves modeling correctness, environment executability, and policy-generation success compared with monolithic LLM baselines and off-the-shelf agentic systems. Additional demonstrations on custom robotics, standard RL, and engineering-domain MDPs further suggest that the same modeling pipeline can be reused beyond the main benchmark suite.

摘要（中文）：我们研究了从自然语言任务描述中自动生成可执行的机器人强化学习（RL）策略的问题。我们并未将大型语言模型（LLMs）用作执行时的决策者，而是将其用作设计者，在部署前构建RL流水线，包括马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）的制定与仿真器实现。我们在此问题中识别出一种分阶段的结构：MDP制定具有依赖关系结构且是顺序性的，而一旦制定完成，仿真器实现则变得模块化。基于这一结构，我们提出了ARPG，一种依赖感知的智能体框架，该框架执行顺序式MDP建模、局部验证与修正，以及面向仿真器结构的实现，同时将中间产物外部化。ARPG针对自动策略生成中的一个关键失败模式：当状态、动作、奖励和终止条件等组件在语义上不一致时，即使代码可执行，所产生的策略也可能无法学习。在Isaac Sim中的实验表明，与整体式LLM基线及现成的智能体系统相比，ARPG在建模正确性、环境可执行性和策略生成成功率方面均有提升。此外，在定制机器人、标准RL及工程领域MDP上的额外演示进一步表明，相同的建模流水线可在主基准套件之外复用。

Authors: Hong Je-Gal, Jinwoo Kim, Chanbin Yi, Hyun-Suk Lee

Caging Vision-Language Navigation for Legged Robots via Barrier-Certified Safety Architecture VLA

Vision-Language Navigation VLA Barrier Function SDF Legged Robots

简要说明：本文提出了一种模块化安全架构，将高层VLA规划器与低层物理接地和屏障认证约束相结合，实现腿式机器人的安全视觉语言导航。

TLDR: This paper presents a modular safety architecture that combines a high-level VLA planner with low-level physical grounding and barrier-certified constraints for safe vision-language navigation of legged robots.

Abstract: By harnessing the inherent commonsense capabilities of pretrained Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision-Language Models (VLMs), current Vision-Language Action(VLA) models for legged robots excel at interpreting language-based navigation commands but lack the physical grounding and explicit safety assurance required for real-world operation. Therefore, this paper aims to cage Legged-Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) through a safety architecture that provides physical grounding and ensures navigation safety. The key idea is not to abandon the powerful capabilities of end-to-end VLA planning, but rather to augment and cage them. In particular, we integrate a high-level VLA planner with a low-level physical-grounding layer that leverages efficient state estimation, in-situ 3D spatial perception, and an Signed Distance Field (SDF) representation to generate executable trajectories. We provide a navigation planner with provable collision-avoidance guarantees under the stated assumptions by combining a low-dimensional Bezier-parameterized MPPI planner with Discrete Exponential Barrier Function (dEBF) constraints. The proposed Legged-VLN system is modular, making it compatible with various VLM/VLA models and agnostic to the robot platform. The proposed system is validated with extensive real-world experiments on humanoid and quadrupedal robots, demonstrating versatile, efficient, and safe vision-language driven navigation capabilities.

摘要（中文）：通过利用预训练大语言模型（LLMs）和视觉-语言模型（VLMs）固有的常识能力，当前用于腿式机器人的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在解释基于语言的导航指令方面表现出色，但缺乏实际物理约束和明确的安全保障，难以满足现实世界操作需求。因此，本文旨在通过一种提供物理约束并确保导航安全的安全架构，对腿式视觉-语言导航（VLN）进行笼络约束。核心思想并非放弃端到端VLA规划的强大能力，而是对其进行增强和约束。具体而言，我们将高层VLA规划器与低层物理约束层相结合，后者利用高效状态估计、原位三维空间感知和符号距离场（SDF）表示来生成可执行轨迹。通过将低维贝塞尔参数化MPPI规划器与离散指数障碍函数（dEBF）约束相结合，我们为导航规划器提供了在所述假设下具有可证明的避碰保证。所提出的腿式VLN系统采用模块化设计，兼容多种VLM/VLA模型，且与机器人平台无关。该系统在仿人机器人和四足机器人上进行了广泛的实际实验验证，展示了多才多艺、高效且安全的视觉-语言驱动导航能力。

Authors: Abhijeet M. Kulkarni, Saimouli Katragadda, Yuze Du, Zijun Sha, Guoquan Huang

Safeguarding Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Connected and Automated Vehicles with Recursively Feasible Control Barrier Functions AutonomousDriving

Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Control Barrier Functions Safety Filter Connected and Automated Vehicles Recursive Feasibility

简要说明：本文提出备份地平线控制屏障函数（BH-CBF），为联网自动驾驶车辆的多智能体强化学习提供递归可行性与精确几何安全保证，并在真实环岛和路口高密度仿真中验证无碰撞性能。

TLDR: This paper proposes Backup-Horizon Control Barrier Functions (BH-CBF) to provide recursive feasibility and exact geometry for safe MARL coordination of connected and automated vehicles, validating collision-free performance in dense real-world roundabout and intersection simulations.

Abstract: Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) shows promise in coordinating connected and automated vehicles but offers no safety guarantee. Although Control Barrier Functions (CBFs) can add this guarantee, their optimization problem can become infeasible in practice due to control bounds. Moreover, they often overapproximate vehicle and road geometry, which makes them conservative. This paper proposes the Backup-Horizon CBF (BH-CBF), which evaluates safety along a horizon until all vehicles stop. BH-CBF is recursively feasible under control bounds, and it considers the exact vehicle and road geometry. Based on BH-CBF, we derive a fully decentralized safety filter that only needs a single broadcast of vehicle states and routes per step and stays real-time in dense traffic. We use BH-CBF to safeguard a MARL policy over its life cycle: as a reward during pre-training, as a run-time filter at deployment, and as a filter in the training loop that keeps fine-tuning on unseen maps collision-free. In simulations on real-world maps of a roundabout and an intersection, BH-CBF avoids all collisions of unsafe MARL policies and keeps its safety guarantee at every step. Existing filters either collide, lose the guarantee, or fall back to full braking far more often. In recorded roundabout traffic with 1264 human-driven vehicles over 115 km, our safeguarded policies shorten the median travel time by 14% compared with the human drivers, without any collision.

摘要（中文）：多智能体强化学习（MARL）在协调网联自动驾驶车辆方面展现出潜力，但无法提供安全保障。尽管控制障碍函数（CBF）能够增加这一保障，但在实际应用中，由于控制约束的存在，其优化问题可能变得不可行。此外，它们常常过度近似车辆和道路几何形状，导致保守性过强。本文提出了备份时域控制障碍函数（BH-CBF），该函数在直至所有车辆停止的时域内评估安全性。BH-CBF在控制约束下具有递归可行性，并考虑精确的车辆和道路几何形状。基于BH-CBF，我们推导出一种完全分散的安全滤波器，该滤波器仅需每步广播一次车辆状态和路线，即可在密集交通中保持实时性。我们使用BH-CBF在其整个生命周期内保障MARL策略的安全：在预训练阶段作为奖励，在部署阶段作为运行时滤波器，并在训练循环中作为滤波器，确保在未见地图上的微调过程无碰撞。在真实世界地图的环岛和交叉口仿真中，BH-CBF避免了所有不安全MARL策略的碰撞，并在每一步保持其安全保证。现有滤波器要么发生碰撞，要么丧失保证，要么远更频繁地退化为完全制动。在记录的包含1264辆人类驾驶车辆、总行驶里程115公里的环岛交通中，我们的受保障策略相比人类驾驶员将中位旅行时间缩短了14%，且未发生任何碰撞。

Authors: Jianye Xu, Yousef Sayed, Bassam Alrifaee

Trusting Imagined Futures: Auditing Imagined Rewards for VLA Post-Training VLA

vision-language-action models world model reward auditing offline supervision selection post-training

简要说明：TIF 是一种离线监督选择方法，通过执行反馈审计视频世界模型的预测奖励，以改进 VLA 后训练，在 LIBERO 模拟和真实机器人视频选择中取得了更高的成功率。

TLDR: TIF is an offline supervision selection method that audits predicted rewards from a video world model against execution feedback to improve VLA post-training, achieving higher success rates in LIBERO simulations and real-robot video selection.

Abstract: Video world models enable candidate actions to be evaluated through imagined outcomes, but high predicted rewards can favor trajectories with poor execution quality. We introduce Trusting Imagined Futures (TIF), an offline supervision selection method for vision-language-action (VLA) post-training that audits predicted rewards using execution feedback. A multidimensional reward model predicts a utility score for candidate ranking and five dimensions of execution quality. An auditor uses reward predictions and uncertainty to identify overestimation patterns learned from paired imagined videos and real executions. TIF accepts the candidate with the highest predicted utility when its advantage over the existing trajectory exceeds a margin and its audit risk passes a threshold; otherwise, it retains the existing supervision. The retained real trajectories then supervise behavior cloning. Across four LIBERO suites and three training seeds, TIF achieves a mean success rate of 76.25%, improving over training on the existing trajectories by 3.00 percentage points with the same trajectory count and training budget. Adding audit gating yields 1.47 percentage points with the reward model and advantage margin held fixed. The gains persist against advantage ranking and logistic regression risk selection at matched replacement counts. On recorded videos from three real robot tasks, TIF increases clean completion among selected trajectories from 58.33% to 70.00% across 60 candidate pools.

摘要（中文）：视频世界模型能够通过想象的结果来评估候选动作，但高预测奖励可能会偏向执行质量较差的轨迹。我们引入了“信任想象未来”（TIF），这是一种用于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）后训练的离线监督选择方法，利用执行反馈来审查预测奖励。一个多维奖励模型预测一个用于候选排序的效用分数，以及五个维度的执行质量。审计者利用奖励预测和不确定性来识别从配对的想象视频和真实执行中学到的过估计模式。当候选方案的预测效用相较于现有轨迹的优势超过一定阈值，且其审计风险通过阈值时，TIF会接受该候选方案；否则，保留现有的监督。保留的真实轨迹随后用于监督行为克隆。在四个LIBERO套件和三种训练种子下，TIF实现了76.25%的平均成功率，相比在相同轨迹数量和训练预算下，对现有轨迹的训练提升了3.00个百分点。在固定奖励模型和优势阈值的情况下，加入审计门控进一步提升了1.47个百分点。在匹配的替换次数下，相较于仅靠优势排序和逻辑回归风险选择，TIF的提升依然保持。在三个真实机器人任务的记录视频中，TIF在60个候选池中将所选轨迹的干净完成率从58.33%提升至70.00%。

Authors: Zicheng Kong, Zhenbo Xu, Haoyan Zhang, Jinghan Yang, Zhenzhen Li, Yiwei Ru, Liuyu Xiang, WanTing Xu, Min Ren, Zhaofeng He

Cycle WAM: Coupling Action and Video through Cycle Consistency WorldModel

world action models cycle consistency forward dynamics inverse dynamics video-action co-training

简要说明：本文提出Cycle WAM，通过双向转换和循环一致性目标将动作与视频模态耦合，改进世界动作模型，在LIBERO-Pro和DROID上取得最优性能。

TLDR: This paper introduces Cycle WAM, a training framework that couples action and video modalities through bidirectional conversion and cycle-consistency objectives to improve world action models, achieving state-of-the-art results on LIBERO-Pro and DROID.

Abstract: Recent advances in video modeling have driven substantial progress in world action models (WAMs). Existing approaches exploit pretrained video priors by decoding actions from latent representations or inferring them from generated videos. The underlying link is causal: robot actions produce changes in the scene, and video observations of these changes provide evidence for inferring the actions that produced them. However, existing training formulations do not by themselves ensure that actions and their predicted visual consequences are consistent, potentially limiting the use of pretrained capabilities. We treat video and action as paired modalities linked by this causal relationship and learn their correspondence through a unified training framework designed to better exploit pretrained video priors. Cycle WAM first augments video-action co-training with bidirectional conversion to reinforce cross-modal correspondence and recover forward and inverse dynamics. It then introduces a differentiable cycle-reconstruction objective to further couple the two mappings. The resulting model supports both forward and inverse dynamics, with the potential to improve performance through more effective use of pretrained video priors. Cycle WAM achieves state-of-the-art performance among comparable methods on LIBERO-Pro and substantially improves DreamZero on DROID. Comparisons with UWM characterize its inverse-dynamics performance and show sharper visual detail in the displayed forward-dynamics predictions.

摘要（中文）：视频建模领域的最新进展推动了世界动作模型（WAMs）的显著进步。现有方法通过从潜在表示中解码动作或从生成的视频中推断动作，来利用预训练的视频先验。其内在联系是因果性的：机器人动作引起场景变化，而这些变化的视频观测为推断产生这些变化的动作提供了证据。然而，现有的训练形式本身并不能确保动作与其预测的视觉结果之间的一致性，这可能限制了预训练能力的利用。我们将视频和动作视为由这种因果关系联系起来的配对模态，并通过一个旨在更好利用预训练视频先验的统一训练框架来学习它们之间的对应关系。Cycle WAM首先通过双向转换增强视频-动作联合训练，以强化跨模态对应关系并恢复前向和逆向动力学。随后，它引入了一个可微分的循环重建目标，进一步耦合这两个映射。所得模型同时支持前向和逆向动力学，并有望通过更有效地利用预训练视频先验来提升性能。Cycle WAM在LIBERO-Pro上达到了同类方法中最先进的性能，并在DROID上显著改进了DreamZero。与UWM的比较表征了其逆向动力学性能，并在展示的前向动力学预测中显示出更清晰的视觉细节。

Authors: Qinglin Yang, Jiepeng Wang, Yuxing Huang, Haibin Huang, Kai Xu, Chi Zhang, Ruizhen Hu, Xuelong Li

Action Intent as a Bridge: Transferring Manipulation Knowledge from Human-Centric Videos to Robots VLA

action intent human-centric videos knowledge transfer robotic manipulation VLA models

简要说明：AIT 是一种两阶段方法，通过提取并对齐干净的动作意图表示，将人类视频中的操作知识迁移到机器人，在仿真和真实机器人上均优于先前基线。

TLDR: AIT is a two-stage method that transfers manipulation knowledge from human videos to robots by extracting and aligning a clean action-intent representation, improving real-robot and simulated manipulation performance over prior baselines.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have achieved promising performance for generalized robotic manipulation, yet their reliance on expensive real-robot data remains a fundamental bottleneck. A scalable alternative is to transfer knowledge from off-the-shelf human-centric videos. However, existing methods extract latent action representations that are entangled with scene-specific noise, diluting the transferred knowledge. Motivated by this limitation, we propose Action-Intent Transfer (AIT), a two-stage method that transfers knowledge through a clean action representation shared across humans and robots. In the first stage, AIT extracts explicit action intents and disentangles the implicit action intent from manipulation videos. In the second stage, AIT aligns the human and robot domains within this shared intent space and decodes the intent into executable robot actions. Extensive experiments in both simulation and real-world environments demonstrate that AIT transfers human knowledge more effectively and consistently outperforms prior baselines.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在泛化机器人操控任务中展现了优异的性能，但其对昂贵真实机器人数据的依赖仍是根本性瓶颈。一种可扩展的替代方案是从现成的人类中心视频中迁移知识。然而，现有方法提取的潜在动作表征与场景特定噪声纠缠在一起，稀释了迁移知识的有效性。针对这一局限，我们提出动作意图迁移（AIT）方法，这是一种两阶段方法，通过人类与机器人共享的干净动作表征来迁移知识。在第一阶段，AIT提取显式动作意图，并从操控视频中解耦隐式动作意图。在第二阶段，AIT在共享意图空间中对齐人类与机器人域，并将意图解码为可执行的机器人动作。在仿真和真实环境中的大量实验表明，AIT能够更有效地迁移人类知识，并持续优于先前基线方法。

Authors: Zhiqian Xia, Lianyang Ma, Haifeng Xia, Siyu Xia, Wei Wang, Xiaochun Cao

Hybrid Particle-Voxel Dynamics for Multimodal 3D World Simulation WorldModel

world model 3D representation action-conditioned multimodal prediction robot policy

简要说明：本文提出了一种动作条件世界模型，利用混合粒子-体素3D表示联合预测外观、几何和触觉信号，实现50Hz的多模态长时程仿真，用于策略训练和规划。

TLDR: This paper introduces an action-conditioned world model that jointly predicts appearance, geometry, and tactile signals using a hybrid particle-voxel 3D representation, enabling multimodal, long-horizon simulation at 50 Hz for policy training and planning.

Abstract: Predicting how the world evolves in response to robot actions is central to policy learning, evaluation, and planning. However, many action-conditioned world models predict future observations in 2D image or video space without explicitly modeling the underlying 3D scene, making spatial consistency across viewpoints and over long-horizon interactions challenging. We introduce 3D World Simulator, an action-conditioned multimodal world modeling framework that jointly predicts appearance, geometry, and tactile observations from a unified 3D representation. Our approach combines a hybrid particle-voxel autoencoder that compresses point clouds into compact 3D voxel latents with an action-conditioned latent dynamics model that predicts their evolution. The shared 3D representation supports geometrically consistent rendering from arbitrary viewpoints and flexible integration of spatially aligned tactile signals. Our experiments demonstrate interactive, long-horizon, multimodal prediction at 50 Hz. We then show how our model enables scalable data generation for policy training and evaluation using tactile and multi-view visual observations, including wrist-mounted and novel camera views. Furthermore, we scale our method to large datasets containing diverse objects and demonstrate model-based planning with unseen objects and robot configurations. Together, these results highlight the potential of hybrid particle-voxel dynamics as a foundation for multimodal 3D world simulation.

摘要（中文）：预测世界如何响应机器人动作而演变，是策略学习、评估与规划的核心问题。然而，许多基于动作的条件世界模型在二维图像或视频空间中预测未来观察结果，未显式建模底层三维场景，这使得跨视角及长时间跨度的空间一致性面临挑战。我们提出了三维世界模拟器，这是一个基于动作的多模态世界建模框架，能够从统一的三维表示中联合预测外观、几何形状及触觉观测。该方法结合了一种混合粒子-体素自编码器，将点云压缩为紧凑的三维体素潜变量，并配以基于动作的潜动力学模型来预测其演变。共享的三维表示支持从任意视角进行几何一致的渲染，并能够灵活整合空间对齐的触觉信号。实验表明，我们的方法能以50赫兹的频率实现交互式、长时间跨度及多模态预测。随后，我们展示了该模型如何利用触觉与多视角视觉观测（包括腕装视角及新颖的相机视角）实现用于策略训练与评估的可扩展数据生成。此外，我们将该方法扩展至包含多样物体的大型数据集，并展示了针对未见物体及机器人配置的基于模型的规划。综合来看，这些结果凸显了混合粒子-体素动力学作为多模态三维世界模拟基础所蕴含的潜力。

Authors: Jimmy Wang, Yifan Chou, Kaifeng Zhang, Yixuan Wang, Binghao Huang, Tao Yu, Saleh Nabi, Yunzhu Li

All-For-One: Distilling Visual Foundation Models to a Fast, Memory-Efficient Visuomotor Policy Manipulation

distillation visuomotor policy visual foundation models robot manipulation privileged learning

简要说明：本文提出All-For-One (AFO)，一种两阶段蒸馏框架，在训练时将视觉基础模型作为特权信息，蒸馏出轻量级的纯RGB视觉运动策略，在仿真和真实世界操作任务中实现高效控制。

TLDR: This paper introduces All-For-One (AFO), a two-stage distillation framework that uses visual foundation models as privileged information during training to distill a lightweight RGB-only visuomotor policy, achieving efficient robotic manipulation across simulation and real-world tasks.

Abstract: Visual Foundation Models (VFMs) provide semantic cues such as depth and segmentation useful for robotic manipulation, but directly deploying them in closed-loop control is impractical due to high computational cost, temporal inconsistency, and distribution shift between static internet images and egocentric robot observations. We propose All-For-One (AFO), a two-stage distillation framework that leverages VFMs strictly as privileged information during training, using downstream robotic data. Following the privileged learning paradigm, AFO decouples semantic representation learning from inference-time policy execution. In the All stage, a teacher policy fuses RGB observations with outputs from multiple VFMs to learn a semantically enriched representation. In the For-One stage, this knowledge is distilled in-distribution into a lightweight RGB-only student policy. Evaluated on two Adroit tasks and five MetaWorld tasks in simulation, as well as three real-world manipulation tasks, AFO outperforms prior foundation-model-based approaches while using over 30x fewer parameters than VFM-based encoders and 50x lower latency than its own teacher in simulation benchmarks, providing an efficient pathway for transferring foundation-model knowledge to robotic control.

摘要（中文）：视觉基础模型（VFMs）提供深度估计和分割等语义线索，对于机器人操作任务具有重要价值，但由于计算成本高、时间不一致性以及静态互联网图像与自我中心机器人观测之间的分布差异，直接将其部署于闭环控制并不现实。我们提出“All-For-One”（AFO）框架，一种两阶段蒸馏方法，在训练过程中仅将VFMs作为特权信息使用，依托下游机器人数据进行学习。遵循特权学习范式，AFO将语义表示学习与推理时的策略执行解耦。在“All”阶段，教师策略融合RGB观测与多个VFM的输出，学习富含语义的表示；在“For-One”阶段，这些知识被蒸馏至仅依赖RGB输入的轻量级学生策略中，且保持分布内一致性。在仿真环境中，AFO在两项Adroit任务和五项MetaWorld任务上均取得优异表现，并成功完成三项真实世界操作任务。相较于先前基于基础模型的方法，AFO取得更优性能，同时参数量较VFM编码器减少超过30倍，推理延迟较其自身教师策略降低50倍，为基础模型知识向机器人控制的高效迁移提供了可行路径。

Authors: Byungkun Lee, Minho Park, Hojoon Lee, Dongyoon Hwang, Donghu Kim, Hyunseung Kim, Kyungmin Lee, Yunho Kim, Jaegul Choo

Spectrally Routed Diffusion Policy for Multi-Task Robotic Manipulation Manipulation

diffusion policy multi-task learning spectral routing VGGT encoder robotic manipulation

简要说明：SR-DP 通过使用冻结的 VGGT 编码器提取判别性视觉特征，并利用基于 SVD 的光谱路由减少梯度干扰，提升了多任务扩散策略在机器人操作中的成功率。

TLDR: SR-DP improves multi-task diffusion policies for robotic manipulation by using a frozen VGGT encoder for discriminative visual features and SVD-based spectral routing to reduce gradient interference, achieving higher success rates in simulation and real-world tasks.

Abstract: Diffusion-based policies have achieved strong performance on single-task robotic manipulation. However, a single model trained jointly on multiple tasks consistently underperforms the per-task specialists trained on the same demonstrations. We focus on two challenges. First, the convolutional encoders commonly used in diffusion-based policies produce visual conditions that are not discriminative enough. Second, gradients from incompatible action modes update the shared denoiser's dense parameters along the same directions, causing destructive interference during joint training. To address both, we propose SR-DP (Spectrally Routed Diffusion Policy). A frozen VGGT encoder with a spatial-compression adapter produces compact multi-scale semantic-geometric tokens, a task-discriminative visual condition for tasks that share a workspace. We first train the denoiser as a standard diffusion policy, then decompose selected linear layers by SVD into a frozen basis of orthogonal rank-one experts, adapted through spectral routing and Householder input rotations. On six RoboTwin tasks, SR-DP averages a 68.4% success rate, surpassing multi-task VO-DP by 21.8 points and the strongest per-task baseline by 3.8 points. On four real-world bimanual tasks, Stage 2 reaches a 43.0% average success rate and improves over Stage 1 by 19.0 points.

摘要（中文）：基于扩散的策略在单任务机器人操作中表现出色。然而，在多个任务上联合训练的单一模型，其性能始终不如在相同演示数据上分别训练的各任务专属模型。我们聚焦于两个挑战。首先，扩散策略中常用的卷积编码器产生的视觉条件区分度不足。其次，来自不兼容动作模式的梯度会沿相同方向更新共享去噪器的稠密参数，导致联合训练过程中出现破坏性干扰。为解决这两个问题，我们提出了SR-DP（频谱路由扩散策略）。一个冻结的VGGT编码器结合空间压缩适配器，生成紧凑的多尺度语义-几何令牌，为共享工作空间的任务提供具有任务区分度的视觉条件。我们首先将去噪器作为标准扩散策略进行训练，然后通过SVD将选定的线性层分解为冻结的正交秩一专家基，并通过频谱路由和Householder输入旋转进行适配。在六个RoboTwin任务上，SR-DP平均成功率达到68.4%，超过多任务VO-DP 21.8个百分点，比最强的单任务基线高出3.8个百分点。在四个真实世界双臂任务上，第二阶段平均成功率达43.0%，较第一阶段提升19.0个百分点。

Authors: Mingcong Li, Yihan Zhou, Jiayu Qu, Xueyang Guo, Yilin Mo

ReflexArc: Bottom-Up Integration of Instantaneous Tactile Reflexes into Whole-Body Humanoid Control HumanoidEmbodied

tactile reflex whole-body humanoid control bottom-up integration contact reaction reflex-in-the-loop policy learning

简要说明：本文提出ReflexArc，一种自下而上的框架，将瞬时触觉反射集成到全身人形控制中，在10毫秒内对意外接触作出反应，减少首次力峰值和接触冲量，同时保持平衡并完成恢复。

TLDR: This paper presents ReflexArc, a bottom-up framework that integrates instantaneous tactile reflexes into whole-body humanoid control to react to unexpected contacts within 10 ms, reducing first force peak and contact impulse while maintaining balance and completing recovery.

Abstract: Humanoid robots operating in cluttered environments must react to unexpected contacts before the first impact peak, which arrives within tens of milliseconds. Learned whole-body policies running at 50 Hz introduce a policy-cycle delay and may suppress a protective withdrawal as a tracking error. To address these challenges, we propose ARC (Ascending Reflex Control), a bottom-up framework that integrates instantaneous tactile reflexes with learned whole-body control. ARC consists of two components: an instantaneous reflex pathway and bottom-up reflex integration. The reflex pathway detects hazardous contacts from full-body tactile sensing, solves a whole-body withdrawal pose, and delivers it directly to the motors within 10 ms. Bottom-up reflex integration combines reflex-in-the-loop policy learning, reflex-transparent policy alignment, and reflex-informed policy adaptation to sustain the withdrawal, maintain balance, and complete longer-horizon recovery. We deploy ARC on a Unitree G1 and evaluate three categories of hazardous contact. Compared with an otherwise identical reflex delayed by 20 ms, ARC reduces the first force peak by 34.1% and reduces the contact impulse from 0.2632 N s to 0.1225 N s (a 2.15x ratio). We further demonstrate protected motion tracking, teleoperation, and vision-free obstacle traversal guided by foot tactile sensing. Project page: https://minusmodulo.github.io/reflexarc-website/

摘要（中文）：仿人机器人在杂乱环境中作业时，必须在首次冲击峰值到来之前（通常为几十毫秒内）对意外接触作出反应。以50Hz频率运行的全身学习策略会引入策略周期延迟，并可能将保护性退缩行为抑制为跟踪误差。为应对这些挑战，我们提出ARC（上升反射控制，Ascending Reflex Control），一种自底向上的框架，将即时触觉反射与学习型全身控制相结合。ARC由两部分组成：即时反射通路和自底向上的反射整合。反射通路从全身触觉感知中检测危险接触，求解全身退缩姿态，并在10毫秒内直接将其传递至电机。自底向上的反射整合结合了反射在环的策略学习、反射透明的策略对齐以及反射感知的策略自适应，以维持退缩动作、保持平衡并完成更长时间跨度的恢复。我们将ARC部署在宇树G1上，评估了三类危险接触场景。与延迟20毫秒的相同反射相比，ARC将首次力峰值降低了34.1%，并将接触冲量从0.2632 N·s降至0.1225 N·s（2.15倍比率）。我们进一步展示了受保护的运动跟踪、遥操作以及由足部触觉感知引导的无视觉障碍穿越。项目页面：https://minusmodulo.github.io/reflexarc-website/
