Authors: Mingyu Wang, Si Li, Ziqing Chen, He Wang, Li Yi

ReSMap: Recasting Satellite Priors for Robust and Accurate Online HD Map Construction AutonomousDriving

HD map construction satellite priors camera-satellite fusion redundancy-aware BEV features

简要说明：ReSMap 提出了一种冗余感知的相机-卫星融合框架，用于鲁棒的在线高清地图构建，通过预测-融合模块和以对象为中心的多模态查询解码器，在相机故障时利用卫星先验，在 nuScenes 上达到 SOTA。

TLDR: ReSMap introduces a redundancy-aware camera-satellite fusion framework for robust online HD map construction, using a Predict-then-Fuse module and an Object-Centric Cooperative Multi-modal Query decoder to leverage satellite priors under camera failures, achieving SOTA on nuScenes.

Abstract: Despite recent advances in camera-based online HD map construction, these systems remain susceptible to sensor failures due to their reliance on onboard cameras. In contrast, satellite images remain available independently of real-time sensing conditions as they are cached offline. Existing methods utilizing satellite images, however, primarily leverage them under nominal conditions, without explicitly addressing them as redundancy when a sensor degrades. To address this gap, we propose ReSMap, a redundancy-aware camera-satellite fusion framework for robust online HD map construction. Our framework explicitly leverages satellite images as a complementary source to improve robustness against camera failures. A Predict-then-Fuse (PTF) module fuses camera and satellite BEV features by using each branch's own prediction confidence as a per-pixel reliability weight, with no learned router. An Object-Centric Cooperative Multi-modal Query (OCMQ) decoder then extends this per-modality separation to the query level: each modality cross-attends only to its own BEV, and per-modality updates are merged through a learned per-token gate. Our model achieves state-of-the-art performance on nuScenes across all splits and range settings. More importantly, it also sets the new state-of-the-art under camera-failure scenarios, demonstrating that satellite images serve not only as a strong prior but as practical redundancy for robust online HD mapping.

摘要（中文）：尽管基于摄像头的在线高清地图构建技术近期取得了进展，但这些系统由于依赖车载摄像头，仍然容易受到传感器故障的影响。相比之下，卫星图像因可离线缓存，其可用性不受实时感知条件制约。然而，现有利用卫星图像的方法主要是在标称条件下使用它们，并未明确将其作为传感器性能下降时的冗余手段。为弥补这一不足，我们提出ReSMap，一种具有冗余感知能力的摄像头-卫星融合框架，用于构建鲁棒的在线高清地图。该框架明确将卫星图像作为补充信息源，以增强对摄像头故障的鲁棒性。我们设计了一个“先预测后融合”（PTF）模块，利用各分支自身的预测置信度作为逐像素可靠性权重，对摄像头和卫星的BEV特征进行融合，该模块无需学习型路由器。随后，一个面向对象的协同多模态查询（OCMQ）解码器将这种逐模态分离的思想扩展到查询层面：每种模态仅对其自身的BEV进行交叉注意力计算，并通过一个可学习的逐令牌门控机制合并各模态的更新结果。我们的模型在nuScenes数据集的所有划分和距离设置下均达到了最先进的性能。更重要的是，在摄像头故障场景下，该模型同样树立了新的最先进水平，证明了卫星图像不仅是一种强先验信息，更是实现鲁棒在线高清地图构建的实用冗余手段。

Authors: Kyungmin Kim, Sumin Lee, Sungoh Jeong, DoHyun Lim, Seonghyun Park, Soonmin Hwang

ActOR: Ambient AI-Based Agentic Orchestration for Humanoid Autonomy in Operating Rooms Manipulation

ambient AI digital twin LLM agent humanoid autonomy closed-loop feedback

简要说明：ActOR 将环境感知与本体感知融合到共享数字孪生中，使基于大语言模型的智能体编排器能够在手术室中无需任务特化训练即可规划并调整人形机器人操作任务。

TLDR: ActOR integrates ambient and onboard perception into a shared digital twin, enabling an LLM-based agentic orchestrator to plan and adapt humanoid manipulation tasks in operating rooms without task-specific training.

Abstract: Operating rooms (ORs) increasingly contain ambient sensing infrastructure to enable AI-based optimization of workflows and utilization. We pursue an alternative path: using ambient AI to guide robot action and optimize utilization. Deploying humanoids in the OR without ambient AI is severely limited by cumbersome de novo orientation and planning due to partial onboard observations. We posit that this can be achieved by coupling an ambient AI-based agentic orchestrator with the humanoid robotic actor, providing shared perception and execution feedback for humanoid autonomy in the OR. ActOR fuses a wall-mounted ambient camera and the robot's head-mounted camera into a shared object-level digital twin (DT). A large language model agent plans over the DT using pre-programmed locomotion and manipulation skills without task-specific training. During execution, DT updates and execution outcomes inform retries, alternative approaches, or replanning. We evaluated ActOR in simulated and physical environments. Across three tasks in two simulated ORs reconstructed from real rooms, ambient perception reduced exploration from 1.05 to 0.12 Explore calls per trial when targets were initially outside the robot's view. Closed-loop feedback increased success from 46.7% to 83.3% under nominal execution and from 8.3% to 51.7% under injected navigation, object-relocation, and grasp perturbations. In a physical mock OR with a humanoid, ActOR completed 14 of 20 single-object disposal trials and demonstrated replanning after scene changes. Ambient AI-based observations provide scene state that improves robot action planning, increasing success and reducing exploration compared with robot-only observations. Feeding skill outcomes and DT updates back to the planner improves multi-step task success. Our results show the feasibility of humanoid task autonomy for multi-step disposal tasks in a mock OR.

摘要（中文）：手术室中日益配备环境感知基础设施，以支持基于人工智能的工作流程优化和利用率提升。我们探索了一条替代路径：利用环境人工智能指导机器人行动并优化利用率。在手术室中部署人形机器人，若缺乏环境人工智能，则因机载观测部分受限而导致的繁琐的新方位确定与规划严重制约其应用。我们认为，通过将基于环境人工智能的智能体编排器与人形机器人执行器相结合，提供共享感知与执行反馈，可实现手术室中人形机器人的自主操作。ActOR将壁挂式环境摄像头与机器人头戴式摄像头融合为一个共享的对象级数字孪生。大型语言模型智能体利用预编程的移动和操作技能在数字孪生上进行规划，无需针对特定任务进行训练。在执行过程中，数字孪生的更新及执行结果用于指导重试、替代方案或重新规划。我们在仿真和物理环境中对ActOR进行了评估。在从真实房间重建的两个仿真手术室中执行的三项任务里，当目标初始位于机器人视野之外时，环境感知将每次试验的探索调用次数从1.05次减少至0.12次。闭环反馈在标称执行情况下将成功率从46.7%提升至83.3%，在注入导航、物体重新定位和抓取扰动的情况下将成功率从8.3%提升至51.7%。在配备人形机器人的物理模拟手术室中，ActOR完成了20次单物体处置试验中的14次，并展示了场景变化后的重新规划能力。基于环境人工智能的观测提供了场景状态，改善了机器人行动规划，与仅依赖机器人自身观测相比，提高了成功率并减少了探索。将技能执行结果和数字孪生更新反馈至规划器，可提高多步骤任务的成功率。我们的结果证明了在模拟手术室中实现人形机器人多步骤处置任务自主操作的可行性。

Authors: Han Zhang, Sicheng Lu, Aleks Santari, Jeffrey K. Jopling, Masaru Ishii, Mathias Unberath

DiMuRe: Diagnosis-Guided Multilevel Recovery for Robotic Task Execution VLA

multilevel recovery diagnosis-guided vision-language-action multimodal large language model LIBERO-Disturb

简要说明：DiMuRe 提出了一种诊断引导的多级恢复框架，结合程序重用、恢复技能和VLA抓取及多模态LLM重规划，并在新的LIBERO-Disturb基准上验证。

TLDR: DiMuRe introduces a diagnosis-guided multilevel recovery framework for robotic task execution, combining program reuse, recovery skills, and VLA-based grasping with multimodal LLM replanning, validated on a new LIBERO-Disturb benchmark.

Abstract: Disturbances can invalidate the conditions required by a robot's next action even when much of its task program remains useful. A recovery system must therefore choose a response suited to the current state. We present DiMuRe (diagnosis-guided multilevel recovery), a framework for robot-use agents that uses phase-specific evidence and method preconditions to select program reuse or predefined recovery skills, including bounded vision-language-action (VLA) grasping. After the original program exits, a multimodal large language model (MLLM) can generate corrective code from images and execution feedback. Local verification checks the outcome of each recovery attempt. We also introduce LIBERO-Disturb, a benchmark for robustness and recovery under mid-execution disturbances, supporting program-based agents and VLA policies. On 801 scheduled disturbed Encore development cases, Local DiMuRe (program reuse and recovery skills) achieves 77.65% complete-task success, compared with 58.68% for the original program under the same physical-step allowance. Full DiMuRe achieves 81.90% with terminal replanning, an additional step allowance, and early handoff. Local DiMuRe also uses fewer physical steps per scheduled episode than the original program.

摘要（中文）：摘要：干扰可能使机器人的下一动作所需条件失效，即便其任务程序的大部分内容仍然可用。因此，恢复系统必须根据当前状态选择适当的应对措施。我们提出了DiMuRe（诊断引导的多层次恢复），一种面向机器人使用智能体的框架，利用阶段特定证据和方法前置条件来选择程序复用或预定义恢复技能，包括有界视觉-语言-动作（VLA）抓取。在原始程序退出后，多模态大语言模型（MLLM）可以从图像和执行反馈中生成修正代码。局部验证检查每次恢复尝试的结果。我们还引入了LIBERO-Disturb，一个用于在执行中途干扰下评估鲁棒性和恢复能力的基准，支持基于程序的智能体和VLA策略。在801个计划性干扰的Encore开发案例中，局部DiMuRe（程序复用和恢复技能）实现了77.65%的完整任务成功率，而在相同的物理步数限制下原始程序为58.68%。完整DiMuRe在终端重新规划、额外步数限制和提前交接的情况下达到了81.90%。局部DiMuRe在每次计划情节中的物理步数消耗也少于原始程序。

Authors: Renkai Yi, Yuwei Wu, Haoyu Zhang, Penghao Dai, Zhi Gao, Jin Chen, Che Sun

Say the Same, Act Differently: Diagnosing and Steering Text-Action Divergence in Reasoning VLAs VLA

reasoning VLA text-action divergence visual perturbations TNAS diagnostic action safety

简要说明：本文发现推理式视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型存在漏洞：视觉扰动可改变物理动作，而生成的理由文本却一字不变；并提出了文本中性动作子空间（TNAS）诊断方法引导此类攻击，表明不变的理由无法保证动作安全。

TLDR: This paper identifies a vulnerability in reasoning VLA models where visual perturbations can change physical actions while leaving the generated rationales word-for-word identical, and introduces a text-neutral action-subspace (TNAS) diagnostic to steer such attacks, showing that unchanged rationales cannot certify safe actions.

Abstract: Reasoning vision-language-action (VLA) models pair physical control with natural-language rationales that supervisors can read to monitor embodied safety. Prior attacks on VLA reasoning corrupt the rationale itself and leave visible evidence in the text. We show that visual perturbations can instead alter the physical action while keeping the generated rationale word-for-word identical. At the shared text/action interface of Alpamayo for driving and InstructVLA for manipulation, our text-neutral action-subspace (TNAS) diagnostic shows that the locally most action-sensitive direction is nearly orthogonal to the active text-loss gradients, with 1.87% and 5.28% norm overlap. At equal hidden-state perturbation norms across both models, interventions along this text-neutral residual shift actions 4.64x to 47.8x more than text-gradient perturbations, whereas text-gradient perturbations induce 21.2x to 277x more text drift. Steering visual perturbations along this direction reaches the same decoupling from the image. Across 154 obstacle-annotated driving scenes in Alpamayo, TNAS-guided attacks induce a new collision under a word-for-word identical rationale in 52.6% of scenes under full-image perturbations and 35.1% under a localized forward-camera patch, compared with 4.55% for unguided action attacks. Relative to a text-preserving baseline, TNAS guidance raises exact rationale preservation from 83.0% to 89.5% and cuts teacher-forced text drift by 68.4% at a comparable collision rate. In InstructVLA, TNAS guidance cuts text drift by 40.5% and preserves the exact response on 85.0% of examples alongside a 1.73-unit action-chunk shift. An unchanged rationale therefore cannot certify a safe action, so monitors for reasoning VLAs must verify the predicted action channel directly.

摘要（中文）：推理视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型将物理控制与自然语言推理过程配对，监督者可通过阅读这些推理来监控具身安全性。以往针对VLA推理的攻击会破坏推理本身，并在文本中留下可见痕迹。我们证明，视觉扰动可以在保持生成的推理逐字不变的同时改变物理动作。在用于驾驶的Alpamayo和用于操作的InstructVLA的共享文本/动作接口上，我们的文本中性动作子空间（TNAS）诊断表明，局部最动作敏感方向与活动文本损失梯度几乎正交，范数重叠度分别为1.87%和5.28%。在两个模型上施加相等隐状态扰动范数时，沿这一文本中性残差方向的干预对动作的改变幅度是文本梯度扰动的4.64倍至47.8倍，而文本梯度扰动引起的文本漂移则是前者的21.2倍至277倍。沿该方向引导视觉扰动可达到与图像相同的解耦效果。在Alpamayo的154个带障碍物标注的驾驶场景中，TNAS引导的攻击在整图扰动下于52.6%的场景中、在前向摄像头局部补丁扰动下于35.1%的场景中，在推理逐字不变的情况下诱发新的碰撞，而未引导的动作攻击仅为4.55%。相对于文本保持基线，TNAS引导将推理逐字保留率从83.0%提升至89.5%，并在相近碰撞率下将教师强制文本漂移降低了68.4%。在InstructVLA中，TNAS引导将文本漂移降低了40.5%，在85.0%的样本上保留了完全一致的响应，同时伴随1.73单位的动作块位移。因此，不变的推理并不能保证动作的安全性，对推理型VLA的监控必须直接验证预测的动作通道。

Authors: Zihao Feng, Qingzhao Zhang, Chunyu Xia, Bo Yu, Z. Morley Mao, Ramesh Govindan

VARP: A Visual Adaptive Rearrangement Planner for Non-Monotone Object Rearrangement Planning Manipulation

object rearrangement non-monotone visual state representation pick-and-place online adaptation

简要说明：VARP从视觉状态表示中学习非单调物体重排，预测拾放动作并在线适应扰动，无需重新规划，实现了高成功率和鲁棒性。

TLDR: VARP learns non-monotone object rearrangement from visual state representations, predicting pick-and-place actions and adapting online to disturbances without replanning, achieving high success rates and robustness.

Abstract: Object rearrangement planning in cluttered environments is often non-monotone, requiring objects to be temporarily relocated before reaching their final destinations. Although search-based planners can solve such tasks, they incur substantial computational cost and require expensive replanning when the environment changes. We propose the Visual Adaptive Rearrangement Planner (VARP), which learns non-monotone rearrangement directly from visual state representations generated from expert demonstrations. VARP predicts pick-and-place actions from the current and goal visual state representations, and incorporates an Action Refinement Strategy (ARS) to improve action feasibility and a Progress Enforcement Strategy (PES) to mitigate progress stagnation. By continuously updating actions from the latest visual state representations, VARP adapts online to disturbances without replanning from scratch or performing online combinatorial search. In challenging rearrangement benchmarks, VARP achieves a 98.3\% success rate with only 0.4 s planning time per task, 97.5\% success under execution-time disturbances, and 94.5\% under continuous severe disturbances, while generalizing effectively to unseen object counts. These results demonstrate that VARP provides a scalable and robust solution for non-monotone object rearrangement.

摘要（中文）：杂乱环境中的物体重排规划通常是非单调的，要求物体在到达最终位置之前被临时转移。尽管基于搜索的规划器能够解决此类任务，但它们会产生高昂的计算成本，并且在环境变化时需要昂贵的重新规划。我们提出了视觉自适应重排规划器（VARP），它直接从专家演示生成的视觉状态表示中学习非单调重排。VARP根据当前及目标视觉状态表示预测抓取和放置动作，并引入动作精炼策略（ARS）以提升动作可行性，以及进度强制策略（PES）以缓解进度停滞问题。通过持续根据最新视觉状态表示更新动作，VARP能够在线适应干扰，而无需从头重新规划或进行在线组合搜索。在具有挑战性的重排基准测试中，VARP实现了98.3%的成功率，每个任务仅需0.4秒的规划时间；在执行过程中受到干扰时成功率达97.5%；在持续严重干扰下成功率达94.5%，并且能够有效泛化至未见过的物体数量。这些结果表明，VARP为非单调物体重排提供了一种可扩展且稳健的解决方案。

Authors: Hanwen Ren, Meng Zheng, Zhongpai Gao, Anwesa Choudhuri, Benjamin Planche, Terrence Chen, Ziyan Wu

MABEL: An Open Anthropomorphic Mobile Bimanual Platform for Teleoperation and Learning Manipulation

mobile bimanual manipulation teleoperation imitation learning whole-body control open-source hardware

简要说明：MABEL是一个开源、低成本（8100美元）的56自由度拟人移动双臂平台，通过Apple Vision Pro实现全身遥操作，并具备端到端模仿学习流程，支持真实机器人策略部署。

TLDR: MABEL is an open-source, low-cost (US$8.1k) anthropomorphic mobile bimanual platform with 56 DOF, featuring whole-body teleoperation via Apple Vision Pro and an end-to-end imitation learning pipeline for real-robot policy deployment.

Abstract: As robot learning moves beyond the tabletop, many tasks require mobility, adjustable reach, active perception, and bimanual dexterity. Commercial platforms combining these capabilities are costly, while affordable open-source alternatives cover only a subset and require software integration. We present MABEL, an open-source anthropomorphic mobile bimanual robot with 56 degrees of freedom (DOF) and a US$8.1k parts cost. It combines two 7-DOF arms with 17-DOF hands, a pitching torso, a lift, a 3-DOF neck, and a holonomic base. Back-drivable arms and torso support compliant interaction, with fingertip reach from floor level to 2.23 m. The head and torso roughly triple modeled camera coverage relative to a torso-fixed camera. Apple Vision Pro head and hand tracking enables whole-body teleoperation without handheld controllers, with 137 ms mean glass-to-glass stereo video latency over the robot's Wi-Fi hotspot. We demonstrate an end-to-end imitation learning pipeline, from teleoperated data collection to policy deployment, using a shared command interface and whole-body controller.

摘要（中文）：随着机器人学习从桌面场景拓展至更广阔的应用领域，许多任务对移动性、可调伸展范围、主动感知及双臂灵巧操作提出了要求。结合这些能力的商用平台成本高昂，而价格可承受的开源替代方案通常仅覆盖其中部分功能，且需进行软件集成。我们提出了MABEL——一款开源仿人移动双臂机器人，拥有56个自由度（DOF），零部件成本为8，100美元。该机器人集成了两条7自由度手臂、17自由度灵巧手、可俯仰躯干、升降机构、3自由度颈部及全向移动底盘。后驱式手臂与躯干支持柔顺交互，指尖可达范围覆盖从地面至2.23米的高度。头部与躯干相较固定于躯干的摄像头，使建模摄像头覆盖范围约增加三倍。借助Apple Vision Pro的头部位姿与手部追踪，可实现无需手持控制器的全身遥操作，经由机器人Wi-Fi热点传输的立体视频端到端延迟平均为137毫秒。我们展示了从遥操作数据采集到策略部署的端到端模仿学习流程，该系统采用共享命令接口与全身控制器。

Authors: Qilong Cheng, Rooholla Khorrambakht, Mohamed Yassine Kabouri, Quang Nam Nguyen, Luca Macesanu, Haoran Zhou, Yipeng Wang, Ludovic Righetti

FEIJOA: Task-Driven Grounding and Execution for Mobile Manipulation Manipulation

language-model agent mobile manipulation grounding embodiment-aware harness RGB-D scene representation

简要说明：FEIJOA 提出了一种语言模型代理，在测试时通过交互式查询场景图工具并在真实 Spot 机器人上验证技能，从而将开放式移动操作指令落地，显著提高了任务完成率。

TLDR: FEIJOA presents a language-model agent that grounds open-ended mobile manipulation instructions at test time by interactively querying a scene-graph tool and verifying skills on a real Spot robot, significantly improving task completion over prebuilt representations.

Abstract: A mobile manipulator asked to "put the toys away in the toy box" must decide which objects are toys and which container the user means, then find base poses, grasps, and placements it can execute. Because a scene representation is built before the instruction is known, it may lack the attributes, affordances, or concepts needed to resolve the task. We present FEIJOA, a language-model agent that grounds the instruction at test time. It queries a grounding tool over a posed RGB-D scan, inspects the returned candidates, and refines its queries until they resolve the instruction. An embodiment-aware harness checks each skill's preconditions, samples base poses from which the target is reachable, and verifies the skill's effect from observations before and after execution. On 103 open-ended grounding queries, FEIJOA resolves 94.2% exactly, compared with 68.0% for the best prebuilt representation. Over 50 real-world trials on Spot, it completes 35 tasks; 17 of these successes follow recovery from a failed tool call or verification check. Of the 15 failed trials, 13 were caused by the robot's physical skills, and only 2 by grounding or the agent's reasoning. Project website: https://williamshen-nz.github.io/feijoa/.

摘要（中文）：移动机械臂在执行“把玩具放进玩具箱”的指令时，必须判断哪些物体是玩具、用户所指的容器是哪个，然后找到可执行的基座位置、抓取姿态和放置姿态。由于场景表示是在指令知晓之前构建的，因此可能缺乏解析任务所需的属性、可供性或概念。我们提出了FEIJOA，一个在测试时对指令进行语义落地的语言模型智能体。它通过一个基于带位姿RGB-D扫描的落地工具进行查询，检查返回的候选结果，并优化其查询直到解析出指令。一个具身感知框架检查每项技能的前提条件，从目标可达的基座姿态中采样，并在执行前后通过观测验证技能效果。在103个开放式落地查询中，FEIJOA精确解析了94.2%，而最佳的预构建表示仅为68.0%。在Spot机器人的50次真实世界试验中，完成了35项任务；其中17项成功是在工具调用或验证检查失败后的恢复中实现的。15次失败尝试中，13次由机器人的物理技能导致，仅有2次归因于语义落地或智能体的推理。项目网站：https://williamshen-nz.github.io/feijoa/。

Authors: Aditya Agarwal, William Shen, Sahit Chintalapudi, Lucy Cai, Nishanth Kumar, Aidan Curtis, Travis Manderson, Tomás Lozano-Pérez, Leslie Pack Kaelbling

Physical Experience Builds Continual Spatial World Models WorldModel

spatial world models continual learning cross-episode memory state-action-outcome navigation

简要说明：本文研究物理经验如何使空间世界模型在变化环境中持续提升预测与行动能力，提出跨情节空间变化记忆，并在物理迷宫和连续导航中验证其优势。

TLDR: This paper investigates how physical experience enables spatial world models to continually improve prediction and action in changing environments, proposing Cross-episode Spatial Change Memory and demonstrating benefits in a physics-grounded maze and continuous navigation.

Abstract: World models are increasingly used to support prediction and planning in embodied agents, but the knowledge is usually established before deployment and then carried into later encounters. Continual operation faces a different problem. A familiar environment may change, and the agent must use previous experience without allowing old expectations to override current physical evidence. This study asks what repeated physical experience must contribute for a spatial world model to become progressively more useful rather than simply more persistent. A physics-grounded dynamic maze separates recurring spatial change from the continuous consequences of action. Cross-episode Spatial Change Memory learns relations among environmental transformations, while state-action-outcome experience refines predictions of motion. Structured experience progressively reduces the need for future route correction and transfers to spatial transitions not encountered during learning. The advantage disappears when past changes contain no information about future ones. Continuous navigation further shows that predictive memory changes behavior when a previous decision becomes invalid but leaves behavior unchanged when the decision remains correct. Physical tests expose a complementary limit: correct topology does not guarantee correct action prediction, and accumulated physical experience reduces this mismatch within the modeled dynamics. The results characterize continual world knowledge as experience that improves future prediction and action beyond stored episodes while remaining revisable by the physical outcomes it is intended to predict.

摘要（中文）：世界模型越来越多地被用于支持具身智能体的预测与规划，但这类知识通常是在部署前建立，随后被携带至后续交互场景中。持续运行面临的是不同的问题：熟悉的环境可能发生变化，智能体必须利用先前的经验，同时不让旧有的预期覆盖当前的物理证据。本研究探讨的问题是：重复的物理经验必须贡献什么，才能使空间世界模型逐步变得更有用，而不仅仅是更持久。一个基于物理学的动态迷宫将重复出现的空间变化与动作的持续后果区分开来。跨情节空间变化记忆学习环境变换之间的关系，而状态-动作-结果经验则细化运动预测。结构化经验逐步减少未来路径修正的需求，并能泛化到学习过程中未遇到的空间转换中。当过去的变化不包含未来变化的任何信息时，这一优势便消失。连续导航进一步表明，当先前的决策失效时，预测性记忆会改变行为，而当决策仍然正确时，行为则保持不变。物理测试揭示了一个互补性的局限：正确的拓扑结构并不能保证正确的动作预测，而累积的物理经验会在建模动力学范围内缩小这一不匹配。研究结果将持续性的世界知识刻画为一种经验——它超越存储的情节，改善未来预测和行动，同时仍可由其旨在预测的物理结果进行修正。

Authors: Yuhang Sun

A Tutorial on Shape Servoing of Deformable Objects-Part II: Advanced Concepts Manipulation

shape servoing deformable objects deformation Jacobian data-driven control singular value decomposition

简要说明：本教程论文涵盖数据驱动的可变形物体形状伺服中的高级概念，包括通过SVD分析变形雅可比矩阵、形状特征选择、失败模式以及扩展到时变目标和三维物体。

TLDR: This tutorial paper covers advanced concepts in data-driven shape servoing of deformable objects, including analysis of deformation Jacobian via SVD, shape feature selection, failure modes, and extensions to time-varying targets and 3D objects.

Abstract: In robotics, shape control, or shape servoing, refers to the automatic manipulation of a deformable object toward a desired shape. This article is the second of a two-part tutorial on data-driven, Jacobian-based shape control, in which the deformation Jacobian, a local model of how robot motion changes the measured shape, is estimated from measurements. Part I built the shape-servoing loop and derived a local stability condition. This paper starts by using the singular value decomposition of the deformation Jacobian to identify shape changes that can be produced by small robot motions, those that require large robot motions, and those that are locally unavailable. It then analyses how the choice of shape features determines how the controller regulates the object's shape and, therefore, how much the object deforms on its way to the target. It then describes three ways in which the shape control loop can fail: loss of controllability, loss of observability, and occurrence of mechanical instabilities. It closes with shape-control extensions to time-varying targets, secondary tasks, and three-dimensional objects.

摘要（中文）：在机器人学领域，形状控制（或称形状伺服）是指通过自动操作将可变形物体调整至期望形状的过程。本文是关于基于数据驱动、利用雅可比矩阵进行形状控制的两部分教程中的第二部分，其中形变雅可比矩阵——即描述机器人运动如何改变测量所得形状的局部模型——是通过测量数据估计得出的。第一部分构建了形状伺服回路并推导出了局部稳定性条件。本部分首先利用形变雅可比矩阵的奇异值分解来识别可由小幅机器人运动实现的形状变化、需要大幅机器人运动才能实现的形状变化，以及局部范围内无法实现的形状变化。随后分析了形状特征的选择如何决定控制器调节物体形状的方式，进而影响物体在朝向目标过程中发生的形变程度。接着，文章阐述了形状控制回路可能失败的三种情况：可控性丧失、可观测性丧失以及机械失稳的发生。最后，文章将形状控制扩展到时变目标、次级任务及三维物体等应用场景。

Authors: Ignacio Cuiral-Zueco, Alessio Caporali, Miguel Aranda, Gianluca Palli, Gonzalo López-Nicolás, Youcef Mezouar

Pixel-UMI: Learning Environment-Aware Whole-Body Manipulation from Sensorized Human Demonstrations Manipulation

whole-body manipulation sensorized human demonstrations Environment-Aware Retargeting Retargeting-Error-Aware Masking DAgger

简要说明：Pixel-UMI 提出了一种从传感化人类演示中学习环境感知全身移动操作策略的流程，通过环境感知重定向、重定向误差感知掩码和 DAgger 校正，在多个具有挑战性的真实任务中取得了高任务进度。

TLDR: Pixel-UMI introduces a pipeline for learning environment-aware whole-body mobile manipulation policies from sensorized human demonstrations, using Environment-Aware Retargeting, Retargeting-Error-Aware Masking, and DAgger-based corrections to achieve high task progress on challenging real-world tasks.

Abstract: Sensorized human demonstrations offer scalable data for mobile manipulation, but embodiment differences complicate policy learning. We present Pixel-UMI, a pipeline for learning environment-aware whole-body policies from human data. We first introduce Environment-Aware Retargeting (EAR), which combines reconstructed scene geometry with demonstrated head and gripper trajectories to determine robot posture and generate collision-aware joint and base targets. Delay-calibrated action assignment converts these trajectories into actions. However, kinematic differences can leave residual pose errors, creating viewpoint mismatches between human demonstrations and robot observations. We therefore introduce Retargeting-Error-Aware Masking (REAM), which uses these errors during training to reduce reliance on mismatched views at deployment. Finally, because estimated actions cannot fully capture contact-rich interactions, we collect on-policy human corrections through DAgger to improve performance. We evaluate Pixel-UMI on five challenging tasks spanning articulated-object manipulation, deformable-object handling, constrained-space reaching, whole-body collision avoidance, and contact-rich bimanual coordination, achieving 87.0% average task progress. Video results are available at https://pixel-robot.com/pixel-umi

摘要（中文）：传感化的人类演示为移动操作提供了可扩展的数据，但 embodiment 差异使策略学习变得复杂。我们提出了 Pixel-UMI，一种从人类数据中学习环境感知全身策略的流水线。我们首先引入了环境感知重定向（EAR），该方法将重建的场景几何与演示的头部和夹爪轨迹相结合，以确定机器人姿态并生成碰撞感知的关节和基座目标。延迟校准的动作分配将这些轨迹转换为动作。然而，运动学差异可能留下残余位姿误差，导致人类演示与机器人观测之间的视角不匹配。因此，我们引入了重定向误差感知掩蔽（REAM），在训练过程中利用这些误差以减少部署时对不匹配视角的依赖。最后，由于估计的动作无法完全捕捉接触丰富的交互，我们通过 DAgger 收集策略内的人类修正以提升性能。我们在五个具有挑战性的任务上评估了 Pixel-UMI，涵盖铰接物体操作、可变形物体处理、受限空间到达、全身避碰以及接触丰富的双臂协调，平均任务进展达到 87.0%。视频结果见 https://pixel-robot.com/pixel-umi

Authors: Jason Jingzhou Liu, Tony Tao, Deepak Pathak, Ruslan Salakhutdinov

Pixel: A Co-Designed Full-Stack Robot System for Learning General-Purpose Mobile Manipulation Manipulation

co-designed full-stack mobile manipulation whole-body control teleoperation policy learning

简要说明：Pixel 提出了一种协同设计的全栈机器人系统，集成硬件、数据采集、全身控制与策略学习，用于通用移动操作，并在低成本轮式人形机器人上进行了演示。

TLDR: Pixel presents a co-designed full-stack robot system integrating hardware, data collection, whole-body control, and policy learning for general-purpose mobile manipulation, demonstrated on a low-cost wheeled humanoid.

Abstract: General-purpose mobile manipulation requires a combination of capable robot hardware, scalable demonstration collection, expressive whole-body control, and effective policy learning. Yet these components are often developed independently, creating mismatches that limit the capabilities of the complete system. We present Pixel, a co-designed full-stack system for learning general-purpose mobile manipulation. Pixel combines a low-cost wheeled humanoid with human-aligned kinematics and compliant grippers, multiple teleoperation and robot-free human data-collection interfaces, a unified whole-body controller, and a common policy learning pipeline across human and robot demonstrations. A hierarchical learning stack further enables language-conditioned visuomotor control and long-horizon task execution. We evaluate the system across hardware, data collection, and policy learning, and demonstrate mobile-manipulation behaviors requiring dexterity, active perception, navigation, and whole-body coordination. We hope that Pixel provides an integrated and extensible foundation for studying how robot hardware, data, control, and learning can be designed together for robot learning. More results at https://pixel-robot.com/pixel

摘要（中文）：通用型移动操作需要具备高性能机器人硬件、可扩展的示范数据采集、富有表现力的全身控制以及有效的策略学习。然而，这些组件往往是被独立开发的，从而产生不匹配问题，限制了整个系统的能力。我们提出了Pixel，一个面向通用移动操作学习的协同设计全栈系统。Pixel结合了低成本的轮式人形机器人、与人体对齐的运动学结构及柔顺夹爪、多种遥操作和无机器人人工数据采集接口、统一的全身控制器，以及适用于人类和机器人示范数据的通用策略学习流程。此外，分层学习架构进一步实现了语言条件下的视觉运动控制及长时程任务执行。我们在硬件、数据采集和策略学习方面对系统进行了评估，并展示了需要灵巧操作、主动感知、导航和全身协调的移动操作行为。我们希望Pixel为研究机器人硬件、数据、控制和学习如何协同设计以促进机器人学习提供一个集成且可扩展的基础。更多结果请访问 https://pixel-robot.com/pixel

Authors: Tony Tao, Jason Jingzhou Liu, Ruslan Salakhutdinov, Deepak Pathak

Robot-Matched Soft Fingers for UMI Data Collection: Lessons from 100 Hours of Pick and Place Manipulation

UMI data collection soft fingers pick and place VLA policies multi-task learning

简要说明：本文介绍了一种电池供电的手持式通用操作接口（UMI），其带有与机器人夹爪匹配的柔软倾斜手指，可快速收集多任务抓取放置策略的数据。他们收集了53个物体上99.7小时的数据集，训练了π0.5策略，并表明顶部摄像头和中期训练能提高成功率，尤其是在未见过的物体上。

TLDR: This paper introduces a battery-powered handheld Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI) with soft, angled fingers that match the robot's grippers, enabling fast data collection for multi-task pick-and-place policies. They collected a 99.7-hour dataset over 53 objects, trained π0.5 policies, and showed that a top camera and mid-training improve success rates, especially on unseen objects.

Abstract: Training robot policies for multi-task pick and place requires demonstrations on many objects, which handheld Universal Manipulation Interfaces (UMIs) can collect quickly and cheaply. However, existing UMIs depend on external base stations, use rigid fingers that give no signal about contact forces, or use parallel-jaw fingers that limit grip strength. We present a battery-powered handheld interface, built on YUBI, whose soft, angled fingers wrap around objects, deform visibly under load as a visual proxy for force, and match the grippers of the robot. With it, we collect a 99.7-hour dataset over 53 objects, train $π_{0.5}$ policies on 49 of them, and hold out the other 4 as unseen objects. We find that a top camera raises success by 13 points even when only about half of the data includes it, and that mid-training on our multi-task data raises success after fine-tuning on unseen objects from 35% to 57%. Finger design, dataset, and data processing code: https://lute-corp.github.io/soft-yubi-site/

摘要（中文）：训练机器人进行多任务抓取与放置的策略，通常需要针对大量物体采集示范数据。手持式通用操作界面（UMIs）能够快速且低成本地完成这一数据采集任务。然而，现有的UMIs依赖于外部基站，或采用刚性手指而无法提供接触力信号，又或使用平行夹爪式手指而限制了抓取力度。我们提出了一种基于YUBI的电池供电手持式界面，其柔软、带有角度的手指能够包裹住物体，在负载下产生明显的形变，可作为力的视觉代理，并且与机器人的夹爪相匹配。利用该界面，我们采集了涵盖53个物体的99.7小时数据集，并基于其中49个物体训练了\( \pi_{0.5} \)策略，其余4个物体留作未见物体进行测试。实验发现，即使仅有约一半的数据包含顶部相机，其引入也能将成功率提升13个百分点；同时，在我们多任务数据上的中期训练，使得对未见物体进行微调后的成功率从35%提升至57%。手指设计、数据集及数据处理代码见：https://lute-corp.github.io/soft-yubi-site/

Authors: Kobi Kelemen, Tomasz Niedziałkowski, Marcin Paszczak, Victoriano Montesinos

D&A: Decoupling Description and Assessment Enables VLMs as Zero-Shot Robotic Reward Models RLRobot

zero-shot reward models vision-language models confirmation bias mitigation progress estimation reinforcement learning

简要说明：D&A 将基于VLM的机器人奖励估计解耦为客观描述和基于量规的评估，锚定到绝对成功定义，以减轻确认偏差并实现零样本、细粒度的进度预测。它在多个任务上匹配或超越后训练奖励模型，并支持高效的下游强化学习。

TLDR: D&A decouples VLM-based robotic reward estimation into objective description and rubric-based assessment, anchoring to absolute success definitions to mitigate confirmation bias and enable zero-shot, fine-grained progress prediction. It matches or surpasses post-trained reward models across tasks and enables efficient downstream RL.

Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) hold promise for zero-shot video task-progress estimation in robot learning, yet existing frameworks frequently suffer from confirmation bias, hallucinating progress in failed executions due to implicit success assumptions or relative temporal ranking designs. Naive prompting of frontier models collapses into a binary success detector that fails to capture nuanced, non-linear progress and failures. While post-training approaches can mitigate this through explicit training, they demand expensive real-world robotics data and require computationally intensive post-training for every individual base model. To resolve these limitations, we introduce D&A (Describe & Assess): our approach decouples progress estimation into an objective, task-grounded textual description of scene dynamics followed by an assessment phase using explicit rubrics. By compelling the VLM to synthesize an explicit, text-based definition of absolute success before scoring, the framework anchors evaluations to an external, global criterion rather than the video's internal timeline. Empirical results demonstrate that our method calibrates zero-shot estimates and mitigates confirmation bias, providing fine-grained, partial progress metrics that accurately penalize failed executions while correctly interpolating successful runs. Being purely prompt-based, D&A generalizes across tasks, embodiments, and benchmarks---matching or surpassing post-trained reward models---and its reward estimates enable efficient downstream reinforcement learning.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言模型（VLMs）在机器人学习的零样本视频任务进度估计中展现出潜力，然而现有框架常常受到确认偏差的影响，在失败执行中因隐式的成功假设或相对时间排序设计而产生虚假进度幻觉。对前沿模型的简单提示会退化为二元成功检测器，无法捕捉细微的、非线性的进度和失败情况。虽然后训练方法可以通过显式训练缓解这一问题，但这类方法需要昂贵的真实机器人数据，并且需要对每个基础模型进行计算密集的后训练。为了解决这些局限，我们提出了D&A（描述与评估）：该方法将进度估计解耦为对场景动态的客观、基于任务的文本描述，随后使用显式评分细则进行评估。通过促使VLM在评分前合成对绝对成功的显式、基于文本的定义，该框架将评估锚定在外部全局标准上，而非视频内部的时间线。实验结果表明，我们的方法能够校准零样本估计并缓解确认偏差，提供细粒度、部分进度的度量，能够准确惩罚失败执行，同时正确插值成功轨迹。由于D&A纯粹基于提示设计，它能够跨任务、载体和基准进行泛化——匹配或超越后训练的奖励模型——并且其奖励估计能够支持高效的下游强化学习。

Authors: Marius Memmel, Shawn Yin, Urvi Rutia, Angad Wadhwa, Eldon Li, Gavin Angeloff, Ankit Goyal, Jesse Zhang, Dieter Fox, Fabio Ramos, Anqi Li, Abhishek Gupta

Seeing Through the Illusion: Test-Time Scaling for World Action Models WorldModel

test-time scaling world action models rollout selection inverse dynamics closed-loop control

简要说明：WISE 是一种测试时扩展方法，通过评分动作有效性、时间规律性、逆动力学一致性和任务进度，从冻结的世界动作模型中选择最佳 rollout，在 RoboLab 和 LIBERO 基准上提高了闭环成功率。

TLDR: WISE is a test-time scaling method that selects the best rollout from a frozen world action model by scoring candidates on action validity, temporal regularity, inverse-dynamics consistency, and task progress, improving closed-loop success on RoboLab and LIBERO benchmarks.

Abstract: World action models (WAMs) jointly generate actions and imagined futures, but a plausible prediction need not be realized by its co-generated action. We introduce WISE (\emph{World Action Inference Scaling through Evaluation}), a pre-execution selector that scores each sampled rollout on action validity and temporal regularity, inverse-dynamics consistency between the proposed action and the imagined motion, and instruction-conditioned task progress, and executes the highest-scoring candidate while keeping the WAM frozen. With four candidates per decision, WISE raises closed-loop success from 6.0\% to 24.0\% on RoboLab with Cosmos~3 Edge and from 75.1\% to 78.3\% mean success on LIBERO with DreamZero, and exceeds the best existing selector in aggregate by 4.0 and 0.9 points. Component ablations and agreement analyses show that the three scores rank candidates differently and that task progress carries the largest weight in the fused decision.

摘要（中文）：世界动作模型（WAMs）联合生成动作与想象未来，但合理的预测并不一定由其共同生成的动作所实现。我们提出WISE（\emph{通过评估实现世界动作推断扩展}），这是一种预执行选择器，它根据动作有效性与时间规律性、所提动作与想象运动之间的逆动力学一致性，以及指令条件下的任务进展，对每个采样轨迹进行评分，并在保持WAM冻结的同时执行得分最高的候选动作。在每次决策使用四个候选的情况下，WISE将RoboLab上使用Cosmos 3 Edge的闭环成功率从6.0\%提升至24.0\%，将LIBERO上使用DreamZero的平均成功率从75.1\%提升至78.3\%，并且在总体表现上超越现有最佳选择器4.0个和0.9个百分点。组件消融实验与一致性分析表明，三项评分对候选动作的排序方式不同，其中任务进展在融合决策中所占权重最大。

Authors: Cheikh Ahmed, Mahdi Mostajabdaveh, Milad Yazdani, Zirui Zhou

FloMo: 3D Scene Flow as a World Action Model Intermediate for Learning from Human Video VLA

3D scene flow video generation robot policy action tokens human video pretraining

简要说明：FloMo 提出将 3D 场景流作为视频生成模型的中间表示，从而高效地将互联网规模的运动先验迁移到机器人动作预测中，并通过预测运动而非完整视频来提升泛化能力。

TLDR: FloMo proposes using 3D scene flow as an intermediate representation for a video-generation model, enabling efficient transfer of internet-scale motion priors to robot action prediction and improving generalization by predicting motion rather than full video.

Abstract: Pretrained video generation models distill internet-scale motion priors into robot policies, but full video is a redundant signal for action prediction. We argue that dense 3D motion is the medium through which video pretraining best transfers to robot actions, and that predicting motion rather than video affords better sample-efficiency for action prediction. FloMo is a 5B video-generation model fine-tuned to predict 3D scene-flow and action tokens. Rendering scene flow as RGB and encoding it into the same latent space as video enables a pretrained video generation backbone to efficiently adapt to predict 3D scene flow. Co-trained on action-free human video and action-labeled robot teleoperation data, our model benefits from human-video pretraining and generalizes to unseen objects, motion primitives, and tasks. Replacing motion prediction with a video prediction objective degrades out-of-distribution generalization, while adding a video prediction target alongside motion lowers policy success rather than improving it. When motion, video, and action are predicted jointly, action tokens attend far more to motion than to video, suggesting that predicting video wastes model capacity. Together, these results indicate that motion effectively mediates the transfer from video pretraining to action. More information can be found at flomo-wam.github.io.

摘要（中文）：预训练的视频生成模型将互联网规模的运动先验知识提炼到机器人策略中，但完整视频对于动作预测而言是一种冗余信号。我们认为，稠密三维运动是视频预训练最佳地迁移到机器人动作的中介，而预测运动而非视频能够为动作预测带来更高的样本效率。FloMo是一个50亿参数规模的视频生成模型，经过微调用于预测三维场景流和动作标记。将场景流渲染为RGB并编码到与视频相同的潜在空间中，使得预训练的视频生成骨干网络能够高效地适应三维场景流预测。通过在无动作的人类视频和带动作标注的机器人遥操作数据上进行联合训练，我们的模型受益于人类视频预训练，并泛化到未见过的物体、运动基元和任务。用视频预测目标替代运动预测会降低分布外泛化能力，而在运动之外增加视频预测目标会降低策略成功率而非提升它。当运动、视频和动作被联合预测时，动作标记对运动的关注远多于对视频的关注，这表明预测视频浪费了模型容量。综合来看，这些结果表明运动有效地中介了从视频预训练到动作的迁移。更多信息可访问 flomo-wam.github.io。

Authors: Jeremy Collins, Namra Patel, Ayush Agarwal, Shitij Govil, Animesh Garg

Controlling Action-Head Co-Adaptation to VLM Representation Anisotropy VLA

Vision-Language-Action Models Representation Anisotropy Interface Co-adaptation Adaptive Interface Equalizer Robotic Manipulation

简要说明：该论文研究了VLA模型中动作头如何适应预训练VLM表示的各向异性几何，并提出一种免参数机制（AdaIE）来重新加权表示，从而在仿真和真实世界操作中提升下游控制性能。

TLDR: This paper studies how action heads in VLA models adapt to the anisotropic geometry of pretrained VLM representations, and proposes a parameter-free mechanism (AdaIE) that reweights representations to improve downstream control performance in simulation and real-world manipulation.

Abstract: Modern learning systems increasingly combine pretrained models with downstream heads. Despite the growing importance of such modular designs, how the downstream model co-adapts to the geometry of pretrained representations remains relatively underexplored. We study this problem through vision-language-action models (VLAs), where a pretrained vision-language model (VLM) conditions an action model for control. We find that the action model progressively concentrates its sensitivity on high-variance dimensions of the VLM outputs. Through controlled experiments across different backbone-head models, we further show that counteracting this sensitivity concentration can be beneficial under representation--task mismatch settings. Motivated by these observations, we introduce \emph{Adaptive Interface Equalizer} (AdaIE), a parameter-free mechanism that reweights pretrained representations according to the evolving downstream sensitivity during training. AdaIE improves VLA success rates on simulation benchmarks, with gains of up to $+5.28$ percentage points (pp) on RoboCasa-GR1 and $+1.68$ pp on RoboTwin 2.0, and achieves an average gain of $+19$ pp across five real-world manipulation tasks. It further generalizes to diffusion policies and world models, improving downstream performance in both settings. Our results highlight interface co-adaptation as an important optimization problem when coupling pretrained representations with downstream models.

摘要（中文）：现代学习系统日益将预训练模型与下游任务头相结合。尽管此类模块化设计的重要性与日俱增，但下游模型如何与预训练表征的几何结构协同适应，这一问题仍未得到充分探索。我们通过视觉-语言-动作模型（VLAs）来研究该问题，其中预训练的视觉-语言模型（VLM）为动作模型提供条件以进行控制。我们发现，动作模型在训练过程中逐渐将其敏感性集中于VLM输出的高方差维度上。通过在不同主干-任务头模型上进行的受控实验，我们进一步表明，在表征-任务不匹配的设置下，抵消这种敏感性集中可能是有益的。基于这些观察，我们提出了\emph{自适应接口均衡器}（AdaIE），这是一种无参数机制，在训练过程中根据不断变化的下游敏感性对预训练表征进行重新加权。AdaIE在模拟基准测试中提升了VLA的成功率，在RoboCasa-GR1上提升了高达$+5.28$个百分点（pp），在RoboTwin 2.0上提升了$+1.68$个百分点，并在五项真实世界操作任务中实现了平均$+19$个百分点的提升。该方法还进一步推广到扩散策略和世界模型，在两种设置下均提升了下游性能。我们的研究结果凸显了在将预训练表征与下游模型耦合时，接口协同适应是一个重要的优化问题。

Authors: Ruijie Zhang, Jiayin Zheng, Yequan Zhao, Liyan Tan, Ziyue Liu, Zhengyang Wang, Kunpeng Song, Nathan Zhao, Jian Yao, Yin Zhang, Zheng Zhang

IGSW: Multi-Weather Urban Scene Reconstruction with Intrinsic-Decoupled Gaussian Splatting AutonomousDriving

4D Gaussian Splatting multi-weather scene reconstruction intrinsic decomposition autonomous driving simulation weather editing

简要说明：IGSW提出一种结合固有解耦4D高斯溅射与结构保持天气细化的两阶段框架，用于面向自动驾驶仿真的多天气城市场景重建，实现高保真和时序一致性。

TLDR: IGSW proposes a two-stage framework combining intrinsic-decoupled 4D Gaussian splatting with structure-preserving weather refinement for multi-weather urban scene reconstruction, targeting autonomous driving simulation with high fidelity and temporal consistency.

Abstract: High-fidelity weather editing of 4D scenes can support end-to-end training and closed-loop simulation for autonomous driving. Combining generative image editing with dynamic Gaussian representations enables multi-weather scene reconstruction, but weather-edited images often contain structural distortions. Directly fitting their appearance may propagate errors from teacher images into the reconstructed 4D scene, compromising the original scene structure and temporal continuity. To address these challenges, we propose IGSW, a two-stage framework that combines intrinsic-decoupled 4D Gaussian scene modeling with structure-preserving weather refinement. In Stage I, background Gaussian appearance is decomposed into weather-shared albedo and normals and weather-specific irradiance and residuals. Weather teacher images generated by a diffusion-based image editing model and intrinsic maps estimated by a diffusion-based inverse renderer provide feature-level soft supervision for stable structure and illumination changes. In Stage II, a structure-preservation gate combines semantic conflicts with cross-weather intrinsic discrepancies to suppress unreliable teacher regions. Per-Gaussian weather transport variables and target-weather branches then strengthen the desired weather appearance over the intrinsic-decoupled scene. Experiments on nuScenes and Waymo show that IGSW achieves the highest content similarity and semantic consistency and the lowest temporal error among the compared methods, while retaining pronounced weather-dependent illumination and atmosphere. The project page is available at https://akaxi6.github.io/IGSW/ .

摘要（中文）：高保真度的4D场景天气编辑能够支持自动驾驶的端到端训练与闭环仿真。将生成式图像编辑与动态高斯表示相结合，可实现多天气场景的重建，但经天气编辑后的图像常存在结构畸变。若直接拟合其外观，可能会将教师图像中的误差传播至重建的4D场景中，从而破坏原始场景的结构与时间连续性。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了IGSW，一个将内在解耦的4D高斯场景建模与结构保持的天气细化相结合的两阶段框架。在第一阶段，背景高斯外观被分解为天气共享的反照率与法线，以及天气特定的辐照度与残差。由基于扩散的图像编辑模型生成的天气教师图像，以及由基于扩散的逆渲染器估计的内在图，提供了特征级软监督，以稳定结构变化与光照变化。在第二阶段，结构保持门控结合语义冲突与跨天气内在差异，抑制不可靠的教师区域。随后，逐高斯的天气传输变量与目标天气分支在内在解耦场景上强化期望的天气外观。在nuScenes与Waymo上的实验表明，IGSW在对比方法中取得了最高的内容相似度与语义一致性，以及最低的时间误差，同时保留了显著的天气相关光照与氛围。项目页面见 https://akaxi6.github.io/IGSW/ 。

Authors: Zhongquan Wang, Long Cao, Peijia Xie, Senlei Ma, Jie Li, Guofa Li

ReconDreamer#: Self-Evolving Closed-Loop Synergy of Reconstruction and Generation for Dynamic Driving Scenes AutonomousDriving

dynamic driving scene reconstruction generative priors closed-loop self-evolving geometry-prior adaptive ground model novel trajectory rendering

简要说明：ReconDreamer# 提出了一种自进化的闭环框架，通过重建与生成的迭代互增强来提升动态驾驶场景的质量，并引入基于几何先验的自适应地面模型，在多个自动驾驶基准上取得了显著改进。

TLDR: ReconDreamer# introduces a self-evolving closed-loop framework that iteratively refines reconstruction and generation for dynamic driving scenes, using a geometry-prior-based adaptive ground model to enhance rendering quality, and demonstrates significant improvements on multiple autonomous driving benchmarks.

Abstract: Dynamic driving scene reconstruction has made remarkable strides in recent years by leveraging generative priors, particularly in the quality of novel trajectory rendering. Nevertheless, a significant gap remains between the generated data and real-world sensor observations, severely hindering further improvements in reconstruction fidelity. In this paper, we present ReconDreamer#, a self-evolving framework that synergizes reconstruction and generation for dynamic driving scenes, which substantially bridges the gap between synthesized novel trajectory data and recorded real-world observations. Within this self-evolving closed-loop framework, the generative and reconstruction models mutually reinforce each other through iterative refinement, ultimately yielding a significant enhancement in the 3D representation capability of the reconstruction model. Additionally, we introduce a geometry-prior-based adaptive ground model to further enhance the rendering quality of the reconstruction model. To validate the effectiveness of the proposed method, we conduct comprehensive evaluations on Waymo, nuScenes, PandaSet, and EUVS benchmarks. Specifically on Waymo, at a 6-m lateral shift, ReconDreamer# improves NTA-IoU and NTL-IoU by 8.8% and 3.0%, respectively, and reduces FID by 15.1% relative to ReconDreamer++.

摘要（中文）：动态驾驶场景重建近年来借助生成先验取得了显著进展，尤其是在新轨迹渲染的质量方面。然而，生成数据与真实传感器观测之间仍存在显著差距，严重阻碍了重建保真度的进一步提升。本文提出了ReconDreamer#，一种自进化的框架，将重建与生成相结合，用于动态驾驶场景，从而有效弥合了合成新轨迹数据与记录的真实观测之间的差距。在该自进化闭环框架中，生成模型与重建模型通过迭代优化相互增强，最终显著提升了重建模型的三维表示能力。此外，我们引入了一种基于几何先验的自适应地面模型，以进一步提升重建模型的渲染质量。为验证所提方法的有效性，我们在Waymo、nuScenes、PandaSet和EUVS基准上进行了全面评估。具体而言，在Waymo数据集中，当横向偏移为6米时，ReconDreamer#的NTA-IoU和NTL-IoU分别提升了8.8%和3.0%，同时相对于ReconDreamer++，FID降低了15.1%。

Authors: Songling Liu, Guosheng Zhao, Xiaofeng Wang, Chaojun Ni, Guan Huang, Jiwen Lu, Xingang Wang, Zheng Zhu

FlowBench: Counterfactual Imagination Training for Spatial Intelligence WorldModel

Counterfactual Spatial Imagination world models vision-language models text-to-flow prediction sim-to-real transfer

简要说明：FlowBench 提出了反事实空间想象（CSI）任务，构建了包含42.8万个样本的数据集和自动流程，用于训练和评估视觉语言模型与世界模型在假设运动下的场景变化想象能力，并展示了从仿真到真实场景的显著性能提升（例如Qwen3-VL-8B提升29.5个百分点）以及文本到光流预测的改进。

TLDR: FlowBench introduces Counterfactual Spatial Imagination (CSI) with a 428K-example dataset and pipeline for training/evaluating VLMs and world models on imagining scene changes under hypothetical motions, showing sim-to-real gains (e.g., +29.5% on Qwen3-VL-8B) and improvements in text-to-flow prediction.

Abstract: Humans imagine scene changes under hypothetical motions, an ability central to spatial reasoning and robotic planning. However, this capability remains underexplored in vision-language models and world models. We formalize this capability as Counterfactual Spatial Imagination (CSI) and introduce FlowBench, a resource for training and evaluating both, with 428K training examples spanning simulated and real-world scenes, household environments and tabletop manipulation, and diverse question types. A scalable, fully automatic pipeline pairs each hypothetical motion with spatial questions and, in simulation, exact outcome frames and optical flow. For VLMs, proprietary models exhibit an imagination gap, performing worse when motion outcomes must be inferred than when observed, and open-source models perform near chance; fine-tuning Qwen3-VL-8B on FlowBench-Sim-Train raises its accuracy by 29.5 percentage points in simulation and 16.9 on real images, a strong sim-to-real transfer. For world models, training on FlowBench-Sim improves text-to-flow prediction for all four model families we test, raising the accuracy of Psi-0.6 from 52.1% to 61.7%. FlowBench thus serves as a training and evaluation resource for both. Code and datasets are released at https://github.com/liuyifan22/FlowBench.

摘要（中文）：人类能够在假设运动下想象场景变化，这种能力对空间推理和机器人规划至关重要。然而，这一能力在视觉语言模型和世界模型中仍未得到充分探索。我们将这种能力形式化为“反事实空间想象”（Counterfactual Spatial Imagination, CSI），并引入FlowBench——一个用于训练和评估上述两类模型的资源，包含42.8万个训练样本，覆盖模拟与现实场景、家庭环境和桌面操作，以及多种问题类型。我们设计了一条可扩展的全自动流水线，将每个假设运动与空间问题配对，并在仿真环境中提供精确的结果帧和光流信息。对于视觉语言模型，专有模型表现出“想象差距”——在需要推断运动结果时表现逊于直接观察时，而开源模型的表现接近随机水平；在FlowBench-Sim-Train上微调Qwen3-VL-8B后，其在仿真环境中的准确率提升了29.5个百分点，在真实图像上提升了16.9个百分点，展现了强大的仿真到真实迁移能力。对于世界模型，在FlowBench-Sim上训练改善了我们测试的所有四类模型的文本到光流预测性能，将Psi-0.6的准确率从52.1%提升至61.7%。因此，FlowBench可作为这两类模型的训练和评估资源。代码和数据集已发布于https://github.com/liuyifan22/FlowBench。

Authors: Yifan Liu, Baihan Zhang, Khai Loong Aw, Klemen Kotar, Daniel L. K. Yamins

RoboTryOn: Synthesizing Dexterous Robot Demonstrations from Human Videos via Virtual Try-On Manipulation

human-to-robot translation virtual try-on inverse dynamics model bimanual manipulation synthetic demonstrations

简要说明：RoboTryOn 通过‘虚拟试穿’将人的运动迁移到高自由度人形机器人上，把第一人称人类视频转换为机器人演示视频，并利用逆动力学模型训练策略，在新型双手操作任务上取得了显著效果，成本远低于遥操作。

TLDR: RoboTryOn converts egocentric human videos into robot demonstration videos for high-DoF humanoid embodiments by 'virtual try-on' of the robot onto the human motion, and trains policies with these synthetic videos using an inverse dynamics model, achieving strong performance on novel bimanual tasks at lower cost than teleoperation.

Abstract: Robot foundation models have shown remarkable performance in robot control, yet adapting them to a new task still relies heavily on teleoperated demonstrations. Egocentric human videos offer a scalable substitute, but overlaying rendered robots on human videos or retargeting human poses into robot actions leaves significant visual or action gaps for high-DoF robot embodiments. To address this limitation, we propose RoboTryOn, which treats human-to-robot translation as virtual try-on: try-on keeps the person and swaps the garment, RoboTryOn keeps the demonstrated motion and swaps the human for the robot. Specifically, RoboTryOn converts a human video into a video of the target robot specified by a reference image, while preserving the original task, objects, and background. To maintain visual consistency, we translate selected keyframes autoregressively and use them to guide video synthesis with motion conditioned on the human hand skeleton. Additionally, we use an inverse dynamics model (IDM) that incorporates depth features to infer action labels from synthesized videos for policy learning. Our experiments across multiple humanoid embodiments show that policies trained with our synthetic data improve the average success rate on novel tasks, including challenging bimanual manipulation, from 2% to 60%, without any real robot demonstration of those tasks. Moreover, training with our synthetic data matches the performance of policies trained solely on teleoperated demonstrations at approximately a third of the collection cost, demonstrating the cost efficiency of our approach.

摘要（中文）：机器人基础模型在机器人控制中展现出卓越的性能，然而将其适配至新任务仍严重依赖遥操作演示。第一人称人类视频提供了一种可扩展的替代方案，但在人类视频上叠加渲染机器人或将人类姿态重定向为机器人动作，对于高自由度机器人本体而言，会留下显著的视觉或动作鸿沟。为解决这一局限，我们提出RoboTryOn，将人类到机器人的转换视为虚拟试穿：试穿保留人物而替换衣物，RoboTryOn则保留演示动作而将人类替换为机器人。具体而言，RoboTryOn将人类视频转换为由参考图像指定的目标机器人的视频，同时保留原始任务、物体和背景。为保持视觉一致性，我们自回归地翻译选定关键帧，并利用它们引导以人类手部骨骼为条件的视频合成。此外，我们采用融合深度特征的逆动力学模型（IDM），从合成视频中推断动作标签以用于策略学习。我们在多种仿人机器人本体上的实验表明，使用我们的合成数据训练的策略，在新任务（包括具有挑战性的双臂操作）上的平均成功率从2%提升至60%，且无需任何真实机器人演示这些任务。此外，使用我们的合成数据进行训练，其策略性能与仅依赖遥操作演示训练的策略相当，而采集成本约为后者的三分之一，充分证明了我们方法在成本效益上的优势。

Authors: Seungyong Lee, Suhyeok Jang, Minyoung Kim, Jinwoo Shin

Physics-Based Plausibility Assessment of AI-Predicted Vehicle Parameters for Automotive Radar in Pre-Crash Scenarios AutonomousDriving

physics-based consistency automotive radar vehicle heading estimation pre-crash scenarios Wasserstein distance

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于物理的一致性评估框架，通过比较预期和实际雷达签名来验证AI预测的车辆参数，从而改善碰撞前场景中的航向估计。

TLDR: This paper introduces a physics-based consistency assessment framework that validates AI-predicted vehicle parameters in automotive radar by comparing expected and observed radar signatures, improving heading estimation in pre-crash scenarios.

Abstract: Automotive radar is a key sensing modality for safety-critical vehicle functions due to its robustness under adverse weather and lighting conditions. Recent advances in AI-based radar perception enable the direct estimation of object parameters from a single radar measurement cycle. However, the internal decision process of data-driven models is typically not explicitly linked to the underlying radar sensing physics. Consequently, object estimates may achieve high statistical accuracy while remaining physically inconsistent with the measured radar signature, particularly in previously unseen scenarios. Such inconsistencies are especially critical for heading estimation, as they directly affect trajectory prediction and collision assessment in pre-crash scenarios. This paper presents a physics-based consistency assessment framework for validating AI-derived vehicle hypotheses in automotive radar perception. The proposed approach generates an expected radar signature from AI-estimated object parameters using a physics-based reference model that incorporates occlusion-dependent edge visibility, aspect- and angle-dependent RCS modeling, and characteristic wheel-induced MD signatures. The expected signature is compared with the observed radar point cloud using a Wasserstein-distance-based consistency metric computed from three complementary features: the spatial distribution of detections along object edges, the local detection count, and the radar reflection intensity. In this way, physically implausible object hypotheses can be identified and corrected independently of the underlying neural network architecture and without model retraining or architectural modifications. The proposed consistency module is integrated as a cascaded post-processing stage for vehicle heading estimation.

摘要（中文）：汽车雷达因其在恶劣天气和光照条件下的鲁棒性，是安全关键型车辆功能的关键感知方式。近年来，基于人工智能的雷达感知技术取得了进展，使得能够从单个雷达测量周期中直接估计目标参数。然而，数据驱动模型的内部决策过程通常并未与底层雷达感知物理原理明确关联。因此，目标估计虽然在统计上可能达到较高精度，但在物理层面却可能与实际测量的雷达特征不一致，尤其是在未见过的场景中。这种不一致性对航向角估计尤为关键，因为它直接影响预碰撞场景中的轨迹预测和碰撞评估。本文提出了一种基于物理的一致性评估框架，用于验证汽车雷达感知中基于人工智能的车辆假设。所提出的方法利用基于物理的参考模型，从人工智能估计的目标参数生成预期雷达特征，该模型包含遮挡相关的边缘可见性、方位角和角度相关的雷达散射截面建模，以及特征性的车轮引起的微多普勒特征。利用基于Wasserstein距离的一致性度量，从三个互补特征（目标边缘上检测点的空间分布、局部检测计数和雷达反射强度）出发，将预期特征与观测到的雷达点云进行比较。通过这种方式，可以在不依赖底层神经网络架构的情况下，识别并修正物理上不合理的车辆目标假设，且无需模型重新训练或架构修改。所提出的一致性模块作为级联后处理阶段集成到车辆航向角估计中。

Authors: Rainer Engert, Patrick Zaumseil, Thomas Brandmeier

CLARA: A Cognitively-Driven Clarification Framework for Grounding Ambiguous Requests VLA

clarification framework large vision-language models ambiguous requests diffusion-based image generation robotic arrangement

简要说明：CLARA 是一个澄清框架，利用大型视觉语言模型针对模糊指令向用户提问，并生成期望场景的视觉渲染以确认理解，适用于机器人整理任务。

TLDR: CLARA is a clarification framework that uses large vision-language models to ask users targeted questions about ambiguous instructions, then generates a visual rendering of the desired scene to confirm understanding for robotic arrangement tasks.

Abstract: Robotics and AI systems are increasingly deploying large vision-language models (LVLMs) to follow high-level instructions, from routine household chores to more complex organizational tasks. Yet, broad directives like "clean the room" or "organize the desk" frequently omit crucial details about user preferences and specific arrangement of objects that influence the desired outcome. Without any further guidance, such models tend to overestimate their grasp of ambiguous instructions and frequently assume they have sufficient understanding despite missing important details. In this paper, we propose CLARA (Conversational cLArification for Robotic Arrangement), a cognitively-driven clarification framework that proactively elicits key information from users, in a similar fashion as humans' clarification seeking behavior. Through targeted questioning, CLARA refines ambiguous requests into structured, detailed instructions describing precisely how objects should be organized or rearranged, according to the user's preferences. These clarifications then guide a diffusion-based image generation pipeline, producing realistic visual renderings of the final, desired scene. This final rendering also serves as a visual confirmation of the system's understanding from the user. Experimental results and user studies demonstrate that CLARA leads to more accurate and consistent outcomes compared to another State-of-the-Art LVLM system, highlighting the importance of interactive clarification for bridging the gap between vague directives and fully grounded task specifications.

摘要（中文）：机器人学与人工智能系统正越来越多地部署大型视觉-语言模型（LVLMs），以执行从日常家务到更为复杂的组织任务在内的高级指令。然而，诸如“打扫房间”或“整理书桌”这类宽泛指令，常常遗漏了关于用户偏好及影响预期结果的物体具体摆放方式等关键细节。在缺乏进一步指导的情况下，这类模型往往会高估其对模糊指令的理解能力，并经常在缺失重要细节的情况下假定自己已充分理解。在本文中，我们提出了CLARA（面向机器人布置的对话式澄清框架），这是一种认知驱动的澄清框架，能够主动向用户获取关键信息，其方式类似于人类寻求澄清的行为。通过有针对性的提问，CLARA将模糊的请求细化为结构化的详细指令，精确描述物体应如何根据用户偏好进行组织或重新布置。这些澄清随后引导基于扩散的图像生成流程，产生最终期望场景的逼真视觉渲染。这一最终渲染还可作为系统理解是否准确的视觉确认，供用户验证。实验结果表明，与另一种最先进的LVLM系统相比，CLARA能够带来更准确、更一致的结果，凸显了交互式澄清在弥合模糊指令与完全具体化任务规范之间差距方面的重要性。

Authors: Dimitrios Bekris, Marios Glytsos, Panagiotis P. Filntisis, Niki Efthymiou, George Retsinas, Petros Maragos

Aero-VPA: Few-Step Flow-Matching Control over Non-Reconstructive JEPA Latents for Agile Flight on Edge Hardware VLA

Vision-Predictor-Action JEPA latent prediction Conditional Flow Matching edge hardware agile flight

简要说明：Aero-VPA 提出了一种轻量级的视觉-预测-动作架构，用于边缘硬件上的敏捷四旋翼飞行，采用非重建 JEPA 潜在预测器和流匹配动作生成，在 PX4 软件在环仿真中的闭环评估表明，无地图运行时防护罩显著提高了成功率。

TLDR: Aero-VPA introduces a lightweight Vision-Predictor-Action architecture for agile quadrotor flight on edge hardware, using a non-reconstructive JEPA latent predictor and flow-matching action generation, with closed-loop PX4 SITL evaluations showing a map-free runtime shield significantly improves success rates.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models generalize across tasks, but their autoregressive decoders need sequential forward passes in proportion to the action horizon, each bounded below on embedded aerial platforms by streaming billions of parameters from memory. We present Aero-VPA, a lightweight Vision-Predictor-Action architecture for 3D navigation on edge hardware. A compact RGB-D Vision Transformer and a five-head ensemble predictor, trained without pixel reconstruction, forecast the next latent state; a Conditional Flow Matching solver generates a velocity and yaw-rate chunk in two Euler steps, so each decision takes five sequential network evaluations; and the ensemble dispersion drives an uncertainty fallback. Version 1 specified the architecture, deployment and protocol without results. This version reports the first closed-loop evaluation: PX4 software-in-the-loop simulation of quadrotor missions in procedurally generated forests. Behaviour cloning failed on all 60 missions despite open-loop errors of 0.02-0.04 m/s: the policy copies its last command, a copycat form of causal confusion. DAgger with a privileged, safety-gated supervisor gave the first successes but plateaued at 11.1-21.1% across six checkpoints. A map-free runtime shield with a 15 s depth memory, barrier constraints, a cap on motion outside the 73-degree field of view and backoff along the flown path raised the first DAgger policy's success on 180 paired missions from 21.1% to 52.2% (95% CI [45.0, 59.4]; exact McNemar p = 1.2 x 10^-10) and cut its crashes from 72.2% to 22.2%, while timeouts rose from 2.8% to 23.3%. All six checkpoints gained 30.0-34.4 percentage points, at mean speeds of 1.16-1.36 m/s. The code (https://github.com/ylee-sling/Aero-VPA), the trained policy (72.6 MB, https://huggingface.co/ylee-sling/aero-vpa) and the full benchmark dataset are public.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型能够跨任务泛化，但其自回归解码器需要按动作时域长度进行顺序前向传播，在嵌入式空中平台上，每一步都受限于从内存中流式读取数十亿参数。我们提出Aero-VPA，一种用于边缘硬件上三维导航的轻量级视觉-预测器-动作架构。一个紧凑的RGB-D视觉Transformer和一个五头集成预测器（无需像素重建训练）预测下一潜在状态；一个条件流匹配求解器在两个欧拉步骤中生成速度和偏航率块，因此每次决策只需五次顺序网络评估；集成离散度驱动不确定性回退机制。版本1规定了架构、部署和协议但未报告结果。本版本报告首次闭环评估：在程序化生成的森林环境中进行PX4软件在环四旋翼任务仿真。尽管开环误差仅为0.02-0.04 m/s，行为克隆在所有60项任务中均失败：该策略复制其最后指令，这是一种因果混淆的模仿形式。DAgger结合特权安全门控监督器首次取得成功，但在六个检查点处仅达到11.1%-21.1%的成功率。一个无地图运行时防护罩，配备15秒深度记忆、势垒约束、对73度视场外运动的限制以及沿飞行路径的回退机制，将首个DAgger策略在180对配对任务上的成功率从21.1%提升至52.2%（95%置信区间[45.0， 59.4]；精确McNemar检验p = 1.2 × 10⁻¹⁰），并将崩溃率从72.2%降至22.2%，同时超时率从2.8%上升至23.3%。所有六个检查点均获得30.0-34.4个百分点的提升，平均速度为1.16-1.36 m/s。代码（https://github.com/ylee-sling/Aero-VPA）、训练好的策略（72.6 MB，https://huggingface.co/ylee-sling/aero-vpa）及完整基准数据集均已公开。

Authors: Yeonseok Lee

RAIPAL: A Powerful and Agile Humanoid Arm for Human Tasks HumanoidEmbodied

humanoid manipulator hardware design payload endpoint speed thermal analysis

简要说明：本文介绍了一种人形机械臂硬件平台RAIPAL，其性能指标源自人类上肢测量数据，实现了20公斤负载、20.6米/秒的末端速度，并在负载-持续时间上超越人类极限。

TLDR: This paper presents RAIPAL, a humanoid arm hardware platform with human-derived performance targets, achieving a 20 kg payload, 20.6 m/s endpoint speed, and sustained operation beyond human load-duration boundaries.

Abstract: This paper presents humanoid manipulator hardware designed specifically for human-level performance throughout its broad domain of tasks, from heavy payloads to highly dynamic motions. Unlike conventional designs targeting uniform workspace capability, the proposed approach derives force, speed, and endurance targets from published measurements of task-relevant human upper-limb performance. These targets guide the actuator, mechanism, and thermal design toward torque transparency and sustained operation. The platform integrates force-oriented upper-arm components, speed-oriented forearm components, and a posture-dependent elbow mechanism that shifts its torque-speed behavior. These components are driven by planetary actuators and compact actuator-embedded electronics. Experimental results validate broad task capability, demonstrating a peak payload of 20 kg (2.25x its own mass), an endpoint speed of 20.6 m/s, and continued operation under repeated hammering impacts. Thermal analysis further confirms that the robot's sustained operation capability exceeds the published human load--duration boundary across nearly the entire load spectrum. These findings show that hardware targets derived from human-task measurements narrow the human-to-humanoid capability gap. A supplementary video is available at https://youtu.be/xVUWFICD5G0

摘要（中文）：本文介绍了一款专为实现人类水平性能而设计的人形机械臂硬件，其应用范围广泛，涵盖从重载荷到高动态运动的各类任务。不同于传统设计追求均匀的工作空间能力，本方法基于已发布的人体上肢任务相关性能测量数据，推导出力、速度和耐久性目标。这些目标引导执行器、机构及热设计朝向扭矩透明化和持续运行的方向发展。该平台集成了面向力的上臂部件、面向速度的前臂部件，以及一个随姿态变化而调整扭矩-速度特性的肘部机构。这些部件由行星执行器和紧凑型执行器嵌入式电子设备驱动。实验结果验证了其广泛的任务能力，展示了20公斤（为其自身质量的2.25倍）的峰值载荷、20.6米/秒的末端速度，以及在反复锤击冲击下的持续运行能力。热分析进一步证实，该机器人的持续运行能力在几乎整个载荷谱范围内超越了已发布的人体负荷-持续时间边界。这些发现表明，基于人体任务测量得到的硬件目标缩小了人与仿人机器人之间的能力差距。补充视频见https://youtu.be/xVUWFICD5G0。

Authors: Donggeon Kim, Hyungho Chris Choi, Donghyuk Choi, Jeongsoo Park, Choongin Lee, Chan Park, Jemin Hwangbo

Online iLQR-MPC with Whole-Body Control for Robust Humanoid Locomotion Locomotion

iLQR-MPC whole-body control humanoid locomotion contact force optimization

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于人形机器人运动控制的在线 iLQR-MPC 框架，在单个滚动时域问题中利用单刚体模型联合优化落脚点位置和接触力，并通过全身控制器将计划映射到关节力矩。在 MuJoCo 仿真中，该方法在 Unitree G1 上表现出对冲击推力的鲁棒性。

TLDR: This paper presents an online iLQR-MPC framework for humanoid locomotion that jointly optimizes footstep locations and contact forces in a single receding-horizon problem using a single-rigid-body model, with a whole-body controller mapping plans to joint torques. The approach demonstrates robustness to impulsive pushes in MuJoCo simulations on the Unitree G1 humanoid.

Abstract: Humanoid locomotion requires deciding where to step and how to distribute contact forces. However, a disturbance can invalidate the nominal plan, requiring coordinated revision under constraints that switch with every footfall. To solve this online, the proposed approach employs the single-rigid-body model, which retains attitude dynamics and the full contact wrench. An iterative linear-quadratic-regulator MPC (iLQR-MPC) then jointly optimizes contact forces and footstep locations in a single receding-horizon problem, without a separate step planner. Specifically, contact and motion constraints are incorporated into the backward pass through augmented-Lagrangian and relaxed-barrier penalties. A whole-body controller subsequently maps the plan to joint torques at 500 Hz while preserving contact feasibility. The model-based formulation makes disturbance responses interpretable through explicit costs and constraints, and requires no platform-specific policy training. In MuJoCo simulations, the iLQR-MPC replans at 100 Hz (mean solve time 8.9 ms); the Unitree G1 sustains steady-state walking and recovers from impulsive 245 N forward and 175 N lateral pushes.

摘要（中文）：人形机器人 locomotion 需要在每一步决定落脚位置以及如何分配接触力。然而，外部扰动可能使名义规划失效，从而需要在每一步触地时随约束切换进行协调修正。为在线解决该问题，所提方法采用单刚体模型，该模型保留了姿态动力学和完整接触力旋量。随后，迭代线性二次型调节器模型预测控制（iLQR-MPC）在单一滚动时域问题中联合优化接触力与落脚位置，无需独立的步态规划器。具体地，接触与运动约束通过增广拉格朗日罚函数和松弛障碍罚函数纳入后向递推过程。随后，一个全身控制器以 500 Hz 的频率将规划映射为关节力矩，同时保持接触可行性。该基于模型的公式化使得扰动响应可通过显式代价和约束进行解释，且无需针对特定平台进行策略训练。在 MuJoCo 仿真中，iLQR-MPC 以 100 Hz 频率进行重规划（平均求解时间为 8.9 毫秒）；Unitree G1 能够保持稳态行走，并从 245 N 前向和 175 N 侧向冲击性推力中恢复。

Authors: Xiang Li, Linlin Ou, Ruihan Wu, Xinyi Yu

Grasping and Stabilizing Tumbling Objects with Rotating-Base Multi-Arm Space Manipulators Manipulation

space manipulator tumbling object capture synchronization control Hamiltonian optimal control grasping

简要说明：本文提出了一种空间机械臂的制导与控制方法，通过主动机动基座与翻滚目标同步，并在抓取后利用基于哈密顿动力学的最优控制实现消旋稳定。

TLDR: This paper proposes a guidance and control method for space manipulators to grasp and stabilize tumbling objects by actively maneuvering the base to synchronize with the target, followed by post-grasp Hamiltonian-based optimal control for detumbling.

Abstract: This paper presents an innovative guidance and control method for a space manipulator that actively maneuvers its base to hold a tumbling object stationary relative to the base during proximity operations. This simplifies motion planning, reduces collision risk, and enables impact-free capture using single- or multi-arm configurations, with or without predefined grasping interfaces. The proposed approach involves two phases. In the pre-grasping phase, a synchronization control aligns the target's center of mass (CoM) with the system's instantaneous center of rotation (ICR), virtually rigidizing the target-servicer system to keep the object stationary for reliable grasping. In the post grasping phase, a control strategy based on Hamiltonian dynamics and optimal control stabilizes the combined system by minimizing time, fuel, or energy, while respecting base torque limits and multiple grasping constraints. For structured targets, applied forces and torques stay within their bounds; for unstructured ones, friction constraints prevent slipping. A case study demonstrates the method's effectiveness in enabling both the subsequent grasping and detumbling phases.

摘要（中文）：本文提出了一种创新的空间机械臂制导与控制方法，该方法在近距离操作过程中，通过主动机动其基座，使翻滚目标相对于基座保持静止。这简化了运动规划，降低了碰撞风险，并实现了使用单臂或多臂配置的无冲击捕获，无论是否具有预定义的抓取接口。所提出的方法包括两个阶段。在抓取前阶段，一种同步控制将目标的质心与系统的瞬时旋转中心对齐，从而在虚拟上将目标-服务系统刚化，以保持目标静止，确保可靠抓取。在抓取后阶段，基于哈密顿动力学和最优控制的控制策略，通过在尊重基座力矩限制和多重抓取约束的同时，最小化时间、燃料或能量，来稳定组合系统。对于结构化目标，施加的力和力矩保持在其界限内；对于非结构化目标，摩擦约束防止滑动。案例研究证明了该方法在促进后续抓取和消旋阶段方面的有效性。

Authors: Farhad Aghili

Online Hamilton-Jacobi Reachability Onboard the Robot Control Loop: A Real-Time GPU Solver for Safety-Critical Autonomy Other

Hamilton-Jacobi reachability CUDA real-time control safety-critical autonomy GPU solver

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于CUDA优化的Hamilton-Jacobi可达性求解器，能在机器人控制回路中实时计算后向可达管，为安全关键控制提供形式化保障；在多种基准上比现有求解器快数倍，并支持多智能体应用如野火响应。

TLDR: This paper presents a CUDA-optimized Hamilton-Jacobi reachability solver that computes backward reachable tubes in real-time onboard robots, providing a formal safety layer for control loops; it demonstrates speedups over existing solvers and supports multi-agent applications like wildfire response.

Abstract: Hamilton-Jacobi (HJ) reachability provides certified backward reachable tubes (BRTs) for safety-critical robotic systems, but the level-set computation scales exponentially in the state dimension and has historically been performed offline. As autonomy stacks (ADAS/AV, humanoid robotics, and vision-language-action models) increasingly rely on black-box, probabilistic policies, a deterministic safety layer with formal guarantees is an essential complement. We present a CUDA implementation of the canonical WENO5 + TVD-RK3 + Lax-Friedrichs level-set Hamilton-Jacobi-Isaacs solver for 2D, 3D, and 4D dynamics that is fast enough to run inside a robot's control loop. In 32-bit floating point (FP32) on a single workstation GPU (NVIDIA RTX 4000 Ada), it computes the 3D Air3D BRT at 112 Hz, a 4D pursuit-evasion BRT at 61 Hz, and a 2D wind-affected drifter BRT at 74-147 Hz, 5.9-17.5x faster than the JAX reference hj_reachability at matched precision and 1.7-16x faster than a torch.compile reimplementation of the same scheme. In 64-bit floating point (FP64) it agrees with hj_reachability on eight benchmark cases, reproduces Mitchell's Air3D BRT to within 0.04% of the reference cell count, and runs 2.0-4.6x faster. On an embedded NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor it computes Air3D at 66 Hz (N=41) and the 2D drifter at 54 Hz, 3.8-8.9x faster than hj_reachability on the same device. As a multi-agent application, an in-kernel label-propagation extension recovers the K-agent capture-basin Voronoi tessellation from a single combined HJ solve, independent of fleet size; it runs at 4.0 ms per tick in a closed-loop wildfire-response simulation of six quadcopters under time-varying, non-uniform wind.

摘要（中文）：Hamilton-Jacobi（HJ）可达性分析为安全关键型机器人系统提供了经过认证的后向可达管（BRT），但水平集计算在状态维度上呈指数级增长，且历来在离线状态下执行。随着自主技术栈（ADAS/AV、人形机器人以及视觉-语言-动作模型）日益依赖于黑盒、概率性策略，具备形式化保证的确定性安全层成为必要的补充。我们提出了一种基于CUDA实现的经典WENO5 + TVD-RK3 + Lax-Friedrichs水平集Hamilton-Jacobi-Isaacs求解器，适用于2D、3D和4D动力学系统，其运算速度足以在机器人控制回路内实时运行。在单块工作站GPU（NVIDIA RTX 4000 Ada）上采用32位浮点精度（FP32）时，该求解器以112 Hz的频率计算3D Air3D BRT，以61 Hz的频率计算4D追逃BRT，并以74–147 Hz的频率计算2D受风影响的漂流器BRT，在匹配精度下比JAX参考实现hj_reachability快5.9–17.5倍，比torch.compile重新实现的相同方案快1.7–16倍。在64位浮点精度（FP64）下，该求解器在八个基准测试案例中与hj_reachability结果一致，复现Mitchell的Air3D BRT时单元数差异在参考值的0.04%以内，且运行速度快2.0–4.6倍。在嵌入式NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor平台上，该求解器以66 Hz（N=41）计算Air3D，以54 Hz计算2D漂流器，比同一设备上的hj_reachability快3.8–8.9倍。作为多智能体应用示例，一种内核内标签传播扩展可从单次组合HJ求解中恢复K智能体捕获域Voronoi剖分，且计算复杂度与编队规模无关；在六架四旋翼飞行器在时变、非均匀风场下的闭环野火响应仿真中，该扩展以每周期4.0 ms的速度运行。

Authors: Kevin Weekly, Alexandre M. Bayen

A Practical Causal Framework for Autonomous Mobile Robots: From Simulation to Real-World Human Environments RLRobot

causal inference sim-to-real transfer mobile robot navigation causal model human-shared environments

简要说明：本文提出了一种面向移动机器人的因果推断框架，通过仅更新因果模型参数并使用少量真实世界观测，实现高效的仿真到现实迁移，并在人类共享环境中成功实现安全导航。

TLDR: This paper proposes a causal inference framework for mobile robots that enables efficient sim-to-real transfer by updating only causal model parameters with limited real-world observations, demonstrating successful and safe navigation in human-populated environments.

Abstract: Causal inference has emerged as a powerful paradigm enabling robots to make safe, efficient decisions by reasoning about the ``why'' behind events. However, its real-world application is hindered by the difficulty of collecting causal data, especially in human-populated environments where training takes time, while users expect immediate operation. To this end, we tackle the challenge of transferring simulation-learnt causal relations to the real world with minimal effort. While retaining the invariant high-level causal structure, we empirically demonstrate the system adapts efficiently to real-world situations by updating only the causal model parameters with a limited set of new observations. Our results show that the parameter update enables rapid sim-to-real transfer. The framework runs efficiently onboard of a mobile robot and significantly outperforms a non-causal baselines navigating successfully and safely in complex human-shared scenarios.

摘要（中文）：因果推断已成为一种强大的范式，使机器人能够通过推理事件背后的“原因”来做出安全、高效的决策。然而，其在实际应用中的推广受到因果数据收集难度的制约，尤其是在人类密集的环境中，训练需要时间，而用户期望机器人能够即刻运行。为此，我们应对了将仿真中学得的因果关系以最小代价迁移至现实世界的挑战。在保留不变的高层因果结构的同时，我们通过实证表明，系统仅需利用有限的新观测数据更新因果模型参数，即可高效适应现实情境。我们的结果表明，参数更新能够实现快速的仿真到现实迁移。该框架可在移动机器人上高效运行，并在复杂的人机共享场景中显著优于非因果基线方法，实现安全、成功的导航。

Authors: Luca Castri, Gloria Beraldo, Nicola Bellotto

RoboScope Kit: Unified Interfaces for Fast and Scalable Embodied-AI Evaluation RLRobot

embodied AI evaluation policy evaluation benchmark acceleration VLA resource scheduling

简要说明：RoboScope Kit 通过统一接口和优化调度加速并扩展具身AI评估，在保持规则和结果不变的情况下，实现高达 25 倍的加速。

TLDR: RoboScope Kit proposes unified interfaces and optimized scheduling to accelerate and scale embodied-AI evaluation across benchmarks, achieving up to 25x speedups without changing benchmark rules or success outcomes.

Abstract: Simulation benchmarks are the standard way to compare robot policies, but each benchmark brings its own evaluator, observation layout, and action convention, and evaluation is slow: 500 RoboTwin Easy episodes with one simulator and one model on one GPU take 359.7 minutes. Profiling the official StarVLA evaluator shows that simulation occupies CPU cores while the GPU averages 14.3% utilization. RoboScope Kit wraps each model once in a Python class called a Policy, and each benchmark once in an adapter around the benchmark's own evaluator, so the benchmark's rules and scoring stay unchanged. Scheduling runs simulator workers and Policy replicas as separate pools, sizes both from measured probes, and shards work deterministically across GPU instances; runtime optimization renders only the observations an action-chunk Policy reads. Adapters cover six benchmark families. On LIBERO-Long with a StarVLA checkpoint on one 48 GiB RTX 4090, the concurrency search selects twelve simulator workers sharing three Policy replicas, which evaluate 500 episodes 4.45$\times$ faster than the official StarVLA evaluation with equivalent success rates, 2.78$\times$ faster than RLinf, and 1.52$\times$ faster than vla-eval at its tuned configuration. With CUDA MPS, which lets the replicas run their kernels concurrently, the search selects sixteen workers sharing four replicas, 6.16$\times$ faster than StarVLA, 3.85$\times$ faster than RLinf, and 2.10$\times$ faster than vla-eval. On RoboTwin Easy, four GPUs with chunk-boundary observation complete the 500 episodes in 14.4 minutes, 25.04$\times$ faster than the single-GPU baseline, with identical success outcomes and terminal steps.

摘要（中文）：模拟基准测试是比较机器人策略的标准方式，但每个基准都带有自己的评估器、观察布局和动作约定，且评估速度缓慢：在单张GPU上，使用一个模拟器和一个模型运行500个RoboTwin Easy回合需要359.7分钟。对官方StarVLA评估器的性能分析显示，模拟过程占用了CPU核心，而GPU平均利用率仅为14.3%。RoboScope Kit将每个模型封装为一次Python类（称为Policy），并将每个基准通过适配器封装在基准自身评估器周围，从而保持基准规则和评分不变。调度机制将模拟器工作进程和Policy副本作为独立池运行，根据实测探测调整两者规模，并在多个GPU实例间确定性分配任务；运行时优化仅渲染动作分块策略实际读取的观察数据。适配器覆盖六个基准系列。在LIBERO-Long上，使用StarVLA检查点运行于单张48 GiB RTX 4090时，并发搜索选择了12个模拟器工作进程共享3个Policy副本，评估500个回合的速度比官方StarVLA评估快4.45倍，成功率相当；比RLinf快2.78倍；比调整配置后的vla-eval快1.52倍。启用CUDA MPS（允许副本并发运行内核）后，搜索选择了16个工作进程共享4个副本，比StarVLA快6.16倍，比RLinf快3.85倍，比vla-eval快2.10倍。在RoboTwin Easy上，使用四张GPU并启用分块边界观察，500个回合在14.4分钟内完成，比单GPU基线快25.04倍，且成功结果和终止步骤完全一致。

Authors: Deng-Ke Wu, Yifan Jin, Yida Yang, Lei Qian, Zhaoye Zhou, Hongru Zhang, Kai Ye, Shuyuan Hu, Yiran Mao, Zewei Ye, Bo Zhao

SurgTransfer: Multi-Step Latent Action Modeling for Action Transfer in Surgical World Model WorldModel

surgical world model latent action modeling action transfer unlabeled video multi-step learning

简要说明：本文提出了SurgTransfer，一种用于手术世界模型的多步潜在动作建模框架，能够从无标签视频中学习上下文不变的潜在动作，无需真实运动学或专家标注即可实现跨手术上下文的动作迁移。

TLDR: This paper introduces SurgTransfer, a multi-step latent action modeling framework for surgical world models that learns context-invariant latent actions from unlabeled videos, enabling action transfer across surgical contexts without ground-truth kinematics or expert annotations.

Abstract: Surgical world models have the potential to provide intra-operative guidance, accelerate risk-free training and facilitate transfer of expert surgical maneuvers. However, the use of world models for transferring surgical expertise has been largely unexplored. Moreover, recent approaches in this domain have mainly relied on ground truth kinematics actions or expert annotations for specific tasks, limiting their applicability beyond the narrow range of tasks with ground-truth annotations. In contrast, existing works in the natural domain have shown promising results in learning latent actions solely from unlabeled videos and transferring the learned actions across contexts. We observe that this paradigm is short-sighted for the surgical domain, failing to capture the hierarchical and goal-directed structure of surgical procedures. Thus, we propose a novel multi-step action learning framework to learn context-invariant latent actions that are easily transferable across various surgical contexts. We perform extensive experiments on the publicly available datasets, SurgToolLoc-2022 and PitVis-2023, verifying our approach with both quantitative metrics and qualitative evaluation by surgical experts. We have published our code and the implementation details at https://github.com/bhattarailab/Surgical-Vision-World-Model.

摘要（中文）：手术世界模型有望提供术中指导、加速无风险训练并促进专家手术操作的迁移。然而，利用世界模型迁移手术专业知识的研究至今仍基本处于空白状态。此外，该领域近期的方法主要依赖真实运动学动作或针对特定任务的专家标注，这限制了其在仅有真实标注的狭窄任务范围之外的适用性。相比之下，自然领域中的现有工作已在仅从无标注视频中学习潜在动作以及跨情境迁移所学动作方面展示了令人鼓舞的成果。我们注意到，这一范式在手术领域存在短视问题，未能捕捉手术过程的层次化及目标导向结构。为此，我们提出了一种新颖的多步动作学习框架，用于学习具有情境不变性的潜在动作，使其能够轻松迁移至多种手术情境。我们在公开数据集SurgToolLoc-2022和PitVis-2023上开展了大量实验，通过定量指标和手术专家的定性评估验证了我们的方法。我们已在https://github.com/bhattarailab/Surgical-Vision-World-Model 公开发布代码及实现细节。
