Authors: Saurabh Koju, Love Panta, Deepak Thapa, Rudra P. K. Poudel, Prajwal Ghimire, Angus Watson, Yash Raj Shrestha, Prashnna Kumar Gyawali, Binod Bhattarai

HTCE: Homeomorphism-inspired Topological Cross-Scene Experience Canonicalization and Reuse for Object Navigation VLN

object-goal navigation topological experience cross-scene reuse vision-language policy canonicalization

简要说明：HTCE 提出了一种基于同胚启发的拓扑框架，用于跨场景导航经验的标准化和复用，在冻结视觉语言策略下压缩经验索引并提升成功率与SPL。

TLDR: HTCE introduces a homeomorphism-inspired topological framework to canonicalize and reuse cross-scene navigation experience for object-goal navigation, compressing experience indices and improving success rate and SPL under a frozen vision-language policy.

Abstract: As embodied agents perform object-goal navigation across residential environments, they accumulate successful experiences whose semantic structure recurs across scenes even when geometric trajectories do not. Reusing such experience is challenging because differences in region naming and observation granularity produce distinct graph representations of similar approaches, while meaningful differences in anchors, branches, and endpoints must stay distinguishable. We introduce HTCE, a homeomorphism-inspired topological framework that canonicalizes and reuses navigation experience. Feature and topology subdivisions characterize representational variations, and their semantically constrained reductions produce comparable semantic sequences and structural signatures while preserving semantic anchors, branching relations, and navigation endpoints. HTCE then retrieves historical successful approaches through subdivision-aware matching as guidance for a frozen vision-language policy. Canonicalization compresses the experience index losslessly, merging 17.7--23.6\% of distinct stored route descriptions while retaining full task performance. Under a single frozen vision-language backbone shared by all compared systems, HTCE attains the best SR and SPL in every setting---59.9\%/31.8\% on HM3D v0.1, 71.0\%/31.5\% on HM3D v0.2, and 46.6\%/16.6\% on MP3D---with SR gains of up to 4.9 points and structured retrieval contributing up to 2.8 SPL points. The code is available in https://github.com/startracker0/htce.git

摘要（中文）：当具身智能体在居住环境中执行目标导向导航任务时，它们会积累成功的经验，而这些经验所蕴含的语义结构在不同场景间具有重复性，即使几何轨迹各不相同。由于区域命名和观测粒度的差异，相似的方法会产生不同的图表示，使得复用这些经验颇具挑战性；与此同时，锚点、分支和端点之间的有意义差异又必须保持可区分性。我们提出HTCE，一种基于同胚思想的拓扑框架，用于规范化并复用导航经验。特征细分与拓扑细分刻画了表示差异，其语义约简在保留语义锚点、分支关系和导航端点的同时，生成可比较的语义序列与结构签名。HTCE随后通过感知细分的匹配机制检索历史成功经验，为冻结的视觉-语言策略提供指导。规范化处理对经验索引进行无损压缩，合并了17.7%至23.6%的不同存储路径描述，同时保持了完整的任务性能。在共享同一冻结视觉-语言骨干网络的所有对比系统中，HTCE在所有测试环境下均取得了最优的SR和SPL指标——在HM3D v0.1上分别为59.9%/31.8%，在HM3D v0.2上分别为71.0%/31.5%，在MP3D上分别为46.6%/16.6%——其中SR最高提升4.9个百分点，结构化检索贡献了最高2.8个SPL百分点。代码已开源至https://github.com/startracker0/htce.git。

Authors: Xiaoran Xu, Yupeng Wu, Tianyu Xue, Xuanran Dong, Yifan Xu, Xiaoshan Yang, Changsheng Xu

AceAction-5M: Hierarchical Goals for Generalist Action Learning Across 3D Game Worlds VLA

vision-language-action data hierarchical goals subgoal transitions 3D game environments human gameplay

简要说明：AceAction-5M 提出了一个大规模人类游戏数据集，包含分层目标和子目标转换标注，用于跨多个3D游戏的视觉-语言-动作学习。

TLDR: AceAction-5M introduces a large-scale dataset of human gameplay annotated with hierarchical goals and subgoal transitions for vision-language-action learning across multiple 3D games.

Abstract: Video games provide a practical setting for collecting vision-language-action (VLA) data, whose acquisition in physical environments is costly. Existing datasets, however, remain limited by restricted game coverage, sparse language supervision, or temporal hierarchies that do not necessarily reflect changes in task objectives. We introduce AceAction, a dataset of human gameplay across multiple 3D games for learning skill composition and subgoal transitions. AceAction organizes demonstrations around complete tasks, linking overall instructions, ordered subgoals, and local skill instructions to temporally aligned visual observations and keyboard-and-mouse actions. To construct these annotations, we develop a vision-language model pipeline that identifies subgoals from changes in objectives or interaction targets, anchors navigation goals to visually recognizable waypoints, and composes adjacent subgoals into task instructions. The resulting demonstrations cover navigation, reconnaissance, combat, interaction, and recovery, with explicit stage boundaries that connect task progression to fine-grained control. We assess annotation quality through model-based verification and human inspection. An audit of 500 trajectories yields a 95.8% pass rate across independent reviewer assessments. AceAction provides a data foundation for studying how agents execute, combine, and switch skills to follow complex instructions in dynamic game environments.

摘要（中文）：视频游戏为收集视觉-语言-动作（VLA）数据提供了实用场景，而在物理环境中获取此类数据的成本高昂。然而，现有数据集仍受限于游戏覆盖范围有限、语言监督稀疏，或时间层次结构未能真实反映任务目标变化等问题。我们推出AceAction，一个涵盖多款3D游戏的人类游戏过程数据集，用于研究技能组合与子目标转换。AceAction围绕完整任务组织演示数据，将整体指令、有序子目标及局部技能指令与时间对齐的视觉观察和键盘鼠标操作相联结。为构建这些标注，我们开发了一种视觉-语言模型流水线，能够从目标或交互对象的变化中识别子目标，将导航目标锚定到视觉可识别的路径点，并将相邻子目标组合成任务指令。由此生成的演示数据涵盖导航、侦察、战斗、交互和恢复等场景，并带有明确的阶段边界，将任务推进与细粒度控制相衔接。我们通过基于模型的验证和人工检查评估标注质量。对500条轨迹的审计显示，独立评审员评估的通过率为95.8%。AceAction为研究智能体如何在动态游戏环境中执行、组合和切换技能以遵循复杂指令提供了数据基础。

Authors: Kailing Li, Ruoxuan Zhang, Zheyuan Zhou, Boyang Chu, Yingshan Lei, Hongxia Xie, Liang Du, Zixun Sun

MiCaDe: Online LiDAR-Camera Miscalibration Change Detection for Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

LiDAR-camera calibration change detection extrinsic calibration autonomous driving object detection

简要说明：MiCaDe 是一种在线、无需训练的方法，通过监控由 2D/3D 检测得到的几何一致性指标，并利用变点模型累积证据，来检测自动驾驶中 LiDAR-相机外参校准漂移。

TLDR: MiCaDe is an online, training-free method that detects LiDAR-camera extrinsic calibration drift in autonomous driving by monitoring geometric consistency metrics derived from 2D/3D object detections and using a change point model to accumulate evidence for robust change detection.

Abstract: Reliable multi-sensor perception in autonomous vehicles requires accurate calibration between cameras and LiDAR. However, calibration drift is often unavoidable in long-term deployments: vibrations, thermal effects, and minor mechanical shocks may alter the relative pose between sensors, leading to systematic errors in downstream fusion tasks. We propose MiCaDe (Miscalibration Change Detection), an online solution detecting when the extrinsic LiDAR-camera calibration parameters are no longer accurate by means of sequential change detection. MiCaDe requires no calibration targets, or modification of the perception stack, providing low false-alarm rates with negligible computational overhead. Our key insight is that 3D and 2D bounding boxes produced by standard object detectors should remain geometrically consistent under correct calibration. By matching cross-modal detections, we derive geometric consistency metrics that serve as sensitive indicators of extrinsic drift. These metrics are aggregated into fixed-size batches and scored against a reference distribution, producing a likelihood stream that is monitored by a Change Point Model (CPM). Crucially, the CPM accumulates statistical evidence over time, enabling detection of subtle drifts that would otherwise go unnoticed. Experiments on multiple long-sequence datasets and on a real-world dataset with physically induced miscalibration confirm reliable detection under diverse conditions. Code available at: https://github.com/CarloSgaravatti/MiCaDe.

摘要（中文）：可靠的自动驾驶多传感器感知系统要求相机与激光雷达之间具备精确的标定。然而，在长期部署中，标定漂移往往难以避免：振动、热效应以及轻微的机械冲击都可能改变传感器之间的相对位姿，进而导致下游融合任务出现系统性误差。我们提出MiCaDe（误标定变化检测），一种在线解决方案，通过序贯变化检测来判断激光雷达-相机外参标定参数何时不再准确。MiCaDe无需标定靶标，也不需要对感知栈进行任何修改，即可实现低虚警率，且计算开销可忽略不计。我们的关键洞察在于：在正确标定条件下，标准目标检测器生成的三维与二维边界框应保持几何一致性。通过匹配跨模态检测结果，我们推导出几何一致性度量，这些度量可作为外参漂移的敏感指标。这些度量被聚合为固定大小的批次，并与参考分布进行比对，生成似然流，由变化点模型（CPM）持续监控。关键在于，CPM会随时间累积统计证据，从而能够检测出那些原本难以察觉的细微漂移。在多个长序列数据集以及一个通过物理方式引入误标定的真实世界数据集上的实验，证实了该方法在多种条件下的可靠检测性能。代码已公开：https://github.com/CarloSgaravatti/MiCaDe。

Authors: Carlo Sgaravatti, Riccardo Pieroni, Matteo Corno, Sergio M. Savaresi, Luca Magri, Giacomo Boracchi

Do Pretrained Backbones Transfer to Physical Sensors? A Systematic Study of Multimodal Initialization Across the Sensor Stack AutonomousDriving

multimodal pretraining multi-sensor autonomous driving masked autoencoding transfer learning sensor fusion

简要说明：本文系统研究了预训练骨干网络在多传感器自动驾驶设置中的迁移效果，通过构建282万张图像的多传感器数据集并改进MultiMAE进行域内预训练，发现MultiMAE是一个强大的现成基线，而针对性的修改带来了渐进式改进。

TLDR: This paper systematically studies how pretrained backbones transfer to multi-sensor autonomous driving setups by curating a 2.82M image multi-sensor collection and adapting MultiMAE for in-domain pretraining, finding that MultiMAE is a strong out-of-the-box baseline and that targeted modifications yield incremental improvements.

Abstract: Transfer learning from pretrained backbones has become standard practice in multi-sensor computer vision---yet two questions remain open: which pretrained weights transfer best to multi-sensor setups, and can in-domain pretraining outperform off-the-shelf solutions? Frameworks like MultiMAE demonstrate the utility of masked autoencoding in a multi-modal context, but rely entirely on dense, model-derived modalities. It is unclear how robustly these methods translate to real-world applications that use physical sensors, where the aggregation of diverse public datasets for large-scale pretraining inherently introduces modality sparsity. To investigate this systematically, we curate a multi-sensor autonomous driving collection of $2.82M$ images from 16 publicly available datasets, incorporating both physical hardware modalities (RGB, LWIR, NIR, Event) and model-derived modalities (Stereo Depth, Segmentation). We use this collection for in-domain pretraining based on the MultiMAE approach. We adapt MultiMAE's loss formulation to accommodate sparse samples, and study the effect of an enforced encoder bottleneck for modality alignment and of additional losses specific to dense reconstruction (SSIM and FFT). We then systematically compare against common pretrained backbones (ViT, MAE, DINO and MultiMAE) across downstream sensor fusion tasks. We find that MultiMAE is a surprisingly strong out-of-the-box baseline, transferring effectively even to modalities it has never seen, while our targeted modifications yield incremental but consistent improvements on multi-sensor transfer and overall robustness.

摘要（中文）：从预训练主干网络进行迁移学习已成为多传感器计算机视觉中的标准做法——然而两个问题仍然悬而未决：哪些预训练权重最适合迁移到多传感器设置中，以及领域内预训练能否优于现成的解决方案？诸如MultiMAE之类的框架展示了掩码自编码在多模态情境中的实用性，但它们完全依赖于密集的、由模型派生的模态。目前尚不清楚这些方法在多大程度上能够稳健地应用于使用物理传感器的现实世界应用中，而在这些场景下，为大规模预训练聚合多样化的公共数据集不可避免地会引入模态稀疏性问题。为系统研究这一问题，我们构建了一个多传感器自动驾驶数据集，涵盖来自16个公开数据集的282万张图像，同时包含物理硬件模态（RGB、LWIR、NIR、事件相机）和模型派生模态（立体深度、分割）。我们基于MultiMAE方法利用该数据集进行领域内预训练。我们调整了MultiMAE的损失函数以适应稀疏样本，并研究了强制编码器瓶颈对模态对齐的影响，以及专门针对密集重建的额外损失（SSIM和FFT）的作用。随后，我们在下游传感器融合任务中系统地将其与常见的预训练主干网络（ViT、MAE、DINO和MultiMAE）进行比较。我们发现MultiMAE作为一个开箱即用的基线出乎意料地强大，即便面对从未见过的模态也能有效迁移，而我们针对性的修改在多传感器迁移和整体鲁棒性方面带来了渐进但一致的改进。

Authors: Fabio Montello, Ronja Güldenring, Lucas Mogensen Sandby, Christoffer Koo Øhrstrøm, Lazaros Nalpantidis

Compression Forcing: Hierarchical History Tokenization Enables Flexible World Models WorldModel

world modeling dynamics-aware tokenization hierarchical history guidance diffusion backbone future prediction

简要说明：压缩强制提出了一种基于动态显著性的历史观察压缩方法，提升了世界模型的预测能力和下游决策表现。

TLDR: Compression Forcing introduces a tokenization method that compresses history observations by dynamics saliency, improving world model prediction and downstream decision-making.

Abstract: Effective world modeling requires compressing salient history information that facilitates future prediction. However, most existing approaches inherit tokenization and conditioning mechanisms from video generation, where objectives are centered around perceptual realism rather than predictive utility. This discrepancy limits the world model's effectiveness, especially in environments dominated by visual nuisances or task-irrelevant background details. To this end, we introduce Compression Forcing (CF), a general framework that aligns history compression with the predictive objective of world modeling. Compression Forcing features Dynamics-Aware Tokenization (DAT), a novel tokenization method that compresses history observations into a sequence ordered by decreasing dynamics saliency. Built on a diffusion backbone, this structure enables Hierarchical History Guidance (HG-H), allowing selective amplification of dynamics-salient information during inference. Extensive experiments across various environments demonstrate improved prediction fidelity, physical realism, and downstream decision-making performance, establishing Compression Forcing as a highly flexible and effective approach for world modeling.

摘要（中文）：有效的世界建模需要压缩有助于未来预测的关键历史信息。然而，现有方法大多继承了视频生成中的 tokenization 和条件机制，其优化目标侧重于感知真实性，而非预测效用。这一差异限制了世界模型的有效性，尤其是在视觉干扰或与任务无关的背景细节占主导的环境中。为此，我们提出压缩强制（Compression Forcing, CF），一个将历史压缩与世界建模预测目标对齐的通用框架。压缩强制包含动态感知 Tokenization（Dynamics-Aware Tokenization, DAT），一种新型 tokenization 方法，可将历史观测压缩为按动态显著性递减顺序排列的序列。基于扩散主干结构，该方法实现了分层历史引导（Hierarchical History Guidance, HG-H），从而在推理过程中选择性地增强动态显著信息的表达。跨多种环境的广泛实验表明，该框架在预测保真度、物理真实感和下游决策性能方面均有显著提升，确立了压缩强制作为一种高度灵活且有效的世界建模方法。

Authors: Siqiao Huang, Partha Kaushik, Michael Chen, Hengkai Pan, Kaiwen Geng, Omar Chehab, Fernando Moreno-Pino, Max Simchowitz

PadLoc: Training-Free Floor-Plan Localization by Sparse Geometric Matching Perception3D

training-free localization geometric matching floor plan sensor modularity Bayes filter

简要说明：PadLoc提出了一种无需训练的楼层平面定位后端，用稀疏几何匹配取代密集位姿网格搜索，在多种传感器和环境中实现了最先进的精度。

TLDR: PadLoc presents a training-free floor-plan localization back-end that replaces dense pose-grid search with sparse geometric matching, achieving state-of-the-art accuracy across diverse sensors and environments.

Abstract: We propose PadLoc, a training-free localization back-end that places a moving sensor within a known floor plan. Floor plans are cheap, persistent, and robust to appearance change, but recent learned-depth methods localize against them by filtering per-frame depth through dense $(x,y,θ)$ pose grids. PadLoc keeps the swappable depth front-end and replaces the dense grid back-end with sparse geometric matching: dominant wall orientations define a small pose-candidate set, masked normalized cross-correlation scores observed free space against the plan, and a moving-pose Gaussian-mixture Bayes filter plus consensus readout decodes the trajectory. Holding each competitor's depth fixed, PadLoc matches or beats UnLoc's forward filter and the F3Loc filter at every Gibson trajectory length, and UnLoc's offline refinement from $T=35$ on; it exceeds Z-FLoc's published results with a shared MapAnything front-end. On Bonn LiLocBench, PadLoc improves pooled SR@1m over UnLoc by 23-32 pp under wheel odometry and 35-43 pp with ground-truth motion; with full-FOV LiDAR plus wheel odometry the same readout reaches 100% SR@1m at 9-10 cm median error on the static sequence. On the Hilti-Trimble Localization Challenge PadLoc localizes a camera-only fisheye rig on construction floors hundreds of metres across at 0.90-0.98 online SR@2m on three of five sessions; adding learned wall isolation, applied to every session, covers all five at 0.67-0.92 with the localizer unchanged throughout. PadLoc thus matches or outperforms dense grid back-ends while preserving sensor modularity and a compact state that does not grow with trajectory length.

摘要（中文）：我们提出PadLoc，一种无需训练的后端定位方法，可将移动传感器放置于已知楼层平面图中。楼层平面图成本低、持久存在，且对外观变化具有鲁棒性；然而近期基于学习深度的方法，是通过在稠密的$(x,y,\theta)$位姿网格上对每帧深度进行滤波来实现与之匹配定位的。PadLoc保留了可替换的深度前端，但将稠密网格后端替换为稀疏几何匹配：主导墙体方向定义了一个较小的位姿候选集合，掩膜归一化互相关用于将观测到的自由空间与平面图进行评分，移动位姿高斯混合贝叶斯滤波器加一致性读出机制用于解码轨迹。在保持各对比方法深度估计不变的情况下，PadLoc在每个Gibson轨迹长度上均匹配或优于UnLoc的前向滤波器和F3Loc滤波器，并从$T=35$起优于UnLoc的离线精化结果；在使用共享的MapAnything前端时，PadLoc超过Z-FLoc已发表的成果。在Bonn LiLocBench上，PadLoc在轮式里程计下将SR@1m综合结果较UnLoc提高23至32个百分点，在真实运动数据下提高35至43个百分点；使用全视场激光雷达加轮式里程计，同一读出机制在静态序列上达到100% SR@1m，中位误差为9至10厘米。在Hilti-Trimble定位挑战赛中，PadLoc使用仅含相机的鱼眼装置在数百米宽的施工楼层中实现了0.90至0.98的在线SR@2m，覆盖五组中的三组；加入学习式墙体隔离并应用于所有组别后，在定位器保持不变的情况下，全部五组均达到0.67至0.92的SR@2m。因此，PadLoc在匹配或优于稠密网格后端的同时，保持了传感器模块化和不随轨迹长度增长的紧凑状态。

Authors: Marian Bookhahn, Frank Neumann

Sparse Anchors for Visual Multi-Session Registration in Changing Environments Perception3D

multi-session registration visual place recognition pose-graph optimization Gaussian feature field changing environments

简要说明：本文提出了一种在变化环境中利用稀疏绝对位姿锚点结合相对位姿约束进行跨会话视觉定位的方法，在建筑工地数据集上实现了改进的轨迹配准。

TLDR: This paper presents a method for cross-session visual localization in changing environments using sparse absolute pose anchors combined with relative pose constraints, achieving improved trajectory registration on construction-site data.

Abstract: Repeated robotic monitoring requires localization across visits to the same environment, even if the environment changes. Such changes can substantially reduce persistent visual content, and repetitive structures can lead to incorrect cross-session correspondences. In this paper, we address visual multi-session registration of a new data recording (the query session) to a previously reconstructed reference map. Under substantial visual and structural changes, cross-session localization may be possible only for parts of the trajectory. In our approach, we therefore rely on a sparse set of reliable absolute pose constraints and combine them with within-session relative-pose information to register the complete trajectory to the reference map. We first estimate absolute alignment hypotheses through visual place recognition, local feature matching, and geometric verification. We then use sequence consensus to reject hypotheses that are inconsistent with a common query-to-reference alignment and retain the remaining poses as absolute anchors. These anchors are refined through featuremetric alignment against a Gaussian feature field and combined with within-session relative-pose constraints in a robust pose-graph optimization. We evaluate our approach on 15 cross-session experiments from the challenging HILTI26 construction-site dataset, covering substantial scene changes and difficult-to-match environments. Our method achieves 94.4% recall within 1m and 100.0% within 5m, outperforming independent image localization, which peaks at 65.3% and 70.7%, respectively, as well as direct registration of independently reconstructed Structure-from-Motion geometry. Our results show that sparse, reliable absolute anchors can provide accurate and complete trajectory registration even when reliable cross-session correspondences are available only for part of the query session.

摘要（中文）：重复性机器人监测要求在同一环境中的多次访问间进行定位，即使环境发生了变化。此类变化可能大幅减少持久的视觉内容，而重复性结构可能导致错误的跨会话对应关系。在本文中，我们研究了将新的数据记录（查询会话）与先前重建的参考地图进行视觉多会话配准的问题。在显著的视觉和结构变化下，跨会话定位可能仅对轨迹的部分区段可行。因此，在我们的方法中，我们依赖一组稀疏的可靠绝对位姿约束，并将其与会话内的相对位姿信息相结合，以将完整轨迹配准到参考地图。我们首先通过视觉位置识别、局部特征匹配和几何验证来估计绝对对齐假设，然后使用序列一致性来拒绝与共同的查询到参考对齐不一致的假设，并将剩余位姿保留为绝对锚点。这些锚点通过对高斯特征场的特征度量对齐进行细化，并在鲁棒的位姿图优化中与会话内的相对位姿约束相结合。我们在具有挑战性的HILTI26建筑工地数据集的15个跨会话实验中评估了我们的方法，该数据集涵盖了显著的场景变化和难以匹配的环境。我们的方法在1米范围内实现了94.4%的召回率，在5米范围内实现了100.0%的召回率，优于独立的图像定位（其最高分别为65.3%和70.7%），也优于对独立重建的运动恢复结构几何的直接配准。我们的结果表明，即使可靠的跨会话对应关系仅适用于查询会话的一部分，稀疏且可靠的绝对锚点也能提供准确且完整的轨迹配准。

Authors: Yunus Talha Erzurumlu, Niklas Trekel, Saurabh Gupta, Nico Koltermann, Olga Vysotska, Jens Behley, Louis Wiesmann, Cyrill Stachniss

Haptic Shared Control for Multi-Robot Systems Other

multi-robot haptic feedback shared control connectivity maintenance user study

简要说明：本文提出了一种多机器人系统的触觉共享控制框架，将自适应监督策略与连通性维护算法相结合，实现分层人机控制与触觉反馈，并通过用户研究验证其有效性。

TLDR: This paper proposes a haptic shared control framework for multi-robot systems, integrating adaptive supervision strategies with a connectivity maintenance algorithm to provide hierarchical human control and haptic feedback, validated through a user study.

Abstract: Multi-agent systems offer significant advantages in terms of flexibility and redundancy, enabling the efficient distribution of complex tasks among multiple robots. However, their deployment requires advanced control strategies to ensure optimal cooperation between autonomous agents and human operators. We propose a modification of the global connectivity maintenance algorithm to incorporate measurements taken in agent's local frame, using sensors with limited fields of view. This algorithm, responsible for the autonomous behavior of the multi-robot system, is combined with different adaptive supervision strategies, allowing the user to exert control at varying scales over the entire group. (i) Single Agent Control (S): The operator directly controls a single robot, (ii) Pinning Control (P): The operator imposes constraints on multiple robots to influence the group, (iii) Centroid Control (C): The operator acts on the system's center of mass to steer the entire fleet. In conjunction with the connectivity maintenance algorithm, these methods ensure compliance with inter-agent constraints while providing haptic feedback to the user regarding the system's connectivity state. The effectiveness of these approaches was evaluated through a user study, comparing performance with and without haptic feedback across multiple scenarios tailored to the different control modes.

摘要（中文）：多智能体系统在灵活性和冗余性方面具有显著优势，能够高效地将复杂任务分配给多个机器人协同完成。然而，其部署需要先进的控制策略，以确保自主智能体与人类操作员之间的最优协作。我们提出了一种对全局连通性维护算法的改进，该改进利用智能体局部坐标系中的测量数据，并采用视场有限的传感器。该算法负责多机器人系统的自主行为，并与不同的自适应监督策略相结合，使用户能够在不同尺度上对整个群体施加控制。(i) 单智能体控制：操作员直接控制单个机器人；(ii) 钉扎控制：操作员对多个机器人施加约束以影响群体行为；(iii) 质心控制：操作员作用于系统质心以引导整个机群。结合连通性维护算法，这些方法确保满足智能体间的约束条件，同时向用户提供关于系统连通状态的触觉反馈。通过用户研究评估了这些方法的有效性，在针对不同控制模式设计的多种场景中，对比了有触觉反馈和无触觉反馈情况下的性能表现。

Authors: Maxime Bernard

h-NESDF: An Infinitely Differentiable Signed Distance Between Two Sets with Robotic Applications Other

signed distance function motion planning differentiability GPU parallelization control

简要说明：本文提出了 NESDF 及其平滑变体 h-NESDF，两者均为两个集合之间的无穷可微距离函数，并展示了其在机器人运动规划中的实用性。

TLDR: This paper introduces NESDF and its smooth variant h-NESDF, infinitely differentiable distance functions between two sets, and demonstrates their utility in robotic motion planning.

Abstract: Computing distances between sets is important in many robotic applications, such as motion planning and control. In many applications, derivatives of the distance are needed as well. It is well known that the Euclidean distance is not always differentiable, which create issues to algorithms that need a derivative. In this paper, we introduce NESDF, the Normal Euclidean Signed Distance Function between two general (with mild regularity assumptions but possibly non-convex) sets. This metric is still not differentiable, but it allows us to introduce a generalization, $h$-NESDF, which has a smoothing parameter $h$ such that the metric is infinitely differentiable for all $h>0$ and that reduces to the NESDF when $h$ goes to $0$. The metric is amenable to GPU parallelization, and thus can be computed efficiently. We show extensive simulation results to evaluate its viability in motion planning.

摘要（中文）：计算集合之间的距离在许多机器人应用中至关重要，例如运动规划和控制。在许多应用中，还需要距离的导数。众所周知，欧几里得距离并非总是可微的，这给需要导数的算法带来了问题。本文提出了一种称为NESDF的度量，即两个一般集合（在温和正则性假设下，但可能为非凸集）之间的法向欧几里得有符号距离函数。该度量仍然不可微，但基于此，我们引入其推广形式$h$-NESDF，该形式具有光滑参数$h$，使得对于所有$h>0$，该度量具有无限光滑性，并且当$h$趋于$0$时退化为NESDF。该度量适用于GPU并行计算，因此能够高效实现。我们展示了大量仿真结果，以评估其在运动规划中的可行性。

Authors: Vinicius Mariano Gonçalves, Pedro Antonio de Souza Campos Rodrigues

Coordinate Frame Recovery, Per Class NMS and Null Return Modelling for Sim2Real V2X LiDAR Detection Perception3D

sim2real LiDAR detection V2X point cloud NMS

简要说明：本文介绍了在城市孪生Sim2Real LiDAR挑战中，针对V2X-Real赛道提出的系统级方法，通过解决坐标框架不匹配、分类别NMS和空值返回建模三个关键诊断问题，显著提升了真实路边LiDAR数据的检测mAP和真实感评分。

TLDR: This paper presents a systems-level approach to a Sim2Real V2X LiDAR detection challenge, identifying and fixing three critical diagnostic issues (coordinate frame mismatch, per-class NMS, null return modeling) that dramatically improved detection mAP and realism scores on real roadside LiDAR data.

Abstract: We describe our approach to the V2X-Real track of the UrbanTwin Sim2Real LiDAR Challenge, in which a 3D object detector must be trained exclusively on synthetic data and evaluated on unseen real roadside LiDAR from an Ouster OS1-64 unit, while the synthetic point clouds are simultaneously scored for distributional realism. Our final entry scores 0.7457 combined, from a detection mAP of 0.4382 and a realism score of 0.9251. Three findings account for most of our result, and all three were diagnostic rather than architectural. First, a coordinate frame mismatch between our predictions and the evaluation ground truth was suppressing detection AP entirely; recovering it took our score from 0.3520 to 0.5147 in a single submission. Second, a single global non maximum suppression threshold was destroying genuine pedestrian detections, because pedestrians occur in groups and a 0.3 IoU threshold applied to a 0.7 m box suppresses distinct neighbouring people; correcting this per class raised overall mAP from 0.0751 to 0.4295. Third, approximately 31 percent of the real reference point cloud consists of null returns encoded as the literal point (0, 0, 0), a format feature entirely absent from our synthetic clouds, which pinned Earth Mover's Distance near its floor until we modelled it. Negative results are reported at equal length, and Section 9 gives a full account of data provenance and compliance. That section also accounts for every mechanism contributing to the submitted score.

摘要（中文）：我们介绍了在UrbanTwin Sim2Real激光雷达挑战赛V2X-Real赛道中的方法。该任务要求仅使用合成数据训练3D目标检测器，并在来自Ouster OS1-64单元的真实路侧激光雷达数据上进行评估，同时，合成点云还需接受分布真实性的评分。我们的最终成绩为综合得分0.7457，其中检测mAP为0.4382，真实性得分为0.9251。我们的大部分成果归因于三个发现，且这三项均为诊断性发现而非架构性改动。首先，我们预测结果与评估真值之间存在坐标系不匹配，这完全抑制了检测AP；纠正该问题后，我们的得分在单次提交中从0.3520提升至0.5147。其次，单一的全局非极大值抑制阈值严重损害了行人检测效果，因为行人常以群体形式出现，对0.7米尺度的框应用0.3的IoU阈值会抑制相邻的不同行人；针对不同类别进行修正后，整体mAP从0.0751提升至0.4295。第三，真实参考点云中约有31%为空返回值，编码为点(0, 0, 0)，而我们的合成点云中完全没有这一格式特征，这使推土机距离始终接近其下限，直到我们对该特征进行建模。负面结果也以同等篇幅进行了报告，第9节详细说明了数据来源与合规性，并逐一阐述了影响所提交得分的所有机制。

Authors: Aman Upganlawar

Geometric Refinement and Distributional Alignment for Sim2Real Roadside LiDAR Detection Perception3D

sim2real roadside LiDAR PointPillars geometric refinement distributional realism

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于路侧LiDAR检测的sim-to-real方法，通过几何细化、后处理修复和真实性指标的解析处理取得改进，并预测了最终得分。

TLDR: This paper presents a method for sim-to-real roadside LiDAR detection, achieving gains through geometric refinement, post-processing fixes, and analytical treatment of realism metrics, with a predicted final score.

Abstract: We describe our approach to the LUMPI track of the UrbanTwin Sim2Real LiDAR Challenge, in which a 3D object detector must be trained exclusively on synthetic data and evaluated on unseen real roadside LiDAR, while the synthetic point clouds are simultaneously scored for distributional realism. Our final entry scores 0.4793 combined, from a detection mAP of 0.1333 and a realism score of 0.9126. Our contribution is not a new architecture. Working from a PointPillars baseline, we obtained most of our gains from three sources. First, a diagnosis that small object failure in roadside LiDAR is a localisation problem rather than a detection problem, which led to a parameter free geometric refinement worth 86 percent relative on pedestrian AP. Second, an audit of our own post processing which revealed that a shipped rule was destroying valid predictions, the repair of which produced our single largest detection gain at 335 percent relative on the Van class. Third, treating the realism metrics analytically rather than as a black box, which showed that one of the four components is a closed form function of nine summary statistics. We also report an experimental methodology that we believe is the more transferable result. Because mean AP decomposes into independent per class terms, a single submission can carry several mutually controlled experiments, and a submission assembled entirely from previously measured components has a score that is known before it is sent. We predicted our final score to four decimal places prior to submission. We report negative results at equal length, and give a full account of data provenance and compliance in Section 8, including a full account of every mechanism contributing to the submitted score.

摘要（中文）：我们介绍了我们在UrbanTwin Sim2Real激光雷达挑战赛LUMPI赛道中的方法。在该挑战中，3D目标检测器必须仅使用合成数据进行训练，并在未见过的真实路侧激光雷达数据上进行评估，同时合成点云会因分布真实感而被评分。我们的最终参赛方案综合得分为0.4793，其中检测mAP为0.1333，真实感得分为0.9126。我们的贡献不在于提出新的架构。基于PointPillars基线，我们的大部分提升来自三个方面。首先，我们诊断出路侧激光雷达中小目标失败是一个定位问题而非检测问题，这促成了一个无参数几何细化方法，使行人AP相对提升了86%。其次，我们审查了自身的后处理流程，发现一个已发布的规则破坏了有效预测，修复该规则带来了我们在检测方面最大的一次提升，使Van类相对提升了335%。第三，我们将真实感指标视为解析问题而非黑盒，发现四个组成部分之一是由九个汇总统计量构成的闭式函数。我们还报告了一套实验方法论，我们认为这是更具可迁移性的成果。由于平均AP可分解为相互独立的类别项，单个提交可以承载多个受控实验，而完全由先前测量过的组件组成的提交，其得分在发送前便已可知。我们在提交前将最终得分预测到了小数点后四位。我们同样详细报告了负面结果，并在第8节全面说明了数据来源与合规性，包括对构成所提交得分的每个机制的完整说明。

Authors: Aman Upganlawar

CoReMatch: Recurrent Continuous Coordinate Refinement for Real-Time Robotic Feature Matching Perception3D

feature matching continuous coordinate refinement recurrent refinement real-time robotic perception

简要说明：CoReMatch 提出了一种递归连续坐标特征匹配框架，在坐标空间中而非离散网格上细化对应关系，在嵌入式硬件上实现了更快、更准确的机器人感知匹配。

TLDR: CoReMatch introduces a recurrent, continuous-coordinate feature matching framework that refines correspondences in coordinate space rather than on discrete grids, achieving faster and more accurate matching for robotic perception on embedded hardware.

Abstract: Feature matching underpins many robotic perception tasks, including visual localization, mapping, SLAM, and autonomous navigation. Existing semi-dense matchers predict confidence on fixed grids, limiting correspondences to predefined locations and requiring costly high-resolution grids for precise localization. We present CoReMatch (Coordinate Refinement Match), a recurrent framework that refines correspondences directly in continuous coordinate space rather than predicting discrete confidence maps. CoReMatch progressively improves correspondence estimates by propagating information across iterations. At the coarse stage, a Deep Aggregated Transformer captures global context and iteratively updates correspondence coordinates, while a lightweight regression head further sharpens their localization. Experiments on indoor and outdoor benchmarks show that CoReMatch strikes a strong balance between accuracy and efficiency, outperforming Efficient LoFTR in accuracy while running more than 10x faster on embedded edge hardware. These results demonstrate that recurrent coordinate refinement offers an efficient and scalable approach to real-time feature matching for robotic perception.

摘要（中文）：特征匹配支撑着众多机器人感知任务，包括视觉定位、建图、SLAM以及自主导航。现有的半稠密匹配器在固定网格上预测置信度，将对应关系限制在预定义位置，并且为实现精确定位需要计算成本高昂的高分辨率网格。我们提出了CoReMatch（坐标细化匹配），一种直接在连续坐标空间中细化对应关系的循环框架，而非预测离散的置信度图。CoReMatch通过在迭代间传播信息，逐步改进对应关系估计。在粗阶段，深度聚合Transformer捕获全局上下文并迭代更新对应坐标，同时一个轻量级回归头进一步锐化其定位精度。在室内和室外基准上的实验表明，CoReMatch在精度与效率之间达到了良好的平衡，在精度上优于Efficient LoFTR，同时在嵌入式边缘硬件上的运行速度快了10倍以上。这些结果证明，循环坐标细化为机器人感知中的实时特征匹配提供了一种高效且可扩展的途径。

Authors: Robert J. Wang, Charles Ling, Boyu Wang

Self-Consistent Neural Control: Learning Trajectories for Implicit Equilibrium Manipulation

implicit equilibrium adjoint learning trajectory optimization deformable objects sensitivity control

简要说明：本文提出自一致神经控制（SCNC），通过显式控制灵敏度变化来优化隐式平衡系统中的轨迹，在可变形物体任务上比伴随学习和无梯度基线实现更快收敛和更好的稳定性。

TLDR: This paper introduces Self-Consistent Neural Control (SCNC), a method for optimizing trajectories in implicit equilibrium systems by explicitly controlling sensitivity variations, achieving faster convergence and improved stability over adjoint learning and gradient-free baselines on deformable object tasks.

Abstract: One big challenge in physical AI is interacting with systems whose states are defined by implicit equilibrium. Learning in these systems is difficult because their responses can be multistable, path-dependent, and sensitive over long horizons. Adjoint learning provides an efficient way to optimize trajectories without unrolling iterative equilibrium solvers, but its gradient relies on the frozen-tangent approximation, which neglects higher-order sensitivity terms and can become inaccurate when the local equilibrium varies rapidly. In this work, we introduce Self-Consistent Neural Control (SCNC), optimizing trajectories along which sensitivity variations are explicitly controlled. We derive a mathematical bound on the resulting gradient error and develop a practical finite-difference approximation. We validate the framework on deformable objects, which are representative of implicit equilibrium systems, ranging from simple quadratic energy models such as elastic rods to complex systems including thin-walled tubes, measuring tapes, and Slinky-like structures. Compared with the adjoint learning and the gradient-free iCEM baselines, SCNC achieves faster convergence and more stable optimization by reducing switching to undesirable equilibrium branches, doubling the stable optimization rate over adjoint learning 83.3% vs. 41.7% and reducing the average loss by more than 1.5 orders of magnitude on thin-walled tubes, where sensitivity variations are pronounced.

摘要（中文）：物理人工智能领域的一大挑战在于与状态由隐式均衡定义的系统进行交互。在这类系统中进行学习十分困难，因为其响应可能具有多稳态、路径依赖性，并在长时间范围内表现出敏感性。伴随学习提供了一种无需展开迭代均衡求解器即可高效优化轨迹的方法，但其梯度依赖于冻结切线近似，该近似忽略了高阶灵敏度项，当局部均衡快速变化时可能变得不准确。在本工作中，我们引入了自一致神经控制（SCNC），该方法沿着灵敏度变化被显式控制的轨迹进行优化。我们推导了由此产生的梯度误差的数学界限，并开发了一种实用的有限差分近似方法。我们在可变形物体上验证了该框架，这些物体是隐式均衡系统的典型代表，涵盖从弹性杆等简单二次能量模型到包括薄壁管、卷尺和类弹簧结构在内的复杂系统。与伴随学习及无梯度iCEM基线方法相比，SCNC通过减少向不良均衡分支的切换，实现了更快的收敛速度和更稳定的优化，在薄壁管这一灵敏度变化显著的场景中，稳定优化率较伴随学习提升了一倍（83.3%对41.7%），平均损失降低了超过1.5个数量级。

Authors: Hengyi Zhou, Haobo Fang, Xiaonan Huang, Dezhong Tong, M. Khalid Jawed

3D-BBDA: Backpropagation-Free Black-Box Domain Adaptation for Robust 3D Point Cloud Recognition Perception3D

Black-box domain adaptation 3D point cloud recognition Prototype-based alignment Pseudo-label Robustness

简要说明：本文提出了3D-BBDA，一种无需反向传播的黑箱域适应框架，用于三维点云识别，通过伪标签引导的原型对齐和加权预测融合，在无法访问源数据或模型内部参数的情况下提升分类器对领域偏移的鲁棒性，并在多个损坏三维基准上展示了改进效果。

TLDR: This paper introduces 3D-BBDA, a backpropagation-free black-box domain adaptation framework for 3D point cloud recognition, which uses pseudo-label guided prototype-based alignment and a weighted prediction fusion to adapt classifiers without access to source data or model internals, demonstrating improved robustness on corrupted 3D benchmarks.

Abstract: Robust 3D point-cloud recognition is critical for robotics, mapping, and urban sensing, yet point-cloud classifiers often suffer performance drops under domain shifts caused by sensor changes, environmental variation, and acquisition artifacts. Many existing adaptation methods are difficult to deploy in practice because they require access to source data or the internal parameters of the source model, which may be restricted by privacy, licensing, or security constraints. We present 3D-BBDA, a backpropagation-free black-box domain adaptation framework that adapts a source-trained predictor to unlabeled target data using only black-box outputs. Our method performs pseudo-label guided prototype-based alignment and employs a weighted prediction module to fuse source logits with alignment logits, reducing sensitivity to noisy pseudo-labels. To stabilize prototype memory when pseudo-label coverage is incomplete, we construct a Gaussian-perturbed prototype prior from unlabeled target predictions and use it as a fallback for missing or unreliable class prototypes during alignment. Experiments on four corrupted 3D benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over strong baselines. On ModelNet-40C, 3D-BBDA achieves mean errors of 32.08% (PointNet) and 29.62% (GDANet), outperforming Source-only (35.88% / 34.03%) and BFTT3D (33.78% / 32.36%). 3D-BBDA requires only a single forward pass with no gradient updates making it suitable for real-time, privacy-preserving deployment in transferable 3D recognition pipelines. Project page is available at https://visdomlab.github.io/3D_BBDA

摘要（中文）：鲁棒的3D点云识别对于机器人技术、测绘和城市感知至关重要，然而点云分类器在传感器变化、环境变化和采集伪影引起的领域偏移下，往往会出现性能下降。许多现有的自适应方法在实际部署中较为困难，因为它们需要访问源数据或源模型的内部参数，而这些可能受到隐私、许可或安全限制的约束。我们提出了3D-BBDA，一种无需反向传播的黑盒域自适应框架，仅利用黑盒输出即可将源训练好的预测器适应到无标签的目标数据上。我们的方法执行伪标签引导的基于原型的对齐，并采用加权预测模块融合源对数与对齐对数，从而降低对噪声伪标签的敏感性。当伪标签覆盖不完整时，为稳定原型记忆，我们从无标签目标预测中构建高斯扰动原型先验，并在对齐过程中将其作为缺失或不可靠类原型的回退方案。在四个损坏3D基准上的实验表明，该方法相较于强基线取得了一致的改进。在ModelNet-40C上，3D-BBDA达到平均误差32.08%（PointNet）和29.62%（GDANet），优于仅用源数据的方法（35.88%/34.03%）和BFTT3D（33.78%/32.36%）。3D-BBDA仅需单次前向传播，无需梯度更新，使其适用于可迁移3D识别流水线中的实时、隐私保护部署。项目页面可在https://visdomlab.github.io/3D_BBDA 获取。

Authors: Shivangi Rai, Kunal Jangid, Vaibhav Kumar, Vinod K Kurmi

DenseTwins: Dense Modality Decoupling for Multimodal Self-Supervision Perception3D

multimodal self-supervision dense representations modality decoupling cross-modal correspondences redundancy reduction

简要说明：DenseTwins提出了一种多模态自监督框架，通过解耦共享与模态特定特征来学习稠密、空间结构化的表示，提升了下游多模态感知基准（包括机器人和自动驾驶应用）的性能。

TLDR: DenseTwins proposes a multimodal self-supervised framework that learns dense, spatially-structured representations by decoupling shared and modality-specific features, improving downstream multimodal perception benchmarks including robotics and autonomous driving applications.

Abstract: Multimodal perception is central to many computer vision applications, including robotics and autonomous driving, where different sensing modalities provide complementary cues. Self-supervised learning offers a scalable solution for exploiting large amounts of unlabeled multimodal data. However, existing methods either neglect modality-specific information by enforcing feature-space alignment between modalities or learn only global representations without preserving spatial structure. We propose DenseTwins, a multimodal self-supervised framework that learns dense representations by explicitly decoupling the dense feature space into shared and modality-specific components. The proposed approach combines dense cross-modal correspondences with redundancy-reduction objectives, enabling the model to capture both shared semantics and modality-specific cues within a structured dense embedding space. DenseTwins jointly optimizes an intra-modal objective across augmented views and a cross-modal objective that aligns shared features while decorrelating modality-specific information. We evaluate DenseTwins across multiple multimodal benchmarks and sensing setups, achieving state-of-the-art or competitive performance across multimodal self-supervised baselines. Code available at: https://github.com/CarloSgaravatti/DenseTwins.

摘要（中文）：多模态感知是许多计算机视觉应用的核心，涵盖机器人和自动驾驶等领域，在这些应用中，不同的感知模态提供了互补的线索。自监督学习为利用大量未标注的多模态数据提供了一种可扩展的解决方案。然而，现有方法要么通过强制模态间的特征空间对齐而忽略模态特有信息，要么仅学习全局表示而不保留空间结构。我们提出了DenseTwins，一种多模态自监督框架，通过将稠密特征空间显式解耦为共享组件和模态特有组件来学习稠密表示。该方法将稠密跨模态对应与冗余消减目标相结合，使模型能够在结构化的稠密嵌入空间中同时捕获共享语义和模态特有线索。DenseTwins联合优化了跨增强视图的模态内目标以及跨模态目标，后者在对齐共享特征的同时对模态特有信息进行去相关处理。我们在多个多模态基准测试和传感配置上评估了DenseTwins，在多模态自监督基线中取得了最先进或具有竞争力的性能。代码可在以下网址获取：https://github.com/CarloSgaravatti/DenseTwins。

Authors: Carlo Sgaravatti, Daniele Kopyshevskiy, Davide Secco, Giacomo Boracchi

Weather Adaptive Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

conformal risk control weather-robust detection false alarm trade-off calibrated threshold object detection

简要说明：本文研究在恶劣天气下如何为冻结的目标检测器设置置信度阈值，以在漏检与误报之间取得权衡，提出一种以每次漏检所接受的误报数为参数的校准旋钮。

TLDR: This paper studies how to set the confidence threshold of a frozen object detector in adverse weather to trade off missed objects against false alarms, proposing a calibrated dial parameterized by the number of false alarms accepted per missed object.

Abstract: Camera object detectors lose recall in rain, fog, snow and sand, and the confidence threshold at which a detector is deployed decides how many objects it misses and how many false alarms it raises. We study how a frozen detector should make this decision in adverse weather. We first reproduce SeqCRC, a conformal object detector whose first step calibrates the confidence threshold by conformal risk control (CRC), and use that step, calibrated separately in each weather condition, as our baseline. With YOLOv8x it keeps the held-out miss fraction within a 20% budget in every DAWN weather bin, where a single global threshold fails in fog, but the false alarms it needs are an output rather than a choice: from 1.6 to 117 per image across DAWN and BDD100K conditions. We then propose a calibrated trade-off dial. One setting, $λ$, the number of false alarms accepted to avoid one missed object, selects the expected-cost-optimal decision rule: either one score threshold, or a per-detection rule that keeps a box when its calibrated probability of being a real object, estimated by gradient-boosted trees from the detector's own per-box outputs, is at least $1/(1+λ)$. F-score preferences map onto the same dial, and CRC applied to $λ$ itself is planned to restore a per-condition miss guarantee. The dial is fitted once on BDD100K train and graded only on BDD100K val and DAWN.

摘要（中文）：摄像头目标检测器在雨、雾、雪和沙尘天气中会降低召回率，而检测器部署时所设定的置信度阈值决定了它漏检多少目标以及产生多少误报。我们研究了在恶劣天气下，一个冻结的检测器应如何做出这一决策。我们首先复现了SeqCRC——一种基于置信度风险控制（CRC）在第一阶段校准置信度阈值的共形目标检测器，并将该步骤（分别在每种天气条件下单独校准）作为我们的基线。在使用YOLOv8x时，该方法在DAWN数据集每个天气类别中均能将留出集的漏检率控制在20%预算以内，而单一的全局阈值在雾天条件下则会失效；但该方法所需的误报数量是输出结果而非选择项：在DAWN和BDD100K的不同条件下，误报数从每张图像1.6个到117个不等。随后，我们提出了一种校准过的权衡调节旋钮。其中一种设置——即为了避免一个漏检目标而接受的误报数量λ——用于选择期望成本最优的决策规则：要么采用单一得分阈值，要么采用逐检测规则，即当该检测框为真实目标的校准概率（通过梯度提升树根据检测器自身的逐框输出估计）至少为$1/(1+λ)$时保留该框。F-score偏好可映射到同一旋钮上，并且计划对λ本身应用共形风险控制，以恢复按条件设定的漏检保证。该旋钮仅在BDD100K训练集上拟合一次，并仅在BDD100K验证集和DAWN数据集上进行评估。
